ep7.「誰かが働きを見てくれている、\nその事実がどれだけ勇気をくれ──」: Knowing someone is watching our work— that fact gives us courage—
ep7.「身の程は理解していますので、\n油断せず、慢心せず、調子に乗らず」: I know my place, so I won't let my guard down, get cocky, or lose my composure.
ep7.「軍神として……？\nそれとも、愛の女神の代わりに……？」: “As a war god…? Or perhaps in place of the goddess of love…?”
ep7.「過ごした時間と絆の強さは必ず比例して、\nそれは何を以てしても覆すことは叶わな: The time we've spent together and the strength of our bonds will always be proportional, and nothing can ever change that.
ep7.「長生きも、案外するものですね……」: “Longevity turns out to be something you can have after all…”
ep7.「馬鹿にしておるのかたわけめ！\n誰がキュウビちゃんだなれなれしい！\nわらわは: Are you mocking me, you scoundrel! Who calls me Kyuubi-chan! I am the great fox of the Empire!?

m200543.あれ！？ 私が同盟から弾かれているのですが！？\n帝国騎士団騎兵大隊長という職責: Huh!? I'm being expelled from the alliance!? Me, the Grand Commander of the Imperial Knight Cavalry?!
m200543.ええと、確かに入浴は風水的に重要ではありますが……。: Well, bathing does have some feng-shui importance, but…
m200543.お労しや、ラタトスク様……。: Thank you for your effort, Lord Ratatoskr…
m200543.こういう仕事は本当に速いのよね……。: Jobs like this really move fast…
m200543.これより『世界三大名湯』の選定に入るにゃ～！: From now on we'll select the “Three Great Famous Hot Springs of the World”!
m200543.しかし、そこで我々は考えた！\n長期休暇が取れないのであれば、\n仕事をしながら: But then we thought! If we can't take a long vacation, we'll work while we rest!
m200543.そもそも冬季休暇が短すぎるのが悪いにゃ！\n一年の疲れがたった数日で癒えるのかに: The real problem is the winter break is way too short! Can a few days heal a year's worth of fatigue?! At least double-digit days should be the minimum, right!?
m200543.ということで、行くぞ視察！: So, let's go on an inspection!
m200543.また変なこと言い出して……。: Here we go with another weird idea…
m200543.もう関係各所に根回しが済んでまして……。: The groundwork's already been laid with the relevant parties…
m200543.メーアはがっつり休んでたでしょ。: Meer, you've been taking a solid break, haven't you?
m200543.世界三大名湯？: The Three Great Famous Hot Springs?
m200543.冬の旅行はやっぱり温泉に限るのにゃ。\nあたしたちで最高の温泉を決めるのにゃー？: Winter trips are all about hot springs. Shall we pick the best one together?
m200543.吾輩たちお仕事したくない同盟は、\n『物質界温泉協会』の設立を宣言！: We, the Alliance that doesn't want to work, hereby declare the founding of the “Material Realm Hot-Spring Association”!
m200543.吾輩だって巣穴で食っちゃ寝したいのじゃがー！？\nなんで世界樹で一番偉い吾輩が一: I too want to eat and sleep in my den! Why is the greatest of the World Tree the busiest one!?
m200543.国家元首級の重責と比べるなであります。: Don't compare that to the burden of a head-of-state level responsibility.
m200543.我ら新生お仕事したくない同盟！\n労働を憎み、自由を愛する者なり！: We are the Newborn Alliance of those who refuse work! Hating labor, loving freedom!
m200543.新年早々過剰労働を強いる社会に否を叩き付けろー！\nこういうのはもっと軽い仕事か: At the start of the year, let's slam the society that forces us into overwork! You gotta start with lighter jobs first, right?
m200543.有識者として風水に詳しいクーシンさんを呼んでおいたよ！: I've invited Ku-Xin, a feng-shui expert, as a consultant!
m200543.正解は一番偉いからでしたー！ 諦めろー！: The answer is—because we're the greatest! Give up!
m200543.物質界連合による経済振興政策の一環だよ。\n温泉を通じて人流や物流の活性化を促す: It's part of the Material Realm Union's economic-revitalization plan. Using hot springs to boost tourism and logistics.

m200574.――あら、誰もが総大将に従うわけではないのよ？: ――Oh, not everyone follows the commanders, you know?
m200574.――いつまで経っても！\n瞼の裏に焼き付いて離れないんだから！:
――No matter how much time passes!
They are burned into the back of my eyelids and won't fade!
m200574.――おお、これが王国の夏祭りか！\n中々に賑やかじゃあないか！:
――Oh, so this is the Kingdom's summer festival!
Quite the lively affair, isn't it!
m200574.――その前に、我々があなたたちを止めますがな。: Before that, we shall be the ones to stop you.
m200574.――なんとか夏祭りに間に合ったな。: ――We made it to the summer festival just in time.
m200574.――マータンが止めないといけないからな！: —then it's up to Martan to stop them!
m200574.――全部全部、めちゃくちゃにするわ。: ――I'm going to turn it all upside down.
m200574.――分かったよ、説教されに出てきてやるよ。: ――Fine, I'll come out and take my scolding.
m200574.――変わらないいつもなんて、あるわけないだろ。: There's no such thing as an “everyday” that never changes.
m200574.――大変です！ 祭り会場で妖怪たちが暴れています！: ――It's a crisis! The yokai are causing a ruckus at the festival grounds!
m200574.――祭りの夜に咲く花火を、\nお前に無理やり見せて教えてやる！:
—and I'll force you to watch the fireworks bloom on the night of the festival!
--- scene: What It Takes to Change (battle, end) ---
m200574.――花火を潰すのは駄目よ。: No, you can't stop the fireworks.
m200574.――花火大会も無事に開催できたみたいだな。: ――It seems the fireworks display was held without a hitch.
m200574.……あの獣人が、主犯格ですかな。: ……That beastman is the main culprit, I presume.
m200574.……おや？ 会場になにか、見知らぬ者がいるような……？: ……Hm? It looks like there are some unfamiliar faces in the arena……?
m200574.……ここにいる獣人たちは、\nその一部の者たちということですかな。: ……So the beastfolk here are the ones who disappeared?
m200574.……こりゃ駄目ね。\nあなたたちを相手取るなら、\nもっと頭数が必要だったかしら:
……Well, that's a no-go.
I suppose I needed a bigger group to handle you all.
m200574.……すまない。\n里のごたごたに巻き込んでしまって。:
……I'm sorry.
I've dragged you into all this village drama.
m200574.……ずっとそう教えられてきたのであれば、\n私たちを警戒するのは仕方のないことか:
……If that's what they've been taught all along,
then it's only natural they're wary of us.
m200574.……そうだな。\n楽しい夏祭りを、里の仲間たちに教えてやりたいと思う。:
……Yes.
I want to show the folks back home what a fun summer festival can be.
m200574.……そうでしたな。\n日常が、周囲の環境が、勝手に変えられることは、\nそう簡単:
Indeed.
If one's daily life, or one's surroundings, are changed without one's consent,
it is only natural that one cannot simply accept it.
m200574.……そうなってもなお、変わらないって言えるのか？\nいつもの光景が別のなにかに侵:
……Even if it happens, can you really say it won't change?
If the scenery you know so well gets overrun by something else,
can you still claim everything's just like it always was?
m200574.……そうやって立ち塞がるのは、\nあの獣人への義理ですかな？:
……Standing in our way like that is
out of some sense of duty to that beastman, I take it?
m200574.……そりゃどうも。\nなら、大暴れさせてもらうぞ。:
……Well, that's a first.
If that's the case, then I'll let loose and have my way.
m200574.……それで、手打ちにしてもらえるか？: ……Can we call it a truce with that?
m200574.……と、その前に。\nそこの獣人の子、あなたがマータンかしら？:
……But before that.
You there, beastfolk. Are you Martan?
m200574.……どこかに去っていくようだが、追わなくていいのか？: ……She looks like she's heading off somewhere. Should we not follow?
m200574.……やはり、マータン殿は嫌なのですかな？: ……Still, Lord Martan dislikes it, does he not?
m200574.……わけが分からんが、\n互いの目的の邪魔をしないならいいか。:
...I don't get it,
but as long as we don't get in each other's way, it's fine.
m200574.……マータンは、もうお前を説得するつもりはない。\nお前は納得しようがなんだろう:
……I'm not going to try to talk you out of this anymore.
Whether you agree or not,
I've realized you're not going to stop until the very end.
m200574.……今、雪枝の里の仲間たちも、\n花火を眺めているんだと思う。:
……Right now, I think my comrades from Snow Branch Village
are watching the fireworks too.
m200574.……俺たちの負けだな。\n当たり前みたいに、惨敗だ。:
……We lost.
It was a crushing defeat, as expected.
m200574.……動けるような状態じゃないんじゃないか？: ……Are they even in a condition to move?
m200574.……周囲からいくつかの気配がするな。\nなるほど、待ち伏せを狙っていたわけか。:
……I sense several presences around us.
I see. You were aiming for an ambush.
m200574.……変わったことを受け入れられなくて、\nもう暴れるしかなくなったということか。:
……So you can't accept change,
and now you have no choice but to rage?
m200574.……夏祭りに関しては、本気よ。: ...When it comes to the summer festival, I am serious.
m200574.……夏祭りの準備の前に、\nやらなければいけないことができたようだな。: ……It seems we have something to deal with before we can even begin preparing for the summer festival.
m200574.……夏祭りをすることが目的なら、\nなぜあなたたちは暴れ回っているのですかな。:
……If the goal is to hold a summer festival,
why are you causing such a commotion?
m200574.……大丈夫だ。\nちょっと考え事をしてた。:
……I'm fine.
I was just lost in thought.
m200574.……当たり前みたいに妖怪と獣人が待ち構えているな。: ……Of course, youkai and beastmen are waiting for us.
m200574.……時間が経ちすぎてしまったのか、\n魔物連中が全部壊していったからなのか。\n:
……Whether it's because too much time has passed,
or because the monsters have destroyed everything,
the sights I knew were no longer there.
m200574.……止めるぞ。\nこれ以上は、見ていられない。:
……I'll stop this.
I can't just watch anymore.
m200574.……獣人たちは答えたくないみたいね。: ……It seems the beastfolk don't feel like answering.
m200574.……王国の奴らには、本当に申し訳ない。: ……I'm truly sorry for what I did to the people of the kingdom.
m200574.……王国の奴らは話が分かりそうな感じだし、\n先にあんたらに相談するんだったぜ。:
……The Kingdom folk seem like they'd be more reasonable,
so I should have gone to them first.
m200574.……理解できないな。\n単純に、王国が好かないという話か？:
……I don't get it.
Is it simply that you dislike the Kingdom?
m200574.……知らないわよ。\n人々を守るためだのなんだのとほざいて、\n敵に立ち向かって:
……I don't know.
Spouting nonsense about protecting people,
that fool who charged right at the enemy.
m200574.……私たちの祭りというのは、そういう意味ですか。: ……So that is what you mean by "our festival."
m200574.……総意ってことはねぇだろ。\n族長はこんなこと考えてないだろうし、\nお前の親:
……It's not the "general sentiment."
The chief isn't thinking like this,
and neither is your best friend.
m200574.……聞きたいことは山ほどあるが、\n今は、お前を倒すことに集中する。:
……I have a thousand questions for you, but
for now, I'll focus on taking you down.
m200574.……自分たちの日常を変えられるのが嫌だ。: ……You don't like the idea of your daily lives being changed.
m200574.……親睦を深めることを考えると、\nそういった者も一緒に派遣するのは、\n自然な:
……Considering the goal is to deepen ties,
is it natural to send those kinds of people along too, I wonder……?
m200574.……雪枝の里は、変わらない。\nずっとずっと、おんなじ日々を繰り返し続ける。:
...Yukieda Village will not change.
The same days will go on, and on, and on.
m200574.……雪枝の里は去年、夏祭りを開いた。\nその提案をしたのはマータンたちだ。:
...Last year, Yukieda Village held a summer festival.
It was Martan and the others who proposed it.
m200574.……？ なんで人間を招くんだ？\n妖怪たちの夏祭りを開くんじゃなかったのか？:
...? Why are you inviting the humans?
Weren't we supposed to be holding a festival for the yokai?
m200574.あぁ、最近は自由になったから、\n陰陽師にコキ使われていた、が正しいかしら？:
Ah, well, since we've recently gained our freedom,
I suppose "were" is the correct tense.
m200574.あぁ、本当に嫌になる……！\nこんな痛い思いをしてまで、やることでもないのに……:
Ah, I really hate this……!
It's not worth going through this much pain for……!
m200574.ああ……もう、我儘言って迷惑かけるのは、やめるよ。: Yeah… I'll stop being selfish and causing trouble.
m200574.ああ……マータンはなにも問題ない。\nむしろ、やる気が出てきたところだ。:
I'm fine… I'm perfectly fine.
In fact, I'm feeling more motivated than ever.
m200574.ああ、ここまできて知らんぷりはできないからな。: Aye. We've come this far; we can't just look the other way.
m200574.ああ、そのとおりだ。\n俺たちは雪枝のいつもが変わることが恐ろしいんだよ。:
Yeah, you've got it right.
We're terrified of Yukieda changing from the way it always has been.
m200574.ああ、教えてやる。\nお前を倒して、みんなで祭りの準備を終わらせて――:
Ah, I'll show you.
I'll defeat you, finish the festival preparations with everyone, and—
m200574.ああ、里の中で一番頭が固くて、\n行動力が有り余っている仲間だ！:
Aye. He's the most stubborn one in the village,
with way too much energy to spare!
m200574.ああ。そのときは必ず、遊びに行こう。: Yes. I will definitely come and join in the fun.
m200574.ああ！ 全然言いたいことが言えてないからな！: Ah! I haven't said a single thing I wanted to say!
m200574.あいつが花火を炸裂させたときはどうしようかと思ったが、\nなんとか打ち上げられた:
I was worried when he set off the fireworks,
but it's a relief to see they managed to launch them after all!
m200574.あと、たとえそのままやるとしても、\nそれは雪枝の夏祭りになる気がするし。:
And even if we did copy it,
I feel like it would still become Snow Branch's summer festival.
m200574.あと、外に興味を持ってる変わり者どもの面倒を見て、\n色々夢を叶えてくれてるみた:
Also, you seem to be taking care of those eccentric types
who are interested in the outside world, and helping them fulfill their dreams.
m200574.あとやるべきなのはなんだ？\n花火の準備をしないといけないんだったか？:
What else is left to do?
Oh, right, we need to prepare the fireworks, don't we?
m200574.あと夏祭りの準備は絶対手伝え！\nこれで開催日に間に合わないとか許さないぞ！:
And you're absolutely helping with the summer festival preparations!
I won't forgive you if we don't make it in time for the opening day!
m200574.あら、逃げ足には自信があったのだけれど、\n流石の王国軍には敵わないみたいねぇ。:
Oh my. I was quite confident in my running speed, but
I suppose even I can't outrun the Kingdom's army.
m200574.ありがたいことだな。\nではお言葉に甘えて、力を貸してもらうとしよう。:
That's very kind of you.
Well, I'll take you up on your offer and accept your help.
m200574.あるいは……あの日見た花火が、美しすぎたせいかしら。: Or perhaps…… the fireworks I saw that day were just too beautiful.
m200574.あれは綺麗だったからな。\n今回王国に来た仲間たちにも、\n見せてやりたいと密か:
They were beautiful.
I've been secretly hoping to show them to the comrades who came with me this time.
m200574.あんたらが楽しみにしていた祭りを……。\n大切ないつもを、踏みにじるような真似を:
The festival you were looking forward to…
I treated your precious everyday life with such disregard.
m200574.いいですな、せっかくの機会ですし、\n私も羽目を外させてもらいましょうか。:
Very well. Since it's a rare opportunity,
I suppose I'll allow myself a bit of freedom as well.
m200574.いいや、今はあんまり抵抗がない。\nなんていうか、分かったんだ。:
No, I'm not really resisting it anymore.
It's just that…… I understand now.
m200574.いいや変わるね、大いにな。\n王国の夏祭りがまさにそうなんじゃねぇのか？:
No, it will. It will change a great deal.
Isn't the Kingdom's summer festival exactly that?
m200574.いや……私たちの事情を知っているのかと思っただけだ。: No... I just thought you might know about our situation.
m200574.いや、それは職人たちがやるからいい。\n私たちは他のことをやるとしよう。:
No, the craftsmen will handle that.
Let's focus on something else.
m200574.いや、なんでもない。\nちょっと気合を入れ直していただけだ。:
No, it's nothing.
I was just shaking off a bit of gloom.
m200574.いやいや、こんなへんてこなのは初めてだよ。\nそもそも俺たちが参加した祭りは東の:
No, no, this weird thing is new to us.
Besides, the festival we went to was in the Eastern Kingdom.
m200574.いやいや、まだ夏祭りの準備がありますぞ。\n滞っていた分、頑張らなくては。:
No, no, we still have the summer festival preparations to attend to.
We'll have to make up for lost time.
m200574.いやはや、参加させてくれてありがとうな！\nおかげで懐かしい気分になれたぜ！:
Well, thank you for letting us join in!
It really brought back some fond memories!
m200574.いやはや、雪枝の里の者たちが来てくれて助かった。\nおかげで夏祭りの準備が早く終:
I'm so glad the people from Snow Branch Village came to help.
Thanks to them, the festival preparations should be finished early.
m200574.うおおぉぉーー！！ マータンセッティング！！\n夏祭りの準備は任せろーー！！:
Woohooo—!! Martan's setting things up!!
Leave the summer festival preparations to us!!
m200574.うむ、了解した。\nにしても、花火の職人なんてものがいるのか。:
Understood.
Though, I wonder if there really are such things as firework craftsmen.
m200574.ええ……みんなで一緒に、\n夏祭りを楽しみ尽くすとしましょう♪: Yes... let us all enjoy this summer festival to the fullest, together♪
m200574.ええ、アタシはクダギツネ。\n陰陽師にコキ使われてる、\n妖怪の恥さらしみたいな:
Yes, I am Kudagitsune.
A race of yokai who were used as slaves by onmyoji,
the laughingstock of the yokai world.
m200574.ええ、北の果ての者たちは勇敢に散ったと、\n後世に語り継いであげるわね。: Yes. I'll make sure the ages remember how bravely the people of the North fell.
m200574.ええ、彼らも王国の夏祭りを中止させたいみたいだから、\n利害の一致でお友達になっ:
That's right. They want to stop the Kingdom's summer festival, too,
so it's a case of shared interests bringing us together.
m200574.ええ、最近できたお友達があなたのことを教えてくれたの。: Oh, yes. A friend I made recently told me all about you.
m200574.ええ、祭りの手伝いと奉仕活動で、\n王子殿も許してくれると思いますぞ。:
Yes. If you help with the festival and do some community service,
I believe His Highness will forgive you.
m200574.ええい、分からん！ 全っ然、分からないぞ！: I don't get it! I don't understand any of this!
m200574.おお、ありがとうなお嬢ちゃんたち！\n模擬戦音頭とやらは知らねぇが、\n夏祭りを:
Oh, thank you, young ladies!
I don't know what a "mock battle" is, but
I'm going to enjoy this summer festival!
m200574.おお、屋台が爆速で出来上がっていく……！: Oh, the stalls are being built at lightning speed……!
m200574.おや、花火に興味がおありですかな？: Oh? Is the Prince interested in fireworks?
m200574.おわー！？ マータンたちが必死に準備した会場が、\nめちゃくちゃになってるぞー！:
Wha-!? The venue Martan and the others worked so hard on is
completely trashed!?
m200574.お前の気持ちだとか言いたいことは、\n正直、里の総意ではあるんだと思う。:
Your feelings, and what you want to say……
Honestly, I think that represents the village's general sentiment.
m200574.お前は、ずっと過去に囚われているんだな。: You are still trapped in the past.
m200574.お前もマータンも、他の仲間たちだって分かってるはずだ。\n里が変わることを受け入:
You, Martan, and the rest of the village all know it, don't you?
You have to accept that the village is changing, and keep living.
m200574.お友達とやらのことも気になるからな！\nマータンはあいつを捕まえに行くぞ！:
I'm worried about this “friend” business too!
Martan is going to catch that creature!
m200574.お友達は、あなたに優しくするよう言っていたけれど……。\n立ち向かってくるなら、:
My friend said I should be gentle with you, but…
If you're going to fight, I suppose there's no choice, is there?
m200574.かつて東の国で行なわれていた賑やかな祭りたち。\nアタシは、その光景を見るのが好:
The lively ones that used to be held in the eastern lands.
I loved watching the sights.
m200574.くそ……全部あの陰陽師のせいよ……！\nとっくにいなくなったくせに……！\nアタ:
Dammit…… it's all that Onmyoji's fault……!
Even though he's long gone……!
How much longer do you intend to chain me……!
m200574.くだらない芝居は結構。\n逃げるふりをして我々を誘い込んだつもりなのでしょう。:
Enough with the theatrics.
You were pretending to flee to lure us in, weren't you?
m200574.けど、お前たちはこうすることでしか、\n変わることを受け入れられないんだって、\:
But Martan also knows that the only way you can accept that change
is by doing what you're doing now.
m200574.こい！ 雪枝の里の戦士たち！ それから王国の者たち！\nマータン様がボッコボコに:
Come on! Warriors of Snow Branch Village! And you from the kingdom!
Lord Martan is going to beat the living daylights out of you all!
m200574.こうして、外の世界の友と肩を並べ、\n一緒にいられる日々が、いつもになるように…:
I hope that days like this, standing side by side with friends from beyond our borders,
will become the norm……
m200574.ここまできたら、もう駄目。: We've come this far. It's over.
m200574.このまま外の文化とか考え方とか、食べ物とか、置物とか。\nそういうのが里に入って:
Thinking about outside culture, ways of thinking, food, decorations……
all of that coming into the village…… it's scary.
m200574.この獣人たちは、まさか……雪枝の戦士たちか！？: These beastfolk… could they be… warriors from Yukieda?
m200574.この花火とやらは大層綺麗らしいなぁ！\nだからよぉ、俺たちに教えてくれよ！:
I hear these fireworks are incredibly beautiful!
So tell us!
m200574.これ、元々は東の国だかの文化だろ？\nそれがいつの間にかこの国に定着しちまったん:
This originally came from some eastern country, right?
Before we knew it, it had taken root in this country.
m200574.これ、結構急にやるって決めたから。\n会場を確保する時間も、屋台を用意する時間も:
We decided to do this quite suddenly.
We didn't have time to secure a venue or set up any stalls.
m200574.これで開催できなかったら目も当てられないからな。\nどうにかなってマータンも一安:
If we hadn't, the sight would have been unbearable.
It's a relief that everything worked out.
m200574.こんなふうに、雪枝の里も変わっちまうんだよ。\nひとつでも外の文化を受け入れたら:
It's the same here. The village of Yukieda will change.
Once you accept even a single outside influence, it's inevitable.
m200574.ご名答。彼らはあなたと同じ、雪枝の里の者たちよ。: Correct. They are from the village of Yukieda, just like you.
m200574.さぁ、話を聞かせてもらうぞ！\nなんで夏祭りを台無しにしようとした！\nこんなこ:
Now then, let's hear it out!
Why did you try to ruin the summer festival!
What's the point of doing something like this for you!?
m200574.さぁさぁ付き合ってもらうわよ皆さま方！\nどうせ戻れやしないっていうのなら！\n:
So come on, everyone! Join in!
If we can't go back anyway!
We have to rage and scream until we forget, don't we!!
m200574.さっき言っていたリーダー格の者が、裏にいると。: So the leader you mentioned earlier is the one pulling the strings.
m200574.しかし、あいつのやってることは絶対ダメだぞ！\n確かに里にはない文化が持ち込まれ:
But there's no way I can stand what that guy is doing!
I know it might introduce culture that doesn't exist in the village,
but throwing a tantrum and causing trouble over something like that...!
m200574.しかし、足並みが揃わないのは問題ですぞ。: But it's a problem if we're not all on the same page.
m200574.じゃ、俺たちは屋台を回らせてもらうぜ！\n迷惑はかけねぇから、許してくれよな！:
Alright, we're hitting up the food stalls!
We won't cause any trouble, so just give us a pass, yeah!
m200574.すげぇ！ これが模擬戦音頭か！\n面白い祭りだなぁ！:
Whoa! So this is the mock battle!
What a fun festival this is!
m200574.そ、そうなのか……。\nいや、身構えてしまって悪かった。:
I-is that so...?
I'm sorry for getting so worked up.
m200574.そいつらは外の世界にいい感情を抱いてない仲間だな！\nありえないくらい渋々手伝い:
Those are our comrades who don't have good feelings toward the outside world!
They're helping with the most reluctance imaginable!
m200574.そういうあなたたちも良かったのかしら？\nアタシたちは必ず祭りを開くけど。:
And what about you? Are you okay with this?
We are definitely going to hold the festival.
m200574.そういうわけだから、悪いな。\n俺たちの我儘に付き合ってもらうぞ。:
So, I'm sorry.
We're going to be a bit selfish, so please bear with us.
m200574.そういう理屈はマータンにはよく分からん。\nでも、大丈夫だって思ったんだ。:
That kind of logic doesn't really make sense to Martan.
But I felt it would be okay.
m200574.そうか。じゃあ最後にはやり合うしかねぇな。: I see. Then we'll just have to fight to the bitter end.
m200574.そうか。ようやく諦めがつくな。: I see. It's a relief that you've finally given up.
m200574.そうか！ 王国はやばいな！: I see! The Kingdom is in for a rough time!
m200574.そうだな。\nそういうことを貴様たちはしたわけだが。:
That's right.
You're the ones who started this.
m200574.そうだな！\nところで、これからなにがはじまるんだ？\nみんなやぐらの近くに集ま:
Agreed!
By the way, what's starting now?
It looks like everyone is gathering near the watchtowers.
m200574.そうでしたか。ならば我々も準備を頑張って――: I see. Then let's all do our best with the preparations—
m200574.そうですなぁ……。\n害意がないのなら追い返す必要もありませんか。:
I suppose you're right...
If they have no ill intent, there's no reason to turn them away.
m200574.そうねぇ……色々と理由はあるけれど、\nその一つとしては、準備時間が足りないから:
Well…… there are a few reasons, but
one of them is that we're short on preparation time.
m200574.そうねぇ。それなら悪党らしく、\n暴れ散らかすとしましょうか。:
I suppose so. Then, like true villains,
let's tear this place apart.
m200574.そう思えるようになったから、マータンは大丈夫だ。: Because I can think that way now, Martan is fine.
m200574.そこの獣人の子は話してないんでしょうけど、\n王国の祭りのために里の者を派遣する:
I don't know if that beastfolk there has told you, but
when it was decided that some villagers would be sent to the Kingdom's festival,
a few of them tried to refuse.
m200574.そちらの言い分や、里を思う気持ちは理解できますがな。\nしかし、こんな手段に訴え:
I understand your reasoning and how much you care about the village.
However, I simply cannot accept such drastic measures.
m200574.そっくりって……。\nその祭りでも模擬戦音頭とかやってたのか？:
Just like?
Did they have a mock battle at that festival, too?
m200574.そのあたりの難しいことはよく分からん！\nただ、困っているならマータンたちは手伝:
I don't really understand all that complicated stuff!
But if you're in trouble, Martan and the others will help!
m200574.そのときの夏祭りは大盛り上がりだったが、\n全員が参加してくれたわけじゃなかった:
That festival was a huge success,
but not everyone participated.
m200574.そのときは遊びにきてくれ！\nマータンたちが雪枝の夏祭りを見せてやる！:
Come and visit us then!
We're going to show you the best summer festival Snow Branch has ever seen!
m200574.その上で、言うぞ。: With that in mind, let me say this.
m200574.その後で、お友達とやらについて聞かせてもらうぞ！: After that, I want to hear all about this “friend” of yours!
m200574.その後は、王国の手伝いとか色々するんだぞ！\n雪枝の里の者として、やったことの責:
After that, you'll be helping the kingdom with all sorts of things!
As a member of Snow Branch Village, you must take responsibility for what you've done!
m200574.そもそも夏祭りだってそうだ。\n王国の祭りをそのままするわけじゃないしな。:
The same goes for the summer festival itself.
We're not just going to copy the kingdom's festival as-is.
m200574.それから一年かけて族長たちが仲間たちを説得して、\n今年はやらないにせよ、一旦王:
Over the past year, the chieftains have been trying to persuade the others.
This year, they're not holding a festival, but they agreed to help with the Kingdom's celebration
so they could get a feel for outside culture, it seems...
m200574.それがいきなり王国と関係を持つようになったとなれば、\n里の者たちの反発は凄そう:
If they suddenly start having relations with the kingdom,
the resistance from the villagers is likely to be fierce.
m200574.それじゃあいいわ、引っ張る意味もないし、\n待ち伏せの皆様に登場してもらおうかし:
Well, that's fine. There's no point in dragging this out,
so let's have our ambushers make their entrance.
m200574.それでこの光景に目を奪われたやつが、\nいつかちゃんとした夏祭りを開いて、\n花:
And the one who was captivated by this sight
will surely hold a proper summer festival someday,
and launch fireworks of their own.
m200574.それなら、既にあるものを拝借したほうが、\n遥かに手っ取り早いでしょう？:
So it seemed far more efficient to simply borrow what's already there,
didn't you think?
m200574.それに、そろそろ模擬戦音頭もはじまりますからな。\n大勢で戦うのは、さぞ楽しいこ:
Besides, the mock battle is about to start.
It must be a lot of fun to fight with a big group.
m200574.それに、次はマータンが大変な目に遭う番じゃないのか？: Besides, isn't it Martan's turn to face some trouble next?
m200574.それはなんとも、楽しみですな。: I do look forward to it.
m200574.それ以外のみんなは、うっすら抵抗を持ってるだろ。\n他ならぬマータンだってそうだ:
The rest of us are quietly resisting.
Even Martan is.
m200574.そんなことはどうでもいい！\nお前たちはなんでこんなことをしてるんだ！:
I don't care about that!
Why are you doing this!?
m200574.そんな王子とその仲間が大義のために戦って、\nそのために里が協力しなきゃならねぇ:
If the Prince and his companions are fighting for a just cause,
and the village has to cooperate for that,
we're more than happy to lend a hand.
m200574.そんな申し訳なさそうにしないでくれ。\n結局私たちはクダギツネを\n倒さないとい:
Don't look so apologetic.
In the end, we have to take down the Kudagi Fox anyway.
m200574.ただ……嫌なことを黙って受け入れるくらいなら、\n派手に駄々こねて意志を表示して:
But... rather than quietly accepting something I hate,
I'd rather make a big scene and show them exactly how I feel.
m200574.ただ、王国に派遣されてきた方々の半分くらいは、\n嫌々といった感じに見られますが:
However, about half of the people sent from the kingdom
seem to be doing it under protest……
m200574.ただまぁ、クダギツネの奴が迷惑かけて悪かったなぁ。\n同じ妖怪として謝らせてもら:
That said, I do feel bad about the trouble Kudagitsune caused.
As a fellow Yokai, I'd like to apologize on his behalf.
m200574.ただ花火とやらは潰させてもらうぞ。\nあれ、空に打ち上げる綺麗めな爆弾なんだろ？:
I'm just going to put a stop to the fireworks.
Aren't they just pretty bombs launched into the sky?
They're bound to catch the eyes of the villagers.
m200574.たぶん次はクリスマスをやろうって、\n変わり者どもは言い出すぜ。\nちょうど越冬:
I bet the next thing the eccentrics will suggest is Christmas.
The timing overlaps with the Winter Solstice Festival, too.
m200574.だから、なんにも変わらないんだ。\nこれも俺たちの大好きな、いつもの祭りなんだよ:
So nothing has really changed.
This is just our favorite, usual festival.
m200574.だから、壊そうって思うの。\n獣人が花火を駄目にしたらいいって思うの。:
That's why I want to destroy it.
I want the Beastkin to ruin the fireworks.
m200574.だからお前たちは……。\n雪枝の里が変わってしまいそうだって、思ってるんだな。:
So you think…….
That Yukieda Village is on the verge of changing.
m200574.だから里の仲間として止めてやる。: That's why I'm stopping you, as a fellow villager.
m200574.だから陰陽師がいなくなって自由になった今、\n久しぶりに祭りを見に行こうと思って:
So now that the Onmyoji is gone and I'm free,
I thought I'd go see a festival again,
so I traveled around the eastern lands……
m200574.だが、それは駄目だろう。\nどれだけ嫌だろうが認めなければ、\n先になんて進めな:
But that won't do.
No matter how much you hate it, you must accept it,
or you will never move forward.
m200574.だが、マータンの意見ははっきり言わせてもらうぞ。: But let me be clear about my opinion.
m200574.だが、今回の手伝いでちゃんとした夏祭りを知ったら、\n里でも毎年開催されちまうか:
But if we get to see a proper summer festival through this job,
maybe we'll end up holding one every year, right?
m200574.だが、分かっているだろう？\nどれだけ頑張っても、\nあの頃の祭りとやらを再現す:
But you must know, no matter how hard you try,
recreating the festival of your memories is……
m200574.だが、放っておくわけにいかないだろう。: But we can't just let her go.
m200574.だが、王国を実際に見てみないと、\n王子たちが悪人ではないことは分からないからな:
But you can't know that the princes aren't bad people
until you actually see the kingdom.
That's how it is, so it was decided we'd help with the festival.
m200574.だけど、なぁ？ 分かるだろ、マータン。\n俺たちがどういう気持ちなのかよぉ。:
But, you see? You get it, Martan.
How we feel about this.
m200574.だそうだ。\nきびきび働くんだぞ。:
That's what she said.
You'd better work hard and efficiently.
m200574.だったら自分たちで作るしかないでしょう？\nあの頃の祭りを、アタシたち自身で。:
Then there's only one option, isn't there?
We make our own festival.
Like the ones from back then, with our own hands.
m200574.だって、あの日の花火と違う花火なんて見たら、\nもう戻れないことが理解できちゃう:
Because if I see fireworks that aren't like the ones from that day,
I'll realize that I can never go back, won't I?
m200574.っ、打ち上げ場に向かうつもりか！: You're heading to the launch site!
m200574.であれば、我々もご一緒しますぞ。: In that case, we'll join you.
m200574.では、いくぞ！ うおおー！\nマータンスーパーダッシュ！:
Then, let's go! Ooooh!
Martan Super Dash!
m200574.では、妖怪も交えてはじめましょうか。\n賑やかな夏祭りを、楽しみますぞ。:
Then let's get started, Yokai included.
Let's enjoy a lively summer festival.
m200574.では、私たちも行こうか。\n色々と買い食いするだろう？:
Then, let's go.
We'll be buying all sorts of street food, won't we?
m200574.では我々も祭りに本格参戦するとしようか。\nたくさん準備を頑張ったのだから、その:
Then let's dive into the festivities in full force.
We worked hard on the preparations, so we deserve to enjoy it to the fullest.
m200574.でも、祭りは祭りだ。\n人が笑ってて、賑やかで、楽しげで……。\nそれは、おんな:
But a festival is a festival.
People are laughing, it's lively, and everyone's having a good time...
That part is the same.
m200574.でもって、そういう連中で集まって、\n今回の事件を起こしたんだと思うが……。:
But I think they banded together
and are responsible for this incident…
m200574.でもって、祭りの日にゃモミの木を飾って、\nプレゼントを贈り合うことになるんだろ:
And then, on the day of the festival, we'll decorate with fir trees
and exchange presents, I suppose.
m200574.でもまぁ、あなたなら分かるんじゃないのかしら？\n異文化に……外の世界に触れたく:
But then again, don't you understand that feeling?
The desire to keep the outside world, and its different culture, at a distance.
m200574.というわけで、みんなで模擬戦するぞー！: So, everyone, let's have a sparring match!
m200574.というわけでアタシは逃げるとするわ。\nええ……お友達のところまでね。: So, I'm off. I'll be heading to my friend's place.
m200574.というわけで行くぞお前たち！\n死ぬ気で働くぞー！！ 雪枝ワーキング！！:
So let's get going, you lot!
We're working ourselves to the bone!! Snow Branch Working!!
--- scene: The Festival Is the Festival ---
m200574.とことん、ろくでもないやり方でなぁ！！: I'll do it in the worst, most unreasonable way possible!!
m200574.ところで、無関係の妖怪の皆さまはどうしてここに？: By the way, why are you unaffiliated Yokai here?
m200574.ともかく、主導者はさっさと出てこい！\nマータンがお説教してやる！:
Anyway, come out, you ringleader!
Martan is going to give you a proper lecture!
m200574.ともかく、我々は進みましょうか。\nまだ、お説教は済んでいないのでしょう？:
In any case, let's move on.
You haven't finished your lecture, have you?
m200574.とりあえず問題は解決したと見てよさそうですな。\nでは我々も、準備に戻るとしまし:
I suppose we can say the problem is resolved for now.
Let's get back to the preparations, then.
m200574.とりあえず最後の抵抗として、\n花火とやらをぶち壊しに行くとするかね。: As a last stand, I guess I'll just have to wreck those fireworks.
m200574.どうだ参ったか！\nもう十分暴れただろ！:
How about that! Aren't you done yet!
You've caused enough trouble!
m200574.どうにもそちらの意図が読めませんな。\nあなたはいったい、なにに突き動かされてい:
I can't quite read your intentions.
What exactly is driving you?
m200574.どうやら厄介なことに、\n重なる部分が多少あったようですね。:
It seems our troubles have
overlapped to a certain extent, it would appear.
m200574.どうやら楽しんでもらえたみたいだな。: It looks like you're all having a good time.
m200574.なに、俺たちは祭りが好きでなぁ。\nできれば参加させてもらいてぇって思ってよぉ。:
Oh, we're just big fans of festivals, that's all.
We were hoping we could join in on the fun.
m200574.なら、そっくりなんかじゃないのでは……？: Then it can't really be the same, can it...?
m200574.なら、今年の夏祭りは絶対に成功させないとな。: Then we absolutely must make this summer festival a success.
m200574.なら問題ないわね。\n人間は招くけど、獣人は招くつもりはないから。:
Then there's no problem.
We're inviting the humans, but we have no intention of inviting the beastmen.
m200574.なるほど、さっそくこいつらの出番みたいだな！: I see. Looks like it's these guys' turn to shine!
m200574.なるほど、夏祭りを知らせないために……。\nあるいは夏祭りという概念を里の者たち:
I see. So they carried out this atrocity to keep the summer festival from being known...
Or perhaps to prevent the very concept of a summer festival from reaching the villagers.
m200574.なんか……元気がなくないか？: Huh…… doesn't she look a bit down?
m200574.なんかいいやつそうだし、\n参加してもいいんじゃないのか？:
They seem like nice guys, so
I don't see why we can't let them participate.
m200574.なんだ、バレバレだったのね。: Hmph, so it's obvious, is it?
m200574.なんだったかしら……昨年、里で夏祭りが開かれて、\nそれがきっかけで外への警戒が:
Now, what was it again… Last year, the village held a summer festival,
and that seems to have been the spark that made them more wary of the outside world.
m200574.なんて……今更なことでしたな。: I suppose…… that was a rather moot point.
m200574.なんて、会話はもう十分よね。\nそれじゃあさっさと喧嘩の続きをはじめましょうか。:
Anyway, I think we've had enough of a chat.
Shall we get back to the fighting?
m200574.なんて言っても、もう遅いみたいですぞ。\n皆、やる気になってしまいましたからな。:
Whatever we say now, it's too late.
Everyone's gotten into the spirit of it, it seems.
m200574.なんでって、決まっているでしょう？\nアタシたちの夏祭りをするためよ。:
Why? It's obvious, isn't it?
To hold our own summer festival.
m200574.なんにせよ、これは雪枝の里の問題だ。\nマータンはやつらを追いかけさせてもらうぞ:
In any case, this is a matter for Yukieda.
I'm going after them.
m200574.はぁ……ここには来ないで欲しかったのだけど。\n祭り会場で暴れたら準備したものが:
Haa…… I really wish you hadn't come here.
If you cause a scene at the festival grounds, you'll ruin all the preparations, won't you?
m200574.はぁ……頭冷えたわ。\n迷惑かけてごめんなさいね、王国の皆さま方。:
Haa…… my head's finally clearing up.
I'm sorry for the trouble I've caused, everyone in the kingdom.
m200574.ふふ、いいわね。\nアタシ、喧嘩は大好きよ。:
Heh, that sounds good.
I love a good fight.
m200574.ふむ……揉めることは大前提、というわけですか。\nまぁ、手を取り合うには必要な痛:
I see…… so conflict is a given, then.
Well, I suppose it's a necessary pain to reach out to one another.
m200574.ふむ、よく分からんがとりあえず止めに行くぞ！\nうぉぉー！ マータンダッシュ！！:
Hmph. I don't quite get it, but let's go stop them anyway!
Woah! Martan Dash!!
m200574.ぶつかることで強固になる絆というのも、\nこの世には確かにありますからなぁ。:
Bonds forged through conflict can certainly be the strongest kind,
as they say.
m200574.ほ、本当にこれで問題が解決するのか……！？\nマータンは模擬戦を過信しすぎている:
D-Do you really think this will solve the problem…!?
Isn't Martan relying a little too heavily on sparring matches!?
m200574.ほらほら、きびきび働きなさいねー。\n祭りの準備が遅れたらぶちのめすわよー。:
Now then, now then, let's get to work.
If the festival preparations are late, I'll beat you up.
m200574.まぁ、いいわ。アタシはあなたみたいに、\n利口には生きられないのだから。:
Well, fine. I can't live so wisely
like you do, after all.
m200574.まぁ、こういう問題は、\n身体を動かせばだいたいどうにかなる！:
Well, when it comes to problems like this,
just getting everyone to move around usually sorts things out!
m200574.まぁ、妥協案なんざねぇんだろうがよ。: Well, there's probably no compromise to be had, though.
m200574.まぁ、当たり前に受け入れられないらしいな。\n里はずっと閉じていたから、仕方ない:
Well, it's not something they can just take in stride.
The village has been shut off for so long, so I suppose that's only to be expected.
m200574.まぁ、真面目な話はこれくらいでいいでしょう。\n今は夏祭りの時間ですからな。:
Well, let's leave the serious talk there for now.
It's time for the summer festival, after all.
m200574.まぁ、結局お手伝いはすることになったんだけど、\n断固拒否した一部の者たちは、\:
Well, in the end, they did agree to help out.
But a few of them flat-out refused,
and apparently, they've since vanished without a trace.
m200574.まぁ、雪枝の仲間の半分は抵抗を示してるんだぜ？\nそういう連中の多くは渋々里の決:
Well, half of our people are resisting, you know?
Most of those folks seem to be going along with the village's decision, more or less.
m200574.まさか、そんな感情は微塵もないわ。\nただ、アタシたちの祭りは開けなさそうだし、:
Not at all. I don't feel a shred of that.
It's just that our festival isn't going to happen,
so I figured I didn't want to see any fireworks anymore.
m200574.まだ人に迷惑をかける妖怪がいたのか……。\n最近は妖怪の総大将たちのおかげで、\:
There are still yokai out there causing trouble for people…….
I thought things had settled down lately, thanks to the efforts of the yokai commanders.
m200574.まったくだぞ！ 反省しろ！\nそれでたくさんごめんなさいしてもらうからな！:
Exactly! Show some remorse!
You're going to apologize profusely, you hear me!
m200574.まったく困ったやつめ。\n今回の件が終わったら、みんなの前に突き出して、\n全力:
What a pain.
When this is over, I'm going to drag you out in front of everyone
and make you apologize with all your might!
m200574.まるで自分に言い聞かせるみたいな言い方ね。: You sound like you're trying to convince yourself.
m200574.みんなが花火を楽しみにしてるんだぞ！\nそんなことをさせるわけには……！:
Everyone is looking forward to the fireworks!
There's no way I can let you do that……!
m200574.みんなで模擬戦をして祭りを盛り上げるみたいな、\nそんな感じのあれらしいですぞ。:
It seems to be a sort of event where everyone joins in a mock battle
to liven up the festival.
m200574.むぅ……想像してみたらかなり嫌だったから、\n言い返す言葉がなくなってしまったぞ:
Mmph…… I imagined it, and it was pretty awful,
so I'm completely at a loss for words!
m200574.むしろ、これで許してくれて感謝している。\n本当にありがとう、ぺこり。:
If anything, we're the ones who should be thankful for your forgiveness.
Thank you so much, Pekori.
m200574.もしや、あなたを従えていた陰陽師はもう既に……。: Could it be that the Onmyoji who commanded you is already……
m200574.もちろんマータンもいるぞ！: Of course Martan is here too!
m200574.やっぱり嫌がって距離を取るやつらはいたし、\nそいつらはみんな、さっきのあいつと:
Some people still resisted and kept their distance,
and they all said the same thing as that one just now.
m200574.よく分からん連中とズブズブになって……！\nさすがのマータンもどうかと思うぞ！:
Getting mixed up with a bunch of weirdos I don't even know…!
Even for me, that's a bit much!
m200574.アタシのいつもが、今や遠く見る影もなくなったんだって。\nそう認めなきゃいけなく:
My "normal" is already a distant, unrecognizable shadow.
I'd have to admit that.
m200574.クダギツネを退治するのもだが、\n私たちは盗まれた備品を取り戻す必要がある。:
Not only do we need to deal with Kudagitsune,
we have to recover the stolen equipment.
m200574.クダギツネ？ いやいや違う違う。\n俺たちはあれとは関係ない、普通の妖怪たちだと:
Kudagitsune? No, no, that's not it.
We're just ordinary Yokai with no ties to him, you see.
m200574.ヒャアッ！！ 模擬戦の時間だァー！！: Yaaah!! Time for the sparring match!!
m200574.ヒャッハァッ！ 盗め盗めー！\n屋台から景品まで全部盗み出せー！\n河童だけにな:
Hyahh! Steal, steal!
Raid the stalls and grab every single prize!
Only a Kappa can swindle everything and get away with it!
m200574.マータンたちの大好きな里は……大好きないつもは、\nきっといつまでも、おんなじま:
The village we all love so much…… our beloved, everyday home,
will surely remain the same, forever.
m200574.マータンたちもたくさん歓迎するぞ！\n王国のみんなは、大切な盟友だからな！:
We'll give you all a warm welcome, too!
Everyone in the Kingdom is a precious ally to us!
m200574.マータンはお腹ぺこぺこだ！\n王子からもらったお小遣いで豪遊するぞ！:
Martan is starving!
I'm going to splurge on the allowance the Prince gave me!
m200574.マータン殿たちもありがとうございました。\n雪枝の皆さまが手伝ってくれて助かりま:
Thank you, Lord Martan and the others.
We are truly grateful for the help from everyone in Snow Branch.
m200574.一応、花火はまだ無事みたいですな。: At least, the fireworks seem to be intact.
m200574.一緒に爆ぜて！ どれだけ綺麗か教えてくれよぉ！！: Explode with us! Show us just how beautiful they are!!
m200574.人間の夏祭りは中止だァー！\n代わりに俺たちの夏祭りを開催してやるよォーッ！！:
The human summer festival is canceled!
In its place, we're holding our own summer festival!!
m200574.人間はそんなに好きじゃないし、\nむかつく陰陽師に連れられてっていうのは癪だった:
I'm not exactly fond of humans,
and I didn't care for being dragged along by that irritating Onmyoji,
but I didn't mind seeing everyone having a good time.
m200574.今日の祭りが、あのときのそれとそっくりだったから、\nなんだか懐かしくて暖かい気:
Today's festival is just like that one, so
it made me feel all nostalgic and warm inside!
m200574.今更妖怪に怯える民は王国にはいませんぞ。\nなのでまぁ、よい夏祭りを。:
There are no citizens in this kingdom who would be afraid of a yokai at this point.
So, I wish you all a wonderful summer festival.
m200574.仕方ありませんな。\n我々で追跡するとしましょうか。:
Very well.
Let us pursue them.
m200574.仲間の故郷で行なわれる新たな祭りだ。\nめいっぱい、楽しませてもらうぞ。:
A brand-new festival held in my comrades' homeland.
I intend to enjoy every last drop of it.
m200574.仲間をしばき倒さないといけないからか……はぁ。: Since I have to beat up my own allies…… haa.
m200574.俺たちは外の文化になんざ触れたくねぇし、\n外の文化に触れられたくもねぇんだよ。:
We don't want to touch outside culture,
and we don't want it touching us.
m200574.俺たちは里の外に存在するすべてが好かないんだよ。\nだが、王子たちのことは例外的:
We dislike everything that exists outside the village.
But we do hold the Princes in high regard, as an exception.
m200574.俺の仲間たちはぶちのめさないでもらいたいんだが……。\nにしてもアンタ、意外に本:
I'd prefer it if you didn't beat up my friends...
But I guess you're more serious than I expected.
m200574.俺はてっきり、自分たちの夏祭りだのなんだのは、\nふざけてるだけだと思ってたんだ: I thought you were just joking around about your summer festival and all that.
m200574.全然綺麗じゃないって、思わせてくれよ……！！: Or better yet, prove to us that they're not beautiful at all…!!
m200574.分かり切ったことですな。\nあちらの気が済むまで、相手をするとしましょうか。:
How was it?
You've had your fill of causing trouble, right!
m200574.別に、反省はしないけれど……。\nアタシはもう、この件からは手を引くわ。:
I'm not exactly filled with remorse, though……
I'm done with this whole mess.
I'm washing my hands of it.
m200574.別に、放っておいていいだろう。\nしばらくは大人しくしていると思うしな。:
Leave her be.
I think she'll keep to herself for a while.
m200574.別に、雪枝の仲間の目に触れなけりゃ構わねぇよ。: As long as the Yukieda folk don't see it, I don't care.
m200574.別に感謝されるようなことはしていないぞ。\nただ、王国の祭りを手伝うように言われ:
Don't thank us for anything.
We were just told to help with the kingdom's festival, so
Martan and the others are just doing as we were told.
m200574.別に里が滅ぼされるとかじゃないんだから、\nそれくらい受け入れるべきだとマータン:
It's not like the village is going to be destroyed or anything!
Martan thinks they should just accept it!
m200574.十分だとか関係ねぇよ。\nこんなことをやるって決めた以上、\n俺らは最後まで走る:
It has nothing to do with being done.
Now that we've decided to do this,
we have to see it through to the end.
m200574.南は悪しき者らの里、姿を見せてはならぬ。\nそれが雪枝の里の教えだからな。:
The south is a village of wicked ones, and we must not show ourselves.
That is the teaching of Snow Branch Village.
m200574.去年、雪枝で開かれた祭りじゃ花火は上がらなかったが、\n万が一目を奪われたら困る:
No fireworks were launched at the festival in Yukieda last year, but
if they manage to steal the show, we'll have a problem.
m200574.友たちと、永く歩むことができるように――: So that we can walk this path together with our friends, for a long time to come――
m200574.変わり果ててしまったものは、\n受け入れて、進むしかないんだよ。:
You have to accept what has changed,
and keep going.
m200574.変わることが嫌、か。\nその気持ちは分かる気がするが……。:
Hating change, huh.
I think I can understand that feeling, but...
m200574.外のことさえ知らなけりゃ、\nいつまでも、いつもどおりの雪枝の里でいられるからな:
As long as they don't know what's out there,
Yukieda Village can stay just the same, forever.
m200574.夜空に咲く大輪が、笑い合う人々の姿が。\n……あの陰陽師の憎たらしい横顔が。:
The great blossoms blooming in the night sky, the smiling faces of the people.
……And that Onmyoji's annoying profile.
m200574.妖怪……！？ まさか、クダギツネの仲間か！？: A Yokai……!? Could it be one of Kudagitsune's allies!?
m200574.妖怪なんてみんなそんなものよ。\n最近の子たちはお行儀がいいみたいだけどね。:
All yokai are like that.
The younger ones seem to be better behaved these days, though.
m200574.安心できる毎日が、変わろうとしている。\nそれに無理やりにでも適応しなくちゃなら:
Our reassuring daily life is changing.
And we have to force ourselves to adapt.
Martan thinks that's the worst.
m200574.実は俺たち、大昔に祭りにまぜてもらったことがあってな。: You see, a long, long time ago, we were once invited to a festival.
m200574.対話が望める相手ではなさそうですな。\n致し方なし、妖怪退治といきましょうか。:
It doesn't look like we can reason with them.
Very well, let's proceed with the yokai hunt.
m200574.幸い、外の世界に興味があった変わり者たちも、\n祭りの準備のために来ているからな:
Luckily, there are some oddballs among us who are interested in the outside world,
and they've come to help with the festival preparations!
They'll work hard, so feel free to put them to use!
m200574.待て！ お前、逃げるつもりか！: Wait! Are you trying to run away?
m200574.必要な物資は十分盗めたもの。\nこれ以上ここに留まる意味はないわ。:
I've stolen all the supplies I need.
There's no point in staying here any longer.
m200574.意味、ねぇ……。\nそれはお前が一番分かってるんじゃないのか？:
Point, huh…….
You're the one who understands that best, don't you?
m200574.我ながら乱暴だと思うし、ダセェと思うし、\nあんたらに迷惑をかけて悪いとは思うよ:
I know it's crude. I know it's tacky.
And I feel bad for causing you all this trouble.
But I'd be in trouble if you found the Kingdom's summer festival interesting.
m200574.手を貸すのはいい。けど里の暮らしに踏み込まれたくない。\nいつもの日々の中に別の:
Lending a hand is fine. But you don't want the village's way of life to be interfered with.
Having something else intrude into your usual days is…… unpleasant.
m200574.打ち上げは必ず行うわ。\nアタシたちの夏祭りには、不可欠だから。:
We absolutely have to launch them.
They're essential to our summer festival.
m200574.承知しました。\nあれはもう……終わらせてあげましょう。:
Understood.
It is time to…… let her rest.
m200574.改めて夏祭りやるとき、里で打ち上げられる花火は、\n王国の花火なんじゃなくて、雪:
When we hold the summer festival again, the fireworks we launch in the village
won't be the kingdom's fireworks. They'll be Snow Branch's fireworks.
m200574.来年……は無理かもだが、\nまた必ず、里で夏祭りをやるからな！:
Next year…… might be a stretch,
but I'll definitely hold a summer festival in the village again!
m200574.東の国を真似てはじまったこの夏祭りが、\n王国の夏祭りとして受け入れられてるから:
Is it because this summer festival, which started by imitating the Eastern Kingdom,
has been accepted as the kingdom's summer festival?
m200574.模擬戦をしてから、明らかに空気が変わりましたな。: The atmosphere has clearly changed since the sparring match.
m200574.毎年毎年、トラブルが続きますなぁ……。: Year after year, the trouble just keeps coming…….
m200574.済んでなんかねぇよ。\nだけどもう、指一本動かせねぇからなぁ……。:
I'm not satisfied at all.
But I can't even move a single finger anymore, so…
m200574.渋々な連中の嫌な気持ちが広がって、\n空気が悪くなってるみたいだな！: The resentment of the reluctant ones is spreading, and it's making the atmosphere pretty tense!
m200574.王国と里の親睦を深める、か。\n結果だけを見ると大成功だったのかもな。:
Deepening the bond between the Kingdom and the village, huh.
Looking at the results, it might just have been a resounding success.
m200574.王国の王子は雪原王だ。\n加えてあんたらには里を助けてもらった恩義もある。:
The Kingdom's Prince is the Snowfield King.
Plus, you helped the village, so we owe you a debt of gratitude.
m200574.知らないのなら結構。\n面白い話ではありませんからな。:
If you don't, then that's fine.
It's not a very interesting story, anyway.
m200574.確か、王国との親睦を深めるためでしたかな。\nそれで里の者たちがこちらに派遣され:
I believe it was to strengthen ties with the kingdom.
I was told that people from the village were sent here for that purpose, but……
m200574.確かにやってることとか、ここにいる人とか、\nそういうのは俺たちの祭りのそれとは:
Sure, the activities and the people here
are completely different from our old festival.
m200574.祭りの準備なんてしてる場合じゃねェ！\nお前ら武器を持てェーッ！！:
There's no time for festival prep right now!
Grab your weapons, you lot!!
m200574.程度はどうあれ、自分たちの日常が変わるというのは、\nとても嫌だし……怖いことだ:
Regardless of the degree, the idea of one's daily life changing is...
very unpleasant. And rather frightening.
m200574.素直にごめんなさいして降参するつもりはないみたいだな。: It seems you have no intention of apologizing and surrendering.
m200574.罠の可能性が高いからな。\n十分注意して進むとしよう。:
It's likely a trap.
We should proceed with extreme caution.
m200574.聞いたときはやばいと思ったが、\nいざやってみると楽しいな！:
I was worried when I first heard about it,
but it's actually a blast!
m200574.職人の皆さんが頑張ってくれたみたいですぞ。\nまったく、頭が下がりますなぁ。:
It appears the craftsmen worked very hard.
I am truly in awe of them.
m200574.花火を手に取った……！？\n貴様、なにをやるつもりだ！？: You've taken the fireworks…!? What are you planning to do!?
m200574.覚悟しておけ、頭の固い雪枝の仲間め！\nそのカチコチの頭をばこーんってして、\n:
Prepare yourselves, you stubborn Yukieda villagers!
I'm going to knock that rigid thinking out of your heads,
and Martan-sama will gently work the kinks out of them for you!
m200574.覚悟しろよ、ボッコボコのギッタギタの、\nぐちゃどろばこーんにしてやるからな。:
Brace yourself, because I'm going to beat you into a pulp.
A complete, total mess.
m200574.言い負かされてどうするんだ！\nいやまぁ、デリケートな話だとは思うが……！:
What are you going to do, just let them win the argument!
I mean, it's a delicate subject, but……!
m200574.言葉で語り合うより、剣で語り合うほうが、\n相手のことを深く理解できるからな。:
Talking with swords helps you understand each other better
than talking with words, you know.
m200574.説得は、難しそうですな。: Persuading them is going to be difficult.
m200574.誰だって生きてたら大変な目に遭うものだろう。: Anyone who's alive is bound to run into trouble.
m200574.質問だが、それは里長――オヴィーにも\n反発している連中ということか？: A question, but does that mean they're also opposed to the village chief, Ovie?
m200574.返り討ちにはできたが、\nクダギツネと雪枝の者たちは逃してしまったな。:
We managed to turn the tables on them,
but Kudagitsune and the Yukieda villagers got away.
m200574.追ってきたか、王国軍。\nそれから……。:
The Kingdom's army has followed us, has it.
And then……
m200574.過去に囚われた亡霊は、\nそうすることでしか進めないのですから。:
A ghost imprisoned in the past
can only move forward by doing so.
m200574.里のみんなは責任を果たしただけだ。\nだから感謝されるわけにはいかない。:
The villagers simply did their duty.
There's no need to thank us for that.
m200574.里の仲間たちが悪さをしているのなら――: If my fellow villagers are up to no good—
m200574.里の祭りは越冬祭りだけだ。\n夏祭りなんてもんはねぇ。:
We only have the Winter Festival in the village.
There's no such thing as a summer festival.
m200574.長は外の世界に歩み寄る方針だからな。\nどうにも反りが合わなかったんだろう。:
The chief has been trying to reach out to the outside world.
I suppose they just didn't see eye to eye.
m200574.開くのはアタシたちの夏祭りよ。\n今回のは、妖怪たちの祭りではないわ。:
We are holding our summer festival.
This one isn't a festival for the yokai.
m200574.雪枝の戦士がこれくらいで根を上げるわけないだろ！\n身動きひとつできなくても、気:
A warrior of Snow Branch isn't going to give up over something like this!
Even if they can't move a muscle, they can work with sheer willpower!
m200574.雪枝の戦士たちよ！\nなぜお前たちはこんなことをするんだ！\n王国の祭りをめちゃ:
Warriors of Yukieda!
Why are you doing this!
What's the point of wrecking the Kingdom's festival!?
m200574.雪枝の里……マータンたちの里は、\n王国と協力していく感じになっている。\nただ:
Snow Branch Village…… our village is in a state of
cooperation with the kingdom.
But not everyone in the village is on board with it.
m200574.雪枝の里にはないものだからな。\nマータンも前に王国の祭りに招かれたときに、\n:
Snow Branch Village doesn't have them.
I only learned they existed when I was invited to a kingdom festival before.
m200574.雪枝の里に夏祭りはないから、って。: That there is no such thing as a summer festival in Yukieda Village.
m200574.雪枝の里の、マータンより頭が固いやつら。\nそのリーダー格のやつも、里から姿を消:
The stubborn ones in Yukieda, the ones even more rigid than Martan.
Their leader has also been missing from the village for a while.
I was wondering if that person is the one behind all this.
m200574.雪枝の里の景色は、これからどんどん変わっていくだろう。\nでも、里そのものはあん:
The scenery of Snow Branch Village will probably change a lot from now on.
But the village itself won't change much.
m200574.雪枝の里はいいところだ。\nみんな見知った顔で、穏やかないつもが続いていく。:
Snow Branch Village is a good place.
Everyone is a familiar face, and the peace just continues.
m200574.雰囲気が明るくなったというか、なんというか……。\nもしかして、模擬戦はあらゆる:
It's gotten brighter, or something…
Could it be that sparring matches solve all problems…?
m200574.頭でっかちが……！\n別にいいだろ、夏祭りが里に入ってきても！\n雪枝の日々はな:
You're being stubborn……
It doesn't matter! Even if the summer festival reaches the village!
Nothing will change in Yukieda!
m200574.駄目にする方法が分からなかったもんでね。\nちょうど今、池に沈めるのを思いついた:
I couldn't figure out a way to ruin them.
I just got the idea to sink them in the pond.
m200574.駄目よ、行かせないわ。: No. I won't let you through.
m200574.（雪枝の夏祭りは、上手くいかなかったからな……）: (The summer festival in Snow Branch Village didn't go so well, though…)

m200581.――きゃっ！？ あの子、\n白い毛に覆われて、爪が伸びて……！:
――Kyaa! That girl…
She's covered in white fur, and her claws are growing…!
m200581.――ご武運を、とは申しません。\n閣下より先に、殿下を取らないでください。\n久:
I won't say "good luck."
Just don't take His Highness from me before I get the chance.
It has been a while since I saw such a lively expression on his face.
m200581.――その卓に、私の席もご用意いただけますか？: ――May I have a seat at that table as well?
m200581.――というわけで、まとめますね。\n量産型ヴィマーナは全機沈黙を確認しました。:
—So, to summarize.
We've confirmed that all the mass-produced Vimanas have gone silent.
m200581.――ふはははははッ！！\n久しいな、王子よ！ 我が友よ！:
――Fuhahahaha!!
It has been a while, Prince! My friend!
m200581.――まぁそれはそれ。: ――Well, that's a story for another time.
m200581.――フゥハハハハー！！\n待たせたな、我が友よ！！:
—Fuuhaahahaha!!
I've kept you waiting, my friend!!
m200581.――停戦の会議とは、聞いて呆れる。\nラージヴィール、アナーニャ。\n貴様らを反:
Noble Council Member?: ――A ceasefire meeting? How preposterous.
Rajvir, Ananya.
I hereby impeach you as traitors.

Are you here to pull off another shady deal?!
m200581.んっ……うわっ、計器が振り切れてる！\n一個一個は小さいけど、すごい数の――\n:
Hnn… Whoa, the gauges are maxing out!
Each one is small, but there are so many of them――
It's like there are tiny Vimanas out there…
m200581.アナーニャ様。私はただの従者です。: Lady Ananya. I am merely a servant.
m200581.キャスパリーグです。\n猫の魔物さんたちを連れて、\n里をとび出て行ってしまって:
Caspar.
He took the cat monsters with him
and ran away from the village.
m200581.ニハラ、その顔だ。\n貴様は昔から、我が来ると、その顔をする。\n実に父親冥利に:
Nihara, that look on your face.
You've always done that when I arrive.
It truly makes your late father proud!
m200581.ニハラちゃん、すごい。\nあたし、全然分かんなかったよ。:
Nihara-chan, that's amazing.
I couldn't sense a thing.
m200581.ニハラよ、貴様はそのまま王子に付け。: Nihara, you stay with the Prince.
m200581.ラージヴィールは先に戻ったんだよね。\n道案内の人って、いつ来るんだろう。:
Rajivir already left to get ahead of us.
Do you think our guide will show up soon?
m200581.ラージヴィール家の随員として登録すれば入れますよ。\nあの方が、何度もそうしよう:
She could enter if she were registered as an attendant of the Rajivir household.
I'm sure he's tried to do that more than once, hasn't he?
m200581.一日だけ王国に出向、ってことでどう？\nラージヴィールも、反対はしないと思うよ。:
How about a one-day assignment to the Kingdom?
I don't think Rajivir would object to that.
m200581.人型の獣……？\n遊びの相手ってのは、こういう意味かよ！:
A beast in human form…?
So that's what a "playmate" means, huh!
m200581.今のところは落ち着いてて何よりだけど、\nこれ、暴れ出したら大変なことになるんじ:
It's good that they're calm for now, but
if they start causing a ruckus, things are going to get bad…
m200581.仕切ってるのは私。集めたのは、真ん中で寝てる子。\n……あの子が起きる前に、みん:
I'm the one keeping things in order. The one who gathered them is the one sleeping in the middle.
……I hope everyone gets tired of playing before she wakes up.
m200581.休館日は動いていいって約束だからね。\nでも猫が暴れ出したら、展示室が――:
Right, the exhibits are allowed to move on closed days.
But if the cats start rampaging, the exhibition hall will――
m200581.何がお初にだ。\n貴様、どうせ抜け駆けして\n勝手に王国と商談を進めているのだろ:
What do you mean "pleasure to meet you"?
You've no doubt been cutting in line
and pushing trade talks with the Kingdom on your own.
m200581.作戦も近いので、私は行きます。: The battle plan is nearly ready, so I shall go.
m200581.例外規定を用います。\n天眼の血に匹敵する実力を持つものは、\n同等の権利を認め:
We will invoke an exception clause.
Those who possess power equivalent to the blood of the Heavenly Eye
are granted equal rights.
m200581.保証人はひとりよりふたりの方が安心でしょう？\nあなたの首ひとつ飛んだら講和交渉:
It is safer to have two guarantors than one, isn't it?
If you were to lose your head, the peace negotiations would be over,
which would certainly not be worth the investment.
m200581.先の戦闘の結果と、議員ふたりが保証人になります。\n私とラージヴィールですね。:
The results of our previous battle, along with two members of the assembly as guarantors.
That would be me and Rajivir.
m200581.去れ。貴族院の犬よ。\n貴様らの神は、もう貴様らのものではない。:
Leave. You dogs of the Noble Council.
Your god is no longer yours.
m200581.可愛い娘には旅をさせろ、だ。\nニハラ、貴様は世界一可愛い娘だからな！:
A cute girl should be allowed to travel.
Nihara, you're the cutest girl in the world!
m200581.呪術師ども、神の目覚めを守れ。\n異端者どもに、滅びの慈悲を――:
Sorcerers, defend the awakening of the gods!
Let the heretics taste the mercy of annihilation—
m200581.問答は無用だ。\n異端者と、それに与する者に、滅びの慈悲を。:
No need for debate.
Let the mercy of destruction befall the heretics and their accomplices.
m200581.問題は、これを誰が管理するかだな。\n王国が持ち帰れば、貴族院に格好の口実を与え:
The issue is who will take control of this.
If the Kingdom brings it back, it will give the Noble Council a perfect excuse.
m200581.喜ばないでください。\n私の領地の税収が、戦火で減るかもしれないのに。:
Please don't be so cheerful.
My territory's tax revenue might suffer because of the war.
m200581.四方全てが敵、という状況からは脱したわけだ。\nさて、何から手を付けるべきか――:
We've escaped the situation where all four sides were our enemies.
Now then, where should we start—
m200581.壊れそうな物の前では、遊ばせてないよ。\n猫様は、遊びの途中で止められるのが一番:
I don't let them play in front of anything that looks fragile.
The Cat Lords hate nothing more than having their fun interrupted.
m200581.夜の街で、猫様の群れが博物館に向かってたの。\n群れを止めるのは無理だから、\n:
I saw the Cat Lords' swarm heading toward the museum in the night.
Since I couldn't stop the whole group,
I decided to let them play inside.
m200581.天眼ノ国と王国の共同管理を提案します。\nどちらか一方が持てば、必ず争いの種にな:
I propose joint management between the Heavenly Eye Nation and the Kingdom.
If either side possesses it alone, it will inevitably become a source of conflict.
m200581.天眼ノ国の全てとはいかないけれど、\nそれだけの貴族を味方につけたなら、\n実効:
It may not be the entire Heavenly Eye Kingdom,
but if we have that many nobles on our side,
we can push forward a peace conference with real force.
m200581.天眼ノ国の都は、貴族院が全てを取り仕切ります。\n議事堂で発言できるのは、天なる:
The capital of the Heavenly Eye Kingdom is run entirely by the House of Nobles.
Only those who possess the Heavenly Eye may speak in the assembly hall.
m200581.安心なさい。天眼の民はおおむね、頭の回る者ばかり。\nより正しく利益のある方を選:
Rest assured. The people of the Heavenly Eye are, for the most part, quite sharp.
They should choose the option that is more correct and beneficial.
For the most part. Probably. Somewhat.
m200581.展示室で模擬戦は駄目だ……絶対に駄目だ……！\n…………（くらっ）:
No sparring in the exhibit hall…… Absolutely not……!
…………(wham)
m200581.引きずり出したというか、閣下が議事堂で\n一晩中どなり続けただけなんですけどね…:
I suppose "dragged" is a bit strong.
His Excellency just kept yelling in the Council Hall all night, you see…
m200581.当然でしょ。展示物も猫様も可愛いのに、\nどっちかが壊れるなんて嫌じゃん。:
Of course. Both the exhibits and the Cat Lords are cute, so
I wouldn't want either of them to get broken.
m200581.心配なら、心配だと言えばいいのに。\n本当に、似た者親子ですね。:
If you're worried, just say so.
You really are like your father.
m200581.愚直、なのかも？\nちょっと王子に似てるかな。:
Maybe he's just... earnest?
He's a bit like the Prince, in a way.
m200581.我が臣下どもが、貴様の強さを疑っておる。\nゆえに、我が軍勢をもって貴様を試すッ:
My subjects doubt your strength.
Therefore, I shall test you with my full army!!
m200581.手加減しながら、猫の群れと猫耳の相手か……。\n上等だ。王子、静かに、丁寧にいく:
Going easy on a swarm of cats and a cat-eared girl……
Fine. Prince, let's do this quietly and carefully!
m200581.手間を掛けたな、王子よ。\nだがこれで、我が領は全面的に講和を推進できるぞ。:
You spared no effort, Prince.
With this, my domain can fully push for peace.
m200581.捕まりたいなら寝ててもいいよ！: If you want to get caught, you can just sleep!
m200581.改めまして、ノヴァリスだよ。\n最高に可愛い、猫様の獣人！:
Let me introduce myself properly. I'm Novalis.
The cutest beastkin of the Cat Lords!
m200581.散歩ですよ。このあたりには王国軍の砦があるでしょう？\n少し前から、何度か通って:
Just taking a walk. There's a Kingdom fortress nearby, isn't there?
I've been passing through this area a few times recently.
I've moved past just being acquainted with the Prince. We're on quite good terms now.
m200581.暗部です。貴族院直属の刺客。\n表の歴史には、一度も名前が出たことがありません。:
They are the Shadow. Assassins under the direct command of the Noble Council.
Their names have never appeared in the official history.
m200581.朝っぱらから騒がしいのが……。: To be so loud this early in the morning…….
m200581.朝早くから、ご苦労なことですね。: ???: You're up early. I hope you're not overworking yourself.
m200581.本格的な講和交渉が始まる前に接触を……？\n貴族院は――閣下は、そのことをご存知:
Making contact before the formal peace negotiations begin……?
Does the House of Nobles——does My Lord——know about this?
m200581.構わぬ。\n我が領と、この女狐の領は、王国と停戦協定を結ぶ！:
I do not care.
My domain and this vixen's domain will sign a ceasefire agreement with the Kingdom!
m200581.歓迎の顔ではないな。\nここでの王国は、まだ「神を砕いた異端者」だ。:
They don't look very welcoming.
In this kingdom, we are still seen as "heretics who shattered the gods."
m200581.残骸を回収して、何をする気だ……？\n一応覚えておこう。:
What do they intend to do with the wreckage……?
I'd better keep that in mind.
m200581.殿下、こちらへ。議事堂までは私が先導します。: Your Highness, this way. I will lead you to the Council Hall.
m200581.殿下。後方に気配が。\n数は……十、いえ、もっと。:
Your Highness. There's a presence behind us.
The number is… ten. No, more than that.
m200581.決まり。最高に可愛い私を、\nこれからよろしくね、王子様♪:
It's a deal. Take care of the cutest girl around,
from now on, Prince♪
m200581.爆発する湯沸かし器……。\n王子さま、それはそれで研究したい！:
An exploding water heater…….
Prince, I actually want to study that!
m200581.爆発する湯沸かし器とか、\n元はまったく別の用途だったんだろうな……。:
An exploding water heater…….
It must have originally been designed for a completely different purpose.
m200581.獣に変じる獣人……！\n文献でしか読んだことがない……本物だ……！:
A beastkin who can shift into a beast…!
I've only read about them in books… This is real…!
m200581.獣の血をひく者たち、天なる使いと称される者たち、\nそれから――空を統べるドラゴ:
Those who carry the blood of beasts, those called the Heavenly Messengers,
and then—the nation of dragons that rule the skies…
m200581.王国の随員ですよ。異界の客人の連れに、\n貴族院が口を出す法はありません。:
She is a member of the Kingdom's retinue.
The Noble Council has no authority to interfere with the entourage of a guest from another world.
m200581.王子、明日の会談の資料はこれで揃いました。\n……天眼ノ国の都に、いよいよ乗り込:
Prince, the materials for tomorrow's conference are all ready.
……It seems we're finally heading into the capital of the Heavenly Eye Kingdom.
m200581.王子よ。ここは我が兵で殿を務め、退路を開く。\n貴様らは荒野へ退き、暗部を引きつ:
Prince. My soldiers will cover the rear and open a path.
You retreat into the wilderness and draw the Shadow out to strike them down.
m200581.王子ー！ 見てください、この遺物！\nつやつやで卵型で、絶対すごいやつですよー！:
Prince! Look at this relic!
It's shiny and egg-shaped. It has to be something amazing!
m200581.王子様、あの子たちは遊んでいるだけです。\nどうか、手加減を……！:
Prince, they're just playing.
Please, go easy on them……!
m200581.王子殿下、小型ヴィマーナが目覚めます。\nここで、講和の値付けを跳ね上げてやりま:
Your Highness, the small vimanas are awakening.
Let's use this to raise the price of our peace proposal.
m200581.王子殿下との秘密会談のあとすぐに。\n賭けは絶対に勝てるもの以外、\n手を出して:
Immediately after the secret talks with Your Highness.
One must never bet on anything that isn't guaranteed to win.
m200581.王子殿下は、面白い方ですよ。\nあなたも、間近で見れば分かります。:
Your Highness is quite the interesting one.
You'll see for yourself once you get a closer look.
m200581.砕けたヴィマーナの残骸を運ぶ荷車を、幾つも。\n貴族院の紋を付けた者たちが、夜中:
Several carts carrying the wreckage of a shattered vimana.
They were marked with the House of Nobles' crest, and it was in the dead of night.
m200581.神を砕いた異端者を、この都の中央に入れるとはな。\nおまけに、人間の小娘まで連れ:
Noble Council Member?: Allowing heretics who shattered the gods into the heart of this capital.
And you even brought along a human girl.
m200581.私が前に出ます。\n閣下の命ですから。――殿下、ご指示はおまかせします。:
I will take the front.
It is Your Highness's command. ――Your Highness, I leave the orders to you.
m200581.私は従者です。\n閣下の後ろで見ていれば、それで十分です。:
I am merely an attendant.
Watching from behind His Excellency is all I need.
m200581.私も同行しますよ。\nニハラちゃんのことはお任せあれ。:
I'll be coming along too.
Leave Nihara-chan to me.
m200581.私を巻き込まないでください。\nでも――はい、私もそう思います。:
Please don't drag me into this.
But—yes, I agree with you.
m200581.端的に言おう！\n面倒なのは嫌いなのでな！:
Let me be brief!
I dislike unnecessary trouble!
m200581.臣下の方々に、王子殿下の武威を示すためです。\nヴィマーナを砕いた話も、\n見て:
It is to demonstrate the Prince's martial prowess to the subjects.
The story of him shattering a vimana
is nothing but a rumor to those who did not see it.
m200581.街は臣下どもに任せた！\n我が友の戦場に、我がおらぬなど許されぬ！:
I've left the city in my subjects' hands!
I cannot allow myself to be absent from my friend's battlefield!
m200581.見ての通り、猫様たちの遊び相手。\nほら、この子見て？\n傘の先を追いかけるの、:
???: As you can see, I'm the playmate for the Cat Lords.
Look at this one, see?
She's really good at chasing the tip of the umbrella, right?
m200581.見るがいい。砕かれた神は、我らの手で蘇った。\nひとつではなく、数多の群体神とし:
Behold. The shattered god has been resurrected by our hands.
Not as one, but as a multitude of collective deities.
m200581.親子では、ありません。従者です。: I am not his daughter. I am his servant.
m200581.言うではないか、女狐め！\n王子よ、また会おう！ 貴族院の連中に負けるでないぞ！:
Well spoken, you fox!
Prince, until we meet again! Do not let the Noble Council get the better of you!
m200581.言うな。\nうちの王子がわくわくを隠しきれてないのがバレる。:
Don't say that.
It's obvious our Prince can't hide his excitement.
m200581.警備の方からの報告では、\n休館日の夜に、\n館内から猫の鳴き声が響いていると…:
According to the security report,
on the night the museum is closed,
meowing sounds have been echoing from inside the building…
m200581.貴族院議員の娘だぞ。\n交渉団に同行する連絡役としては最上だろう。:
She's the daughter of a senator.
She'd be the perfect liaison to accompany the negotiating team.
m200581.貴様が王国軍と共にある限り、\n我が家が講和派である証は、誰の目にも明らかとなる:
As long as you are with the Royal Army,
it will be clear to everyone that our house is the peace faction.
You may refuse to accept it, but a daughter is a daughter, even by obligation.
m200581.賢明ですね。私も、あなたを見なかったことにしましょう。\n閣下のお披露目が終わっ:
Wise decision. I shall pretend I never saw you.
Once His Excellency's debut is over, I will join you at the table.
m200581.遊び疲れたら、猫様は勝手に帰る。\nそれが一番、誰も傷つかない終わり方だからね。:
Once they're tired from playing, the Cat Lords will go home on their own.
That's the best way to end this without anyone getting hurt.
m200581.遊び相手って……おい、まさか。\n猫をここに集めて、仕切ってるのはお前か！？:
"Playmate"… Hey, no way.
You're the one who gathered these cats here and is running the show, aren't you!?
m200581.量産型の神像兵器……？\nそれを、講和会議の裏で準備してたんだ。\nだからラージ:
Mass-produced god statues as weapons…?
They were preparing that behind the scenes of the peace conference.
That's why they rejected Rajiv's proposal.
m200581.閣下、お下がりください。私が前に出ます。: Your Excellency, please step back. I will take the front.
m200581.閣下、街は……って、聞くだけ無駄ですね。: Your Excellency, the city is… well, no point in even asking.
m200581.閣下のお側で、長く戦ってきましたから。\nあの人、周囲に煙たがられて\nよく暗殺:
I've fought by Your Highness's side for a long time.
That man is often resented by those around him,
so he sends assassins after him frequently.
m200581.閣下は、ずっと反対しておられました。\n貴族院が耳を貸さなかっただけで。:
Your Highness was always opposed to it.
The House of Nobles simply refused to listen.
m200581.閣下は、王国は負けぬと。\nそれだけは、ご自分が保証するとおっしゃいました。:
My Lord said the Kingdom will not lose.
He personally guaranteed that much.
m200581.閣下！ 新型の魔眼が！\n議事堂の外からこちらへ！:
Your Excellency! A new type of Magic Eye!
Coming from outside the Council Hall!
m200581.震えていません。\n都の中央に入るのは\n私も初めてなので、警戒しているだけです:
They are not.
It is simply that I am on high alert,
as this is my first time entering the heart of the capital.
m200581.馬鹿な……神が、再び、砕かれた……？: Foolish… the god has been shattered… again?
m200581.鳴き声どころじゃねぇな、これ。\n見ろよ、床一面、猫、猫、猫だ。最高かよ。:
This is way beyond just meowing.
Look at this. The floor is covered in cats. Cats, cats, cats. This is awesome.
m200581.（……考えることはどこも同じ。\nラージヴィール殿をここへ呼び出したのも、実際は:
(...Everyone thinks the same thing.
Calling Rajvir here was actually the Prince's idea
to create an opening for peace negotiations.)
m200581.（そういう言い方しか\nできないんだよなぁ、うちの閣下は）:
(That's the only way
our Excellency knows how to say it, isn't it)
m200581.（今後ともご贔屓にお願いしますね？）: (We look forward to your continued patronage?)
m200581.（誰が言ったのだったか、王子は戦時の王ではなく、\n平和な時代の王の器であると）:
(Someone once said that the Prince is not a king for war,
but a king for times of peace.)
m200581.（閣下ですね。真面目なときの）: (That's the look he gets when he's being serious.)

m300243.――お、王子っ、大変です！\nプリンセスの皆さんが、\nゴブリンクイーンに操られ: Prince! This is terrible! The princesses are being controlled by the Goblin Queen…!!
m300243.――くっ、この洗脳装置では足りナイカ！\nやはりマダマダ改良が必要だナ……！: Damn, this brain-washing device isn't enough! I still need to keep improving it…!
m300243.――こ、これが！\n噂に聞くプリンセスのお茶会ですのね！: So… this is it! The princess's tea party I've heard rumors about!
m300243.――この世界を一度終わらせるか否か、\nそれを見極める段階に来たと判断したまでの: —have decided it's time to determine whether to end this world once and for all.
m300243.――ごめんなさい、王子。\nこれ以上は、もう……っ。: I'm sorry, Prince. I can't… go any further…
m300243.――その剣技、まさしく英雄王の系譜。\n潮流、水底の音、母なる海の愛を知らぬ者よ: —That swordsmanship truly follows the lineage of the Hero King. Those who know not the tides, the sounds of the deep, the love of Mother Sea—your skill seems genuine.
m300243.――ちっ、シノ！ あんた手を抜いたな！？\nわざと勝ちを譲られても意味がないんだ:
—Tch, Shino! You held back, didn't you!?
Even if you let me win on purpose, it means nothing!
m300243.――なるほど、あれが王国軍か。\n英雄王の系譜が、この時代にまで残っているとはな: ???: I see, so that's the Kingdom's army. The lineage of the Hero King still persists into this age, huh. No wonder the expedition we left on the beach the other day fled in defeat.
m300243.――はい、それでは本日のメインイベント、\n王国軍レース大会です！ 実況は私ステ: ――Alright, now for today's main event, the Kingdom Army Race Tournament! I'll be your commentator, Stella, and our sharp-analyzed Prince will provide the analysis!
m300243.――はい、満員御礼、拍手喝采万々歳♪\nそれじゃあ第２回～？:
—Yes, sold out, thunderous applause, hooray♪
Now, the second round—?
m300243.――はっ、ゴール！ ゴールです！\nえっと、い、一位は誰だったんでしょうか？: —Ha, the finish! It's the finish line! Um, who took first place?
m300243.――はっ！\n我らが深海の王よ！: —Ha! We are the Deep Sea King!
m300243.――ほう？ しかしあなたからも、\n私と同じぬらりひょんの血筋を感じます。\nな:
—Is that so? Yet I sense the same Nyaruhyon bloodline in you.
