to launch ambushes.
I'm so glad you're safe.
m320390.メカゴブリンクイーン様が、\n異世界の娘……サテラ殿を食客として迎えたノダが……: The Mecha Goblin Queen has taken in a daughter from another world… Lady Satella, as her guest…
m320390.ランスよ、貴様が優れた戦士であることは分かった。\n我が配下となれば、\n物質界:
Not my problem.
I don't answer to anyone.
Besides, I just don't like you.
m320390.ランス様、呪縛霊になっちゃったそうです。: It seems His Highness Lance has become a bound spirit.
m320390.ランス様！ ここは！ 異世界なので！: Rance-sama! This is a different world!
m320390.ランス様！？\nランス様が幽霊に！？:
Rance-sama?!
Rance-sama has become a ghost?!
m320390.ルキファさんが以前に行って戻ってきた実例ですし、\n今回は魔力潤沢な仲間もいます:
Lukifer went there and came back before,
and we have plenty of powerful allies this time.
Plus, Grimm-chan is coming along. Yaaay.
m320390.万の軍勢を従え、如何なる危機にも怯まず、\nあらゆるものを砕く精強なる者、\nこ: A warrior worthy of this new flesh……
m320390.人畜無害なランスね……。\nこれはこれで新鮮かも？:
Harmless Lance, huh…
Maybe this is a refreshing change?
m320390.今、王国の魔術師が、\n転移による魔力の痕跡をたどっています。\nきっと、もう少:
The kingdom's mages are currently tracking the magical residue from the teleportation.
We should be able to locate the others soon.
m320390.今のランスじゃ怖くも何ともないけどね？: I don't think he's scared of us right now, though?
m320390.代わりに、シィルちゃんの近くからは\n離れることができなくなっているけど。: The trade-off, however, is that she can no longer stray too far from you.
m320390.以来、ワタクシに、\nガーディアンの技術を用いた\n「ゴブリンガーディアン」を開: Ever since, she has been demanding that I develop a “Goblin Guardian” using Guardian technology…!
m320390.何が私からなのよ！？\nはぁ……それでグリム、\nこいつを元に戻すいい考えって？:
What do you mean, "with me first"!?
Sigh…… So, Grimm,
do you have a good plan to restore him?
m320390.何にせよ、この辺りには魔物が出ますし、\nその少女……たち？ を保護しにいきまし:
Whatever the case, monsters are active in this area.
Let's go check on those girls…… or whatever they are.
m320390.何をやるつもりなのかは分からぬが、\n実力は確かだとお見受けする。\nしからば、:
I do not know what you intend to do,
but I can tell you are a force to be reckoned with.
Then, I shall press ahead.
m320390.何を言っとるか！（ぽかっ）\nお前も否定せんか！（ぽかっ）:
What are you talking about! (poked)
Don't you deny it too! (poked)
m320390.俺様の肉体が奪われた時、\nかなみも一緒にいただろーが！: You were with me when my body was stolen!
m320390.俺様はスーパーな男だ。\nスーパーな欲望を、お前ごときが制御できるものか。:
I'm a super guy.
You can't control super desires like mine.
m320390.出来たらもう触っている。: If I could, I would have touched you already.
m320390.助けていただき、ありがとうございました。\nまさかシィルさんに化けるモンスターが:
Thank you for the rescue.
I never would have guessed a monster could impersonate Sill.
m320390.厄介なヤツだな……。\n受け止めずに全力で殴れ、ってことか？:
What a pain…
So we just hit him as hard as we can without trying to block?
m320390.問題は、サテラ殿がガーディアンナル\n強力なゴーレムの一種を所持していたコト……: The problem is that Lady Satella possessed a Guardian Nar… a powerful type of golem…
m320390.大変です、何かものすごい数の魔力反応が、\n王国の方へ向けて移動中みたいです！:
It's serious. I'm detecting a massive number of magical reactions
moving toward the kingdom!
m320390.嫌よ！ っていうか自分で考えなさいよ魔女でしょ！: No way! Besides, figure it out yourself, you're a witch, aren't you!
m320390.実験台にされそうなのに、留まるはずないわよ。\nはぁ……ランスたちはいったいどこ:
I'm about to be turned into a guinea pig, so of course I'm not staying.
Haa…… where on earth are the Lances――
m320390.後は元の世界に帰るだけ、か。\n……どうやって帰る？:
Since this is the interstice between dimensions,
it should be easier to create a gate back to our world
than to connect the two worlds.
m320390.意志ある魔剣を持つとは……。\nやはりこの肉体は、一級品の戦士であったか。:
To possess a sword with a will of its own……
So this vessel truly was a warrior of the highest caliber.
m320390.我が栄光の時代を取り戻すのだ……！\nガハハハハッ！:
I will reclaim my age of glory…!
Gahahahaha!
m320390.敵の配置は、\nまるで防衛準備を整えているかのようでした。\nということは、最も:
The enemy's formation……
It looks as if they've prepared for a full-scale defense.
Which means they must have taken up position in the most fortified place……
m320390.本来、客人として遇するべきなのですが、\n今はどうか、お力をお貸しください。:
Normally, we should treat you as honored guests,
but for now, please lend us your strength.
m320390.次元の狭間、というそうね。\nいわばどこでもない場所、かしら？:
They call it the space between dimensions.
It's a place that is nowhere, I suppose?
m320390.正体不明の軍勢が、\n王国に向けて進軍中とのこと！:
An unidentified army
is marching toward the kingdom!
m320390.無理やり召喚されたんだから、\n倒して言うことを聞かせるしかないでしょ。: Wha……? I was supposed to summon a warrior named Rance…….
m320390.王国の忍者さんたちもお元気で！: Give my regards to the kingdom's ninjas, too!
m320390.王子、ここなら魔神セーレの強制転移も効かないです。\nでも物体を引き寄せる力は\:
Alright, let's go, Prince.
I'm going to beat him to a pulp!
m320390.王子、このままでは王国の民が危険です。: Prince, the people of the kingdom are in danger if we keep going like this.
m320390.王子、どうやらピンク髪の少女は\nドッペルゲンガーが化けたもののようです！\n急:
Prince, it seems those pink-haired girls
are Doppelgangers in disguise!
We need to hurry and help that one!
m320390.王子、我々も急ぎましょう。\nこのまま王都へ突入します！:
Prince, we should hurry.
Let's push straight into the capital!
m320390.王子殿下、援護いたします。\n兵の回復はお任せください。:
Your Highness, I will provide support.
Please leave the recovery of the troops to me.
m320390.王子殿下、次は国家元首同士、\n友好条約の締結を結びに来ますね。: Your Highness, next time, we'll come to sign a treaty of friendship between our heads of state.
m320390.硬くて強い、ゴブリンガーディアンfeat,サテラ！\n――発進だ！ ふははははは:
Tough and strong, Goblin Guardian feat. Satella!
—Launch! Hahahaha!
m320390.私たちも手伝います。\nランス様の肉体も、王国の方々も、\n魔神セーレの好きなよ:
We'll help too.
We won't let Demon God Seire have his way
with Lance-sama's body or the people of the kingdom.
m320390.私達はランス様の奴隷ですが、\nシィルさんは限りなく恋人に近いような？: We are Lance-sama's slaves, but Sill is… well, she's practically his lover, I suppose?
m320390.突然、こんな話をすると\n驚かれてしまうかもしれませんが……。:
I know this is a sudden and strange story,
so I imagine you must be shocked……
m320390.肉体が消える、器が消えていく……。\n我が身が滅ぶことで、この術は完成する！:
My body is gone, the vessel is dissolving……
With my destruction, this ritual will be complete!
m320390.肉体という楔が奪われた時に、\nシィルちゃんが近くにいたおかげで、\n魂が冥界に: It seems the only reason your soul wasn't dragged to the underworld when your physical anchor was taken away is that Sill was right there.
m320390.肉体と精神は密接につながっていますのよ？\n元の肉体の持ち主に引っ張られるのは当:
The body and the mind are closely linked, you know?
It's only natural that the original body's owner would be influenced.
m320390.覗き見とは趣味が悪いぞ、変態魔神。: Eavesdropping? You have terrible taste, you perverted demon god.
m320390.言うつもりがないのなら、\nこれは、身体に聞くしかなさそうだねぇ……。:
If you have no intention of telling me,
it seems I'll have to ask your body instead……
m320390.試作型でここまでやるなんて、\nサテラ、あなたの技術はなかなかのものねぇ。:
To do this much with a prototype…
Satella, your skills are truly impressive.
m320390.誰が変態か！\nくっ……この男を相手にすると、\nこちらまで引っ張られてしまう…:
Who's a pervert!
Grr… being around this man
drags me down to his level…
m320390.誰が有象無象ですって？: What was that spell……? Could it be a summoning ritual?
m320390.道化を演じるのは中々骨が折れたが……。\nその肉体、私がもらい受けるぞ！:
Playing the fool was quite a hassle, but……
I'll be taking that body for myself!
m320390.霊体、ですからね……。: Well, you are a spirit, after all……
m320390.驚きはしましたが、あなたの言葉を信じます。\n魔神にはこれまで、何度も苦戦させら:
I was surprised, but I believe you.
We've had our fair share of trouble with Great Demons in the past.
m320390.魂と身体は、もともとの組み合わせの方が\nありあわせの組み合わせよりずっと強いで:
A soul and body are far stronger when they're their original match
than when they're just thrown together.
m320390.魔力の反応的に、\nここにいるのはひとり――いえ、\nもうひとつ、濃い魔力反応が:
Judging by the magical energy reactions,
there is one person here―― no,
there is another, stronger reaction as well……
m320390.（……味方にすると心強いですが、\n敵には回したくない方ですね）:
(……She would be a reassuring ally,
but I certainly wouldn't want to cross paths with her as an enemy.)
m320390.（それはランスさんのご一行、\n全員に言えそうですよねぇ。戦力も知識も規格外です:
(I think that could be said about everyone in Lance's party.
Their power and knowledge are both off the charts!)

m400164.『援軍要請』のスキルを持つ兵士や、\n出撃コストを増加させる能力を備えたワルキュ:
I recommend adding soldiers with the “Call Reinforcements” skill
and Valkyries that increase deployment cost to your sortie team.
m400164.このままでは彼らの身が危険です。\n急ぎ彼らを救出致しましょう！:
Their lives are in danger if we do nothing.
We must rescue them at once!
m400164.この時の為に整えてきた戦力を、\n全て使っての襲撃でしょう。\n此方もしっかりと:
They'll be using every ounce of the forces we've prepared for this assault.
We'll need solid countermeasures.
m400164.それではこれより、\n『大討伐ミッション』\n開始いたします！:
Now then, from here,
“Great Extermination Mission”
will commence!
m400164.なにぶん、夜間の急な襲撃故、部隊を用意するのに\n少し手間を要するかと。此度の戦:
Since this night-time raid came on short notice,
assembling troops will take a bit of effort.
Also, deployment costs won't recover over time in this battle, so be careful.
m400164.また吸血鬼化した魔物達の爪牙には麻痺毒があります。\n安易に攻撃を受けすぎては危:
The claws and fangs of those vampire-tainted beasts carry a paralyzing toxin.
Taking reckless hits could be dangerous.
m400164.また敵を倒してもEXPやゴールド、\nドロップ品を手に入れることはできませんので: And remember, defeating enemies won't grant EXP, gold, or drops, so keep that in mind.
m400164.バリケードを利用し、極力敵の攻撃を避けるよう\n心掛けるのが上策かと。:
Using barricades to dodge enemy attacks as much as possible
is the best strategy.
m400164.今回は通常のミッションとは異なり、\n『大討伐ミッション』となります。: This isn't a regular mission—it's a “Grand Hunt” mission.
m400164.今宵は雲の多い『闇夜』。月が陰り光が弱まれば、\n吸血鬼達の動きは更に活発になる:
Tonight is a cloud-filled “dark night”. When the moon wanes and the light dims,
I've heard the vampires become even more active.
Prince, please be especially careful.
m400164.以前撃退した『ヴァンパイア公爵』\n彼の者が、配下の吸血鬼の総勢を連れ\n再び領:
The Duke of Vampires we previously defeated
has returned with his legion of vampire minions
and is once again invading our lands.
m400164.例えライフが0になってもクリアとなりますので、\nそれまでに倒した敵の数は全てカ:
Even if our life gauge hits zero, the mission counts as cleared,
and every enemy you've slain will be tallied as your final score.
m400164.吸血鬼、アンデッドに対して効果的な\n能力を持った方々を編成に加えておくことが必: It would be wise to include units with abilities effective against vampires and the undead.
m400164.大討伐ミッションでは『敵を撃破すること』\nそれだけが目的となります。:
In a Grand Hunt, the sole objective is
to defeat the enemies.
m400164.王子、出撃の前に幾つか留意事項を\nご説明させて頂きます。: Prince, before we set out, let me go over a few points.
m400164.王子、此度の襲撃では普段はあまり見かけない\n吸血鬼化した魔物達の姿が見受けられ: Prince, reports indicate we'll be facing vampire-tainted monsters we rarely see.
m400164.王子、火急の事態が発生致しました。: Prince, an urgent situation has arisen.
m400164.生き残った住民達はバリケードを設置し、\n屋内へと避難しているようですが……\n:
The surviving villagers have set up barricades
and taken shelter indoors, but…
…I don't think they can hold out much longer.
m400164.自軍の被害を抑えるよりも、いかに多くの\n敵を倒すかが重要なミッションです。\n:
Rather than minimizing our own losses, the focus is on slaying as many foes as possible.
Let's do everything we can to rack up kills.
m400164.部隊が手薄な地を狙ったのでしょう。\n展開していた部隊では応戦空しく、\n領地は:
He must have targeted a spot where our forces are thin.
Our deployed troops were no match, and the area
has fallen under their control.

m400257.……と、その前に。\n王子はちゃんと王子……だよね？: …But first. You're still… a prince, right?
m400257.……今回は雪山での戦いになるから、\n戦闘中『吹雪』で視界が悪くなる事があるかも: …Since this battle takes place in the snow mountains, the blizzard may reduce visibility during combat.
m400257.──と、討伐に向かう前に\n今回の戦いで重要なことを\n説明しておくね。: —Before we head out on the hunt, let me explain what's important about this battle.
m400257.これ以上騙される人達が増える前に、\nドッペルゲンガーをやっつけにいっちゃおう！: Before more people get fooled, let's go take down those doppelgängers!
m400257.それと、凍った地面の上では戦いにくくて\n近接クラスの皆は戦える場所が\n限られ: Also, fighting on frozen ground is tricky, so melee units will have very limited places they can fight from.
m400257.それと出撃コストが時間経過で回復しないから、\n『援軍要請』のスキルを持つ人や、: Also, deployment cost doesn't recover over time, so make sure you have someone with the “Call Reinforcements” skill and include a Valkyrie in your deployment roster!
m400257.そんな凍った地面を利用して、\n滑って駆け抜けてくる敵もいそうだから\nくれぐれ: Enemies might use that icy surface to slide right through, so be extra careful.
m400257.だから傷つく事を恐れないで、\n一体でも多く魔物を倒す事を優先してね！: So don't fear getting hurt—prioritize taking down as many monsters as you can!
m400257.だから自分達の被害を抑えるより、\nどれだけたくさんの敵を倒せるかが\n一番重要: So instead of minimizing our own losses, the number of foes you slay is what matters most!
m400257.でも、王子なら絶対に勝てるって\n私信じてるから！: But I'm sure you'll win, Prince—I believe in you!
m400257.でも雪山での戦いだったら私に任せて。\n王子の力になってみせるから！:
But if it's a battle in the snow-capped mountains, leave it to me.
I'll prove I've got your back, Prince!
m400257.なんでも王子と魔物の連合軍が、\n各地を侵攻して回ってるだなんて、\nそんな噂が: Rumor has it that you and a monster alliance have been marching across the lands, invading everywhere.
m400257.ドッペルゲンガーに連れてこられた魔物や人達、\nそれに慣れない雪山での戦いは\n: The monsters and people dragged in by the doppelgangers, plus fighting in unfamiliar snowy mountains, will make things tougher than usual.
m400257.ドッペルゲンガーの変身能力にも個体差があって、\n強い人の姿に化けたからってその: Doppelgangers' shape-changing abilities differ from one individual to another; just because they mimic a strong person doesn't mean they can copy that person's power.
m400257.中には何人もの王子を見かけたなんて報告も……。\n……きっと、王子に化けたドッペ: Some reports even say they've seen multiple princes… It must be those doppelgängers impersonating you.
m400257.人を騙すなんて卑怯なこと、\nそんなの私許せないよ！: Deceiving people is cowardly, and I can't stand that!
m400257.今回の戦いは、\n一体でも多くの敵を倒すことを目的とした\n『大討伐ミッション』: This fight is a “Grand Hunt Mission” aimed at defeating as many enemies as possible.
m400257.以上が今回の戦いの説明だよ。: That's the rundown for this battle.
m400257.偉い人や魔物に化けたドッペルゲンガーが、\n部下を騙して戦力を集めていってるんだ: I think doppelgängers disguised as nobles or monsters are tricking their subordinates to gather forces.
m400257.北の雪山で沢山の人や魔物を見かけた\n話もあるみたい。多分、魔物や\n騙された人: There's also talk of a lot of people and monsters spotted in the northern snow mountains. Probably the monsters and the duped folks are gathering there.
m400257.大討伐ミッションでは、\nライフが0になってもクリア扱いになって、\n倒した敵の: Even if your life hits zero, you'll still clear the mission, and the number of enemies you defeat will be recorded as your achievement.
m400257.大討伐ミッションでは普段のミッションと違って\n『敵を撃破すること』だけが目的に: Unlike regular missions, the only goal in a Grand Hunt Mission is to kill enemies.
m400257.急に執務室に入ってきたりしてごめんね！\nでもとっても大事な話があるの！: Sorry for barging into the office like this! But I have something really important to tell you!
m400257.敵を倒してもEXPやゴールド、\nドロップ品が手に入ったりはしないから\nその点: Even if you defeat enemies, you won't get EXP, gold, or drops, so keep that in mind.
m400257.早く戦いを終わらせて、折角の雪景色を楽しも！\nそれじゃ王子『大討伐ミッション』:
Let's finish the fight quickly and enjoy the beautiful snow scenery!
Now then, Prince, the “Great Hunt Mission” begins!
m400257.王子がひどい事するなんて、\nそんなこと絶対あるわけないのにね。: The idea that you'd do something terrible? That's impossible.
m400257.逆に力を持ったドッペルゲンガーなら、\n強大な魔物に化ける事もできちゃうみたい。: On the flip side, a doppelganger that already has power can even take the form of a mighty monster.

m400260.――王子、此度は白の帝国、王国共同で行う\n軍事演習への申し入れに快諾頂いたこと: —Prince, I'd like to thank you again for graciously accepting the joint military exercise proposed by the White Empire and the Kingdom.
m400260.そうだな、形式としては普段の\n魔物討伐の任とは違い『大討伐ミッション』\nとい: Right, unlike our usual monster-clearing missions, we'll use a “Grand Hunt Mission” format for this.
m400260.それでは『大討伐ミッション』開始とさせて頂く！: Then, let the Grand Hunt Mission begin!
m400260.たとえライフが０になってもクリアとなり、\nそれまでに倒した数はカウントされ\n: Even if your life reaches zero, the mission counts as cleared, and the number of enemies you've defeated is tallied as your battle record.
m400260.つまり、自軍の被害を恐れるよりも\n少しでも多くの相手を打ち倒す事に\n専念する: In other words, it's more important to focus on killing as many foes as possible than to worry about your own casualties.
m400260.まず大討伐ミッションでは\n『敵を撃破すること』\nそれのみが唯一の目的となる。: First and foremost, the sole objective is to defeat the enemies.
m400260.また敵を倒してもEXPやゴールド、\nドロップ品を手に入れることはできない。\n: Defeating enemies won't grant EXP, gold, or drops, so keep that in mind.
m400260.今回の演習は帝国と王国、互いの戦力を知り\n共闘を学ぶ良い機会だ、貴公の国の兵も: This exercise is a great opportunity for the Empire and the Kingdom to learn each other's capabilities and to practice joint combat. Your country's troops will also take part.
m400260.兎に角一人でも多く相手を倒す、\nそれこそが最も重要だ。: In short, the more opponents you take down, the better—that's what matters most.
m400260.出撃コストが時間経過で回復しない事も留意しておけ。\n『援軍要請』のスキルを持つ: Also remember that deployment cost doesn't recover over time. Be sure to include someone with the “Call Reinforcements” skill or a Valkyrie in your deployment team.
m400260.場所については当帝国の領土内、\n新設した防衛拠点にて行う事になる。: The location will be within our empire's territory, at a newly established defensive outpost.
m400260.大討伐ミッションでは通常のミッションとは違い\n幾つか異なる点がある事に注意して: Keep in mind that a Grand Hunt Mission differs from regular missions in several ways.
m400260.有事の際には貴国の力を借りる事もあるだろう。\nその際に互いの力を知らない、\n: In times of crisis we may call upon your aid, and it would be disastrous if we didn't know each other's strength or couldn't coordinate.
m400260.此度の演習、王国帝国双方にとって\n意義のある演習となることを願っているぞ。: I hope this exercise will be meaningful for both the Kingdom and the Empire.
m400260.此度の演習の目的は、我が帝国軍の\n軍力向上、並びに貴国との連携の強化にある。: The purpose of this drill is to improve our imperial forces and to strengthen cooperation with your nation.
m400260.演習とは言え、こちらとしても拠点の効果の程を試す\n絶好の機会だ。全力で当たらせ: Even though it's an exercise, it's a perfect chance for us to test the outpost's effectiveness. We'll give it our all, so don't let your guard down either.

m400346.――王子、東の砦より伝令！\n正体不明の魔物の軍勢、さらに増加！: —Prince, a messenger from the eastern fortress! Unidentified monster forces are on the rise!
m400346.……それもそうですね。\nあっ……でも、ここだけ微かに読み取れそうです。: …That's true. Ah… but I think I can just barely make it out here.
m400346.……どうやら、消耗戦を\n続けろとは言わなくて済みそうね。: …It looks like we won't have to tell them to keep grinding this war.
m400346.……なるほど、つまりあの謎の敵対生物は、\n突然、どこかから出現したのだ、と。: …I see, so that mysterious hostile creature just appeared out of nowhere.
m400346.あぁ、アルレットさん。\nいえ、どうにも気になることがありまして。: Ah, Arlette. No, there's just something bothering me.
m400346.あぁっ、それはさっき買った焼きたてのー！？: Ah, that was the fresh-baked one I just bought—!?
m400346.あっ、それはとっておきの！\n返してくださいよー！: Ah, that's a secret! Give it back to me!
m400346.あなたは、アイギス神殿防衛部隊の！\n部隊はどうなったのですか！？: You're from the Aegis Temple defense unit! What happened to your troops!?
m400346.あれが生物なのかどうか、\nその定義から始めないといけないくらい、\nアタシたち: We don't even know if that's a living thing; we have to start by defining it. To us, it's such an alien existence…
m400346.あんなものが今までに存在していたのなら、\n必ずどこかに記録が残っているはずだか: If something like that ever existed, there has to be some record of it somewhere.
m400346.いいえ、それがまったく……。\n魔物、事件、伝説、ありとあらゆる資料をあたっても: No, actually… Even after scouring every record on monsters, incidents, legends, nothing comes up about this, oddly enough.
m400346.えぇっと……うーん……？\nエ……フ……？ エフトラ……？: Let's see… um…? E… f…? Eftra…?
m400346.これだけの数の魔物――いや、\n魔物かどうかすら分からないわけだが、\nそいつら: With this many monsters—no, we don't even know if they're monsters—where have they been all this time?
m400346.その可能性もありますが……。\nでも、何かが引っかかっているんです。: That's a possibility, but… something just feels off.
m400346.それはつまり、確認されていない、\n完全に新種の魔物ということなのでは？: So that means it's an unconfirmed, completely new species of monster, right?
m400346.それも何というのか、\n自分で消したかのような痕跡もあって……。: And there are even traces as if I erased them myself…
m400346.そろそろ反撃ですよぉ……？\nアルレットさんのおやつ、いただきっ！: It's about time to counter-attack, right…? Arlette, bring me that snack!
m400346.はぁ……分からないってことが分かってしまった。\nこのまま消耗戦を続けろなんて、: Sigh… I've realized we just don't know anything. As a strategist, I absolutely can't tell you to keep grinding this war…
m400346.ふふん、あんまり気にしてると、\n美味しいお菓子が美味しくなくなっちゃうぞっと♪: Hehe, if you worry about it too much, the tasty sweets will lose their flavor♪
m400346.ぶっちゃけ何も分からない！\nあえて記録を残さなかったんじゃないかって、\n疑い: Honestly, we have no clue! It's almost like they deliberately left no records—there's just no information at all!
m400346.むぅ、自分の癖くらい分かりますよ。\nこの消し方は間違いなく、自分自身のものです: Mmm, I know my own habits. This kind of erasing is definitely my own doing.
m400346.もしやと思い、古代文明の資料や、\n専門家にもあたってみたのですが……。: I even dug into ancient-civilization documents and consulted experts…
m400346.もっと悪い事態になったかもしれないけどね。\n若！ アイギス神殿の偵察に向かおう: It could've gotten even worse. Young! Let's head out to scout the Aegis Temple!!
m400346.アイギス神殿防衛部隊からの連絡途絶！\n魔術師ギルドによる通信魔法にも応答ありま: Communications from the Aegis Temple defense unit have gone silent! No response to the Mage Guild's communication magic!
m400346.イタズラで、誰かに消されちゃったとか？: Maybe someone played a prank and wiped them out?
m400346.エフトラ、エフトラかぁ……。\nふふ、ちょっと神秘的で、かわいい名前だね。: Eftra, Eftra, huh… Hehe, it's a mysterious and cute name.
m400346.レーヴさん、書庫に何か\n参考になりそうな資料はありましたか？: Reve, did you find any reference material in the archives?
m400346.何かあったし、それを覚えていない、\nでも、きっとそれは悪いことではなかったんじ: Something happened and you don't remember, but it probably wasn't bad, right?
m400346.名前、なんでしょうか……？\nうーん、うーん？: What could the name be…? Hmm, hmm?
m400346.報告いたします。\nアイギス神殿北の山脈が崩壊！\n巨大な……その……なんという: The northern mountain range of the Aegis Temple has collapsed! A massive… uh… what's the word…
m400346.悪いことが起きてたなら、\nこんな風におしゃべり出来ていないだろうし。: If something terrible had occurred, we wouldn't be able to chat like this.
m400346.敵はいったい何者なんだ……。\n見たこともない魔物の群れに、\nそれを生み出す能: Who the heck are these enemies… A horde of monsters we've never seen, and the ability that creates them—information is all over the place!
m400346.確かにつけていたはずの日記が、\nほんの数行、なぜか抜け落ちているんです。: The diary I was keeping is missing a few lines for some reason.
m400346.被害は甚大ですが、まだ持ちこたえています。\nしかしそれも時間の問題かと……。: The damage is severe, but they're still holding on. Though I think it's only a matter of time…
m400346.超巨大生物の頭部と思われるものが\n山脈を割って出現しました……！！: What appears to be the head of a colossal creature has ripped through the mountains…!!
m400346.青白い肌と、生物の常識を無視した肉体、\nそして自身を複製するあの特性……。: Pale blue skin, a body that defies biology, and that self-replicating trait…
m400346.（……忘れているだけでなく、\n自ら消した痕跡があるということは、\nきっと誰か: (Not only have I forgotten, but there's evidence I erased it myself—someone must have done massive memory manipulation…)
m400346.（でも、悪い気はしないですね。\nアルレットさんの言うとおり、\nきっと何か、良: (But it doesn't feel bad. Just as Arlette says, it must've been a good encounter.)

m400416.――そろそろ、ハロウィンの祝祭が始まりますね。: Looks like the Halloween festivities are about to start.
m400416.――大変です王子！\n突如としてチェーンソーを振り回す怪物たちが現れ、\n仮装を: —This is terrible, Prince! Monsters suddenly appeared swinging chainsaws, rampaging through the venue with the costumed villagers!!
m400416.『大討伐ミッション』は、\n一体でも多くの敵を倒す事が目的です。: The goal of a ‘Grand Hunt Mission' is to defeat as many enemies as possible.
m400416.あっ、飾りといえばね、\n実はレミィとクーコも会場の準備を手伝ってくれたの！: Oh, speaking of decorations, actually Remi and Kuko helped set up the venue too!
m400416.あの様子は精神支配されていますわ！\n村人たちが被っている仮面には、\n着けた者: They seem to be under mental control! The masks the villagers are wearing appear to have an effect that makes the wearer go berserk!
m400416.そういえば、ちらっと見ましたけど、\nカボチャの飾りとか可愛くできてましたね。: Speaking of that, I caught a glimpse— the pumpkin decorations were really cute.
m400416.でしたら、今から見に行きましょうか。\nちょうどハロウィンが始まる時間です。\n: Then shall we go take a look? It's just about the time Halloween starts. Look, beyond the window, the villagers are enjoying the festivities…
m400416.では王子、『大討伐ミッション』の発令を！: Then, Prince, let the Grand Hunt Mission commence!
m400416.とはいえ、ハロウィン会場には人が大勢集まっており、\n普段のような部隊展開を行う: That said, the Halloween venue is packed with people, making our usual troop deployments difficult.
m400416.なにが起こるか分からない状況のため、\nこちらも万全の準備をして臨みましょう。: Since we can't predict what'll happen, let's make sure we're fully prepared.
m400416.なんにせよ、この騒動をどうにかしないと、\nハロウィンを楽しめないわよ！\nさっ: Anyway, we have to deal with this commotion or we won't be able to enjoy Halloween! Let's hurry, Prince!
m400416.ほ、本当！？ 何回も練習し――こほんっ！\n私は手先だって器用なんだから、あれく: R-really!? I've practiced over and over— ahem! I'm pretty handy, so that should be a breeze!
m400416.また、敵を倒してもEXPやゴールドを\n入手出来ない点にも気を付けて下さい。: Also, keep in mind that even if you defeat enemies, you won't earn any EXP or gold.
m400416.もうすっごいんだから！\n王子にも今すぐ見てもらいたいくらい！: They're amazing! I want the Prince to see it right now!
m400416.ハロウィン会場からの報告によると、\nチェーンソーを振り回している怪物だけでなく: Reports from the Halloween venue say that, besides the chainsaw-wielding monster, there are also costumed villagers and undead gathering there.
m400416.今日に向けて衣裳も用意して、\n村の人たちと会場の飾りつけも頑張ったわ。\nきっ: I've prepared costumes for today, and worked hard with the villagers on the decorations. It's sure to be a fun Halloween!♪
m400416.出撃されるのですね、王子。\nですがその前に、今回のミッションは、\n敵の討伐を: You're heading out, Prince. But before that, this mission is a ‘Grand Hunt Mission' aimed at exterminating the enemies.
m400416.出撃コストが時間経過では回復しないため、\nスキル『援軍要請』を持つメンバーや、: Since deployment cost doesn't recover over time, I recommend including members with the ‘Call for Reinforcements' skill or adding Valkyries to your squad.
m400416.嘘でしょ……きゃぁーー！？\n頑張って作った飾りつけが破壊されてるじゃない！？: No way… Kyaa—! The decorations we worked so hard on are being destroyed!?
m400416.拠点のライフが0になった場合でも、\nそれまでの討伐数が記録として残りますので、: Even if the base's life reaches zero, the number of defeats up to that point will be recorded, so don't fear falling— face the enemies!
m400416.窓から見える範囲で、暴れているのは……。\n怪物の仮面を被っている村人……！？\: From what we can see out the window, those wreaking havoc are… villagers wearing monster masks…! What on earth is this…?

m400507.しかも、現れた妖怪たちの数は千体にも及ぶと言われ、\n百鬼夜行ならぬ、千鬼夜行の: Moreover, the number of youkai that have appeared is said to be in the thousands, turning this into a "Senkibiyako"—a thousand-spirit night parade.
m400507.そのため出撃コストが時間経過で回復しないので\n『援軍要請』のスキルを持つ者や、: Consequently, deployment costs won't recover over time, so be sure to include anyone with the "Request Reinforcements" skill or a Valkyrie in your sortie team.
m400507.その百鬼夜行が実際に東の国で行われ、\n妖怪の群れが居住区に向っているという報告: We've received reports that such a Hyakki Yagyō is actually happening in the Eastern lands, with a swarm of youkai heading toward a settlement.
m400507.それと、敵を倒してもＥＸＰやゴールド、\nドロップ品を手に入れることはできません: Also, note that defeating enemies won't grant any EXP, gold, or item drops.
m400507.まず大討伐ミッションは『敵を撃破すること』\nそれだけが目的となります。: First, the only objective in a Grand Annihilation Mission is to destroy the enemies.
m400507.ライフが０になってもクリアとなり\nそれまでに倒した敵の数がカウントされ\n戦果: Even if your life gauge hits zero, the mission counts as cleared, and the number of enemies you've defeated will be tallied as your battle record.
m400507.今回の戦いは敵を倒すことだけを目的とした\n『大討伐ミッション』となります。: This battle will be a "Grand Annihilation Mission," focused solely on defeating the enemies.
m400507.今回は急な遠征のため思うように\n部隊が展開できません。: Because this is a sudden expedition, we can't deploy our forces as we'd like.
m400507.傷つくことを恐れず、一体でも多くの魔物を\n倒すことに専念してください。: Don't fear taking damage—devote yourself to cutting down as many monsters as you can.
m400507.大討伐ミッションは通常のミッションとは\nいくつか異なる点がありますので\nご注: The Grand Annihilation Mission differs from regular missions in several ways, so please keep that in mind.
m400507.王子、『大討伐ミッション』の発令を！: Prince, issue the Grand Annihilation Mission!
m400507.王子、妖怪から東の国の人たちを守るためにも\n千鬼夜行を止めに行きましょう！: Prince, we must go stop this thousand-spirit night parade and protect the people of the East from the youkai!
m400507.王子。百鬼夜行という言葉をご存知ですか……？\n集団でさまよう妖怪たちのことを指: Prince, have you ever heard of the term "Hyakki Yagyō"? It refers to a horde of wandering youkai.
m400507.自軍の被害を抑えるよりも\nいかに多くの敵を倒すかが重要です。: Rather than minimizing our own casualties, the key is to slay as many foes as possible.

m400579.――えぇと、お久しぶりですね？\n今日は異世界合同演習に\nご協力いただき、あり:
Um, it's been a while, hasn't it?
Thank you for your cooperation with the interdimensional joint exercise today.
m400579.――おぉ～、これが王国、\nそして王国軍と帝国軍の皆さん、と。:
――Oh~ so this is the Kingdom,
and everyone from the Kingdom and Empire armies.
m400579.――ふぁ……あふ……。\n海辺の朝というのも良いものだな。:
――Faa……ahh…….
A morning by the seaside is quite something, isn't it?
m400579.――ふぅ、そろそろ異界の門を開くタイミングですかねー。\n王子さまー？ もういい:
――Phew, it's about time to open the gate to the other world.
Prince? Are you ready?
m400579.――んもぉ～、だから！\n私もご主人くんと一緒に、\nおーこくって所に行ってみた:
???: ――Mmph! I told you!
I wanted to go to that other world with Master too!
m400579.――楽しい夏は、まだまだ続くんだからな。: ――Our wonderful summer is just getting started.
m400579.――特別ゲストは彼女たちだったのか。\nいや、それにしても、何か様子がおかしいが:
――So the special guests were them.
No, but something seems off about them.
m400579.…………！！\nあっ、あれって……まさか本物のヴァイスさま！？:
…………!!
Ah, that's……could it really be Weiss-sama?
m400579.……やれやれ。\nさて王子、私たちもバカンスに向かおうか。:
……I give up.
Well then, Prince, let's head off to our vacation.
m400579.……ゔぁ、ゔぁいす、さま！？\nえぇと、えっ、あっ、何？ どういうことだ！？:
……Vaa, Weiss, sama?
U-um, w-what? What's going on?
m400579.……無断の召喚実験は禁止ですよ？\nちゃんと申請はしてくださいね。:
……Unapproved summoning experiments are prohibited, you know?
Please make sure to file the proper paperwork.
m400579.……熱くなりすぎて、\n倒れないように注意するですよ？:
……Just be careful not to
collapse from the heat, okay?
m400579.あっ……なるほど……。\nあの子きっと、ヴァイスさんのファンなんですよ。:
Ah…… I see.
That girl must be a fan of Weiss.
m400579.あっ……また後方彼女面してるぅ……。: Ah…… She's doing her "possessive girlfriend" face again……
m400579.あっ、キミが門を開いてくれたんですねぇ。\nんぅ～、よしよし、なでなでしちゃいま:
Oh, you're the one who opened the gate for me, are you?
Mmm~ Alright, alright, let's have a little petting session♪
m400579.あはは、あの冷静沈着なヴァイスが、\nあんなにやる気出しちゃって。:
Ahaha, look at Weiss, who's usually so calm and collected,
getting all fired up like that.
m400579.あらあら……。\nともあれ、これにて模擬戦は終了です。\n王子、軍団の指揮、お疲:
Oh my……
In any case, that concludes the simulated battle.
Prince, thank you for your command of the corps!
m400579.あれだけ暴れればね……。\nあのクロミコピーいったいどこから持ってきたの。:
After all that rampaging……
Where did you even get that Kuromi copy from?
m400579.いえいえ、実は近隣の村から、\n見学を希望する方々を招待したんです。:
Not at all. We actually invited
visitors from the nearby village to observe.
m400579.いやいや、クロミが「私も異世界行きたかった」と\n駄々をこねているところだったか: Oh, come now. Kuromi was throwing a fit because she wanted to come to the other world too, so this is perfect timing.
m400579.うぅ、思い出したら悲しくなってきました……。: Uu, just remembering it makes me sad……
m400579.うぅ、関係ないもん……。\nひとりだけ関係ない世界に行っちゃったの\n寂しかった:
Uu, that's irrelevant……
It was lonely because only I was left out of that world……
m400579.うわぁああ！？\nどこからこのクロミコピー連れてきたんだ！？:
Wha――!?
Where did you bring this Kuromi copy from!?
m400579.えぇ、この後には懇親会も予定しています。\n共に世界を守るために戦った仲ですし、:
Yes, a social gathering is scheduled afterwards.
Since we've fought side by side to protect our worlds, please do take the opportunity to deepen our friendship.
m400579.えぇっ、せめて後片付けしてから――\nあっ、もう行っちゃった……。:

That's enough!
As expected of the Prince, splendid command.

m900001.ウィッチの魔法もあなどれないことを\nわかっていただけたでしょうか？: I hope you've realized that you shouldn't underestimate the Witch's magic.

We must never let the healer be taken down.
Please be especially careful.

m900001.メイジは広範囲、かつ威力のある魔法での攻撃を\n行える強力な遠距離型ユニットです: Mages are powerful ranged units that can unleash wide-area, high-damage magic attacks.
m900001.ユニットが出撃するためにはこの出撃コストを消費\nします。これが足りないとユニッ: Deploying a unit consumes its deployment cost. Without enough, you can't send the unit out, and stronger units require higher costs.
m900001.ワルキューレとは馬に乗った女騎士です。\n騎兵が敵を倒すことで後続の味方が\n出: A Valkyrie is a female knight on horseback. When cavalry defeat enemies, they open a path for their allies behind them to be deployed.

This time we'll cover how to deal with flying enemies.
Flying foes? Leave it to me! I'll…

m900001.戦術の教官は、これで必要なくなったと\nいうわけです。: So the tactics instructor is no longer needed.
m900001.攻撃力や防御力も大切ですが、敵の数が多い時は\nブロックできる数が非常に重要とな: Attack and defense are important, but when there are many enemies, the block count becomes crucial.
m900001.敵の中には、飛び道具などで遠距離ユニットを\n攻撃してくるものがいます。: Some enemies attack our ranged units from afar with projectiles.
m900001.敵をブロックできるのは近接型のユニットのみで、\nさらに何体の敵までブロックでき: Only melee units can block, and the number of enemies they can stop varies by class.
m900001.日々積み重ねた訓練は、決して裏切りません。\n少しずつ、様々な知識を身に着けてい: The daily training you've piled up won't betray you. Let's gradually acquire a range of knowledge.
m900001.最後に、撤退すると出撃コストの一部が回復します。\nこれはすべてのユニットで有効: Finally, retreating restores a portion of your deployment cost. This works for every unit, so be sure to make use of it.
m900001.最後にもう一つ、\nお教えしたいことがございます。: One last thing I'd like to teach you.
m900001.次に、ワルキューレが敵を倒すと出撃コストが\n回復します。あくまでトドメを刺した: Next, when a Valkyrie defeats an enemy, it restores deployment cost. Note that it only recovers cost when delivering the finishing blow.
m900001.無尽蔵ともいえる魔物の勢いの前には\n戦闘力だけでは打ち勝つことはできません。: In the face of the seemingly endless tide of monsters, sheer combat power alone won't be enough to prevail.
m900001.王子、今回は強力な敵が出現するそうです。\n私も「スキル」を発動するタイミングを:
Prince, this time a powerful enemy is said to appear.
I'll advise you on the timing to activate a “Skill,” so let's do our best together!
m900001.王子、味方の兵はすでに展開していますが、\nこのままでは「毒の地形」によって\n: Prince, your troops are already deployed, but as it stands they'll be wiped out by the poison.
m900001.王子、赤いガーゴイルの群れが現れました！\nあの群れにあわせて、\n私に「スキル:
Prince, a swarm of red gargoyles has appeared!
When that swarm shows up,
please give me the command to activate my “Skill”!
m900001.王子のこれからのご活躍に期待しております。: I look forward to seeing your future exploits, Prince.
m900001.王子の味方は強力な「スキル」を持っており、\nそれは戦況を変えるほどの効果を発揮: Your allies possess powerful “Skills” that can turn the tide of battle.
m900001.百聞は一見に如かず、まずはウィッチの力を\n見てみましょう。: Seeing is believing, so let's take a look at the Witch's power.
m900001.空を飛ぶ敵には、飛び道具で対抗するほか\nありません。\nでは早速、空を飛ぶ敵と:
The only way to handle flying foes is with ranged projectiles.
So let's begin the training against airborne enemies right away.
m900001.空を飛ぶ敵は道に沿って移動することも\nありませんので、侵攻ルートには気を付けて: Flying enemies don't stick to the path, so watch your invasion routes carefully.
m900001.簡単に申しますと、敵が本陣に到達するとライフが\n減りそのライフが０になると、我: Simply put, if enemies reach our headquarters, our life gauge drops, and when it hits zero, we lose.
m900001.言い換えれば、出撃コストがたくさんあるほど\nより多く、より強いユニットが出撃で: In other words, the more deployment cost you have, the more units—and the stronger ones—you can field.
m900001.護りに自信がなければできることではありません。\n逆にブロック数が１ということは: If you lack confidence in your defense, it's not for you. Conversely, a block count of one means you'll only be attacked by a single enemy, making it relatively safe.
m900001.近接型ユニットで敵を足止めし、攻撃できれば\n一度にたくさんの敵を一網打尽にする: If your melee troops hold the enemies in place, the Mage can wipe out a huge number of foes all at once!
m900001.追加演習に挑む場合には、\nまたここを訪ねてきてくださいね。: If you decide to take on the extra exercise, just come back here again.
m900001.通常の敵よりもはるかに強力な敵が\n戦場に出現することがあります。: Much stronger foes may appear on the battlefield.

m920001.うふふ、やる気満々のようね。\nでも、いつも通りに戦えるとは限らないよ。\n魔女:
Heh heh, you look quite eager.
But don't expect this to be a routine battle.
Learn the true power of a witch.
m920001.ここが忌々しい女神アイギスの神殿だね。\nふふ、すぐにボロボロにしてやるよ。\n:
This is the loathsome temple of the goddess Aigis.
Heh, I'll reduce it to rubble in no time.
Now then, my minions, make your move!
m920001.この前はよくもやってくれたね！\n今回はもっとすごいの連れてきたよ。\nさあ、ぶ:
You really did me in last time!
This time, I've brought even stronger reinforcements.
Now then, let's give them a taste of the big ones!
m920001.この女神様の神殿がどうしても邪魔な\nようですね。\n絶対に守り抜きましょう。:
It seems this temple of the goddess
is a great thorn in her side.
We must defend it at all costs.
m920001.この数の魔物を倒すなんて\n案外やるもんだ。\n英雄の子孫ってのもまんざらじゃな:
To defeat this many monsters...
You're not as bad as I thought.
Being the heir of a hero does have its perks, I suppose.
m920001.どうやら私の手には負えないみたいだね。\nならば、あのお方に直接戦ってもらおうか:
It seems I'm no match for you after all.
Then let's have my master fight you directly...
Now then, follow me!
m920001.ふふふ、しつこい奴らだね。\nもしかして私が欲しいのかい……\n私に勝てたら考え:
Heh heh, you persistent ones.
Could it be that you want me...?
If you can defeat me, I'll consider it.
m920001.森に住む者たちがこの周囲で\n逃げていく魔女を見たという話ですが…\nあの小屋が:
The locals who live in the forest say they saw
the witch fleeing through this area...
Could that hut be her hideout?
m920001.気を付けてください。\nこの神殿を覆っている霧は\n癒しの力を妨げています。:
Please be careful.
The fog shrouding this temple
is hindering the power of healing.
m920001.王子、魔女はあの穴に逃げ込んだようです。\n何が潜んでいるかわかりません。\nお:
Prince, it looks like the witch has fled into that hole.
We don't know what's lurking inside.
Please be careful.
m920001.王子、魔物たちの襲撃です。\n女神様の神殿を狙っているようです。\n迎え撃ちまし:
Prince, the monsters are attacking.
They seem to be targeting the goddess's temple.
Let's intercept them.

m920036.……魔物に奪われた真竜の卵を、\n取り戻して欲しい。: …I want you to retrieve the true dragon's egg that the White Goblins stole.
m920036.あ、ルシルさんは敵にバレないよう、\n魔物の命令通りに動いてくださいね。: Ah, Lucille, make sure you follow the monsters' orders so we don't get spotted by the enemy.
m920036.あぁ……。おかげで卵の母親との誓いも\n守ることができた。\n本当にありがとう…:
Ah… Thanks to you, I was able to keep my vow to the egg's mother.
Thank you so much…
m920036.あなたは……！\n王子、敵襲です！:
You are…!
Prince, it's an enemy attack!
m920036.え……えぇ。\nお手柔らかに……。: Uh… yeah. Take it easy on us….
m920036.ここの魔物を一掃できれば、\n真竜の卵を奪還できるはずです。\n一気に攻め込みた:
If we clear out the monsters here, we should be able to recover the egg.
I'd love to charge in all at once, but…
m920036.この瞬間を待っていた。\n真竜の卵は絶対に取り返す。:
I've been waiting for this moment.
I will definitely reclaim the true dragon's egg.
m920036.そういえば、卵を盗んだ真犯人の情報を\n魔物から聞き出すことができたんだ。\n私:
By the way, I managed to get info from the monsters about the real culprit who stole the egg.
I'm going after them.
m920036.そのとき魔物が出した条件が、\nこの国の王子を倒せば、真竜の卵を返す。\nただし:
Their condition was that if they defeat this country's Prince, they'll return the egg.
But if we betray them, they'll destroy the egg…
m920036.その通り。\n真竜の保護は竜騎士の務め……。\n魔物の手に落ちることは許されない:
Exactly.
Protecting the true dragon is the duty of a Dragon Knight…
It must never fall into the White Goblins' hands.
m920036.それで、私たちに戦いを挑んできた訳ですね。\nしかし、魔物たちが約束を守るとは…:
So that's why they challenged us to battle.
But can the White Goblins be trusted to keep their word…?
m920036.なるほど……。\nともあれ、未然に防げてよかったですね。:
I see…
Anyway, I'm glad we prevented it.
m920036.ぬぅっっ……！\nなかなかやりおる。\nこのままではラチがあかん！:
Nuu…!
Not bad at all.
If this keeps up, my luck's ruined!
m920036.ま、待って！\n敵意はないんだ！\n武器を下ろしてくれ。:
???: Wait, wait!
We mean no harm!
Lay down your weapons.
m920036.わかった。敵にバレないように\n全力であなたたちと戦わせてもらう……！: Got it. I'll fight you with all my might without letting the enemy notice…!
m920036.オイ、オマエ。\nドコニ行ッテイタ。:
Hey, you.
Where have you been?
m920036.オイッ爆弾部隊ハ、マダカ！？\nモウ戦イハ始マルゾッ！！:
Hey! Bomb squad, still here!?
The battle's about to start!!
m920036.オイッ！ オマエ！\nドコ行ク！:
Hey! You!
Where are you going!
m920036.オマエタチ！ コノ卵ヲ取リ返シニ\n来タンダロッ！: You lot! We came here to take back this egg!
m920036.ゲギャァア、オイ！\nオマエ！ 怪シイ動キヲスルナ！:
Geeeaaah, hey!
You! Don't make any weird moves!
m920036.ゲギャッ！ \nバクダン、バクダン。\n人間マトメテ、ズガーン！！:
Geh!
Bombs, bombs.
Humans, get ready—boom!!
m920036.コウナッタラ仕方ガナイ！\nモッタイナイガ、卵ヲ割ッテヤル！:
If it comes to this, there's no helping it!
It's a waste, but we'll smash the egg!
m920036.サッサト王子ヲ倒セ！\n裏切ッテモ卵ヲコワス！\n少シデモ手ヲ抜イタラコワス！:
Take down the Prince quickly!
Even if you betray us, we'll smash the egg!
Even a little slip and we'll break it!
m920036.ソレニ、ソノ竜。\n炎ヲ吐イテナイ！\n卵、壊サレタイノカ！！:
And that dragon.
Not breathing fire!
You wanna smash the egg!!
m920036.モウスグ王子ガ来ル。\nオマエ……手ヲ抜クナヨ。\n分カッテイルダロウナ？:
The Prince of Moosugu is coming.
Don't let your guard down.
You get it, right?
m920036.ルシルさん……。\nちょっと無理があるのでは……。:
Lucille…
That's a bit much, don't you think…?
m920036.ルシルさん！ やりましたね！\nしかし、なぜ魔物は真竜の卵を？\n壊そうと思えば:
Lucille! We did it!
But why were the monsters after the true dragon's egg?
If they wanted to break it, they could've done it at any time…
m920036.事情はわかりました。\n私たちにも協力させてください。:
We understand the situation.
Let us help as well.
m920036.人間……！\nあなたたちは魔物の手助けをしたと\n言うのですか！？:
Humans…!
Are you saying you helped the monsters!?
m920036.今回は戦うことになってしまったが、\n今度は王子の元で戦わせてくれ。\nいつか…:
This time we had to fight, but next time let me fight under your command, Prince.
Someday… I hope you'll call on me.
m920036.卵が保管されている場所は教える。\n王子はそちらに向ってほしい。:
I'll tell you where the egg is kept.
Prince, you should head there.
m920036.卵の在り処は分かったのだが……。\n調査の途中で魔物の襲撃に遭い、\n私は囚われ:
I know where the egg is, but…
During the investigation I was ambushed by the White Goblins and captured.
m920036.卵は……！ よかった……。\n無事だな。: The egg…! Thank goodness… It's safe.
m920036.卵を壊させる訳にはいかない……。\nそれに絶対に取り返すと誓った。\n真竜の母に:
I can't let the egg be destroyed…
I've sworn to retrieve it at any cost.
For the true dragon's mother…
m920036.報告！ 敵影を確認！\n竜に乗った騎士が\nこちらに向ってきます！:
Report! Enemy sighted!
A knight on a dragon is heading our way!
m920036.場所さえ分かればこっちの物ですね。\n王子、早速ですが向かいましょう。:
As long as we know the location, it's ours.
Prince, let's go right away.
m920036.恐らく魔物は真竜の卵を魔界へ送り、\n悪に染まった真竜を作ることが\n目的だった:
Likely the monsters intended to send the egg to the demon realm
and create a dragon corrupted by evil…
m920036.我らはこの忍びの腕を\n高く買ってくれる者に従うだけよ。: We only serve those who value our ninja skills.
m920036.敵の身でありながらここに来たのは\n王子に一つ、頼みがあるからなんだ。: Though I'm an enemy, I came here because I have a request of the Prince.
m920036.敵意はない……？\nどういうことですか？:
No harm…?
What do you mean?
m920036.本当か！ ありがとう……。\n相談できてよかった。:
Really! Thank you…
I'm glad we could discuss this.
m920036.次に会うその時まで、\n楽しみにしている。:
Until we meet again,
I'll be looking forward to it.
m920036.派手に暴れる……！\nもはや忍ぶ気はないみたいですね……。\n王子、ご注意を！:
Going all out...!
Looks like you've given up on hiding...
Prince, watch out!
m920036.爆弾を持った魔物たちが\n卵の周りに陣取っているため、\n近づけそうにないですね: Goblin bombers have taken positions around the egg, so we can't get close.
m920036.王子、ここは戦うしかないようですね。: Prince, it looks like we have no choice but to fight.
m920036.王子、先の戦いで現れた爆弾を持った\n魔物がくると予想されます。\n現れ次第、早:
Prince, we can expect more bomb-carrying goblins like the ones from earlier.
As soon as they show up, try to intercept them quickly!
m920036.王子、爆弾による集中攻撃を受けると危険です。\nまずは魔物の動きを探り、攻勢に移:
Prince, a concentrated bomb attack would be deadly.
First, let's scout their movements before we go on the offensive.
m920036.王子、爆弾を持った魔物が出現しました。\nあんなにたくさんの爆弾を抱えて……。:
Prince, a goblin carrying a bomb has appeared.
It's lugging a huge pile of explosives….
m920036.王子、魔物たちの撤退を\n確認しました。: Prince, I've confirmed the White Goblins are retreating.
m920036.王子、魔物の撤退を確認。\nこの洞窟内の魔物は一掃されました。:
Prince, the monsters have withdrawn.
All the monsters in this cave have been cleared.
m920036.王子！！ 覚悟することだな！\n私を倒すことができるかな！？:
Prince!! Brace yourself!
Think you can defeat me!?
m920036.真竜……。確か、１００年に一度\n生まれるという、高い知力を持った\nドラゴンの: True dragon… If I recall, it's the highly intelligent dragon born once every hundred years.
m920036.真竜の卵が保管されているという\n洞窟はここですね。: So this is the cave where the true dragon's egg is kept.
m920036.真竜の卵を盗んだ犯人の本拠地は\nここらしいですが……。\n肝心のルシルさんは何:
The culprit's hideout seems to be around here…
Where on earth is Lucille?
m920036.真竜は力と知力を併せ持った\n強大な存在へと成長する。: The true dragon will grow into a mighty being possessing both strength and wisdom.
m920036.私の名はルシル。\n今は訳あって魔物に従っている身だ。\n先の戦いでは失礼した…:
My name is Lucille.
For now I'm serving the White Goblins for reasons.
I was rude in the previous battle…
m920036.私は魔物の監視下におかれ、\n身動きがとれない……。: I'm under the White Goblins' watch, unable to move…
m920036.秘技……隠形の術……。\n姿を消した我らに\n遠距離攻撃は通じぬぞ……。:
Secret technique… the art of concealment…
Now that we've vanished, ranged attacks won't reach us…
m920036.竜に乗った騎士！\n新しいタイプの敵ですね……。\n王子、十分に注意して迎撃を！:
A knight on a dragon!
A new type of enemy, huh….
Prince, stay sharp and intercept!
m920036.者ども、行くぞ！\n派手に暴れろ！:
Alright, you lot, let's move!
Go all out!
m920036.衝撃を与えると誘爆してしまうでしょう。\n距離をとって戦うことをおすすめします。:
If we hit it, it'll trigger a chain reaction.
I'd recommend fighting from a distance.
m920036.貴様らがあの騎士の仲間か！\nあやつは既に我らの術にかかって\n動けなくなってお:
You lot are allies of that knight!
He's already fallen under our technique and can't move!
m920036.貴様らの抹殺命令もでているのでな。\n丁度良い。覚悟をしてもらおう！:
There's even an order to eliminate you.
Perfect timing. Let's see how you handle this!
m920036.（あれが王子……。\n戦闘後に接触する必要がある。\nここは手を抜いておいたほう:
???: (That's the Prince….
I need to make contact after the battle.
Maybe I should hold back here…)
m920036.（くっ……。\n魔物たちに悟られれば終わりだ。\n王子には悪いが手は抜けない……:
(Damn… if the monsters notice us it's over.
Sorry, Prince, but I can't hold back…!)
m920036.（ここで見破られる訳には……。\n王子を信じて、全力でぶつかるしかない！）: (I can't let them see through me here… I have to trust the Prince and go all out!)
m920036.（この混乱に乗じて卵を……。）: (I'll use the chaos to snatch the egg… )
m920036.（やはり動けない……か。\n王子、爆弾を持った魔物には\n気をつけてくれ……！）: (So I still can't move… Prince, watch out for the goblins carrying bombs…!)
m920036.（爆弾！？ いけない、\n王子に知らせないと……）: (Bombs?! This is bad, I need to tell the Prince…)

m920048.……うわっ！ な、なぜ顔を近づける！ \nここはどこだ？ 貴様何者だ！: …Whoa! W-why are you getting so close! Where am I? Who the hell are you!
m920048.……なるほど。\nさきほどは敵と間違えてしまって悪かったな。: …I see. Sorry about mistaking you for the enemy earlier.
m920048.……！ なに、これ……っ。体が、勝手に……！: …! What is this…? My body… moving on its own!
m920048.あぁ……心が軽くなっていきます……。\n我々を縛り付けていた鎖が、ほどけてゆく…: Ah… I feel my heart lightening… The chains that bound us are loosening…
m920048.あぁ、さっきのお嬢さんならあのドラゴンの腹の中よ。\n私は別にあなたたちが逃げて:
Ah, that lady from earlier? She's inside the dragon's belly.
I don't mind if you run away, but that girl? She won't make it out alive, you know.
m920048.あぁ、私たちの負けだ。\n（失意のまま、あの世へ旅立たせることを\n許してくれ…: Yeah, that's our loss. (In our despair, let us be allowed to depart for the afterlife…)
m920048.あなたたちを倒す奥の手を紹介してあげようかしら？\nさぁ、みて頂戴……私の傑作。:
Shall I show you my trump card to defeat you?
Behold… my masterpiece.
A Dragon Zombie…!
m920048.あなた方には感謝している。\nさぁ、お前たち。私も一緒に逝こう。: I'm grateful to you all. Come now, you lot. I'll go with you.
m920048.あの嵐で……提督がいなくなった直後に、\n魔物の襲撃を受けたんです……。\n我々: After that storm, right after the Admiral disappeared, we were attacked by monsters... We fought desperately, but we were all wiped out...
m920048.あらあら、お姉さん負けちゃった。\n意外と強いのねー、あなたたち。\nまぁいいわ:
Oh dear, sister, you lost.
You're surprisingly strong, aren't you.
Fine then. I'll be satisfied with just this one experiment this time.
m920048.あーらら、やられちゃった。ここまでやるなんて……。\nそれによく見たら坊や、いい:
Oh dear, you got me. I never expected you to go this far…
And now that I look closely, kid, you're not a bad-looking fellow.
Ah, that's right. You don't plan on becoming undead, do you?
m920048.えっ、私たちと戦うんですか！？: What? We're supposed to fight them!?
m920048.おや、残念。目が覚めてしまいやしたか。\nせっかく助けて差し上げようとしたんです: Oh dear, too bad. Looks like you woke up. I was just about to help you… Heh, I'm a bandit.
m920048.お前たち……。ありがとう……。\nわかった……最後まで、お前たちの分まで、\n生: You… thank you… I understand… I'll live on, carrying your memory until the very end.
m920048.お前たち、その体は……！\n一体何が起きたんだ！: You... what happened to those bodies?! What on earth is going on?!
m920048.お前たちの望みはなんだ！？\n私にできることであればなんでもしよう！: What is it you all desire!? I'll do anything I can!
m920048.お察しの通り。このわ・た・し。: Just as you guessed. It's me.
m920048.くくく……。なにかショックなことがあったのかしら？\n精神が弱まってて、操りやす: Heh heh… Did something shocking happen? Your mind's weakened, making you so easy to control.
m920048.くくくっ、見事に罠にハマるなんて……。\n本当に可愛い坊やだわ……。: Heh heh, falling perfectly into my trap… Such an adorable brat…
m920048.げへへ、大丈夫でやすか？\nおっと意識がないみたいですね。\nこういう時は人工呼: Hehe, are you alright? Hmm, looks like they're unconscious. In cases like this, you do mouth-to-mouth…
m920048.このドラゴンは実験の過程で生まれたものだけどー、\nなんといっても体力がすさまじ:
This dragon was born during my experiments—
and its stamina is just insane. If you keep hitting it with claw attacks, it'll get paralyzed and freeze up, you know?
m920048.この姿では死ぬこともできず……。\nただただ……提督の帰りをお待ちすることだけが: In this form we can't even die... All we can do is wait... wait for the Admiral's return... that's our only hope...
m920048.ご、誤解です！ 彼らは山賊ではありますが、\n今は魔物と戦う仲間なんです。: It's a misunderstanding! They are bandits, yes, but now they're allies fighting the monsters.
m920048.ご報告します。\n船ですが、魔物との戦いでかなり\n傷ついているようです。: Report. The ship's been badly damaged in the fight with monsters.
m920048.さぁ、助手のリッチたちよ！\nこいつらをやっつけておしまい！: Now, my assistants, the Liches! Take them down!
m920048.そういうことでしたか……。\nでもおかしいですね。: So that's what happened... But it's strange.
m920048.そうですね。一直線に進むよりもその方が\n良いかもしれません。: That might be better than just charging straight ahead.
m920048.それと、船の前には骸骨の魔物がいまして……。\nまるで船を守るように立っているん: Also, there's a skeletal monster standing at the bow, as if guarding the vessel.
m920048.それにしても、魔物はここで\n何をしていたのでしょうか。: Still, what were those monsters doing here?
m920048.そんなものを生み出すなんて……。\nそれに王子、先ほどからリーンベルさんが\n見:
To think you could create something like that…
And Prince, we still haven't seen Reanbell anywhere.
m920048.ちょっと複雑な事情がありまして……。\nそれは傷の手当てをしながらご説明いたしま: It's a bit of a complicated situation… I'll explain while I tend to your wounds.
m920048.とはいえ、提督としての命を受けているからには\n全うしなければと、これまで魔物と: Still, as an admiral I must fulfill my duty, so I've been fighting monsters…
m920048.どちらを使うかのタイミングは\n王子の指示に任せる。: When to switch between them, I'll follow your orders.
m920048.なっさけないわねー。それでも私の部下なの？\n……あ、そうよ。消えてしまった部下: How pathetic. Still my subordinate? …Ah, right. Since your comrades vanished, you can fight for me instead!
m920048.なんだと……！！ おのれ賊め！\n私を女だと思って侮らないことだな！: What the—!! You damned bandit! Don't you dare think I'm a woman!
m920048.ひとまずここを切り抜けたほうがよさそうですね。: We should probably get out of here first.
m920048.まずはこの近海を捜索いたしましょう。: First, let's search these nearby seas.
m920048.まだ魔物と戦っている国があるのかもしれません。\n一緒に戦えたら心強いですね。: There might still be a country still battling monsters. It would be reassuring to fight together.
m920048.もう一度言います。\n誰ですかあなたは！:
I'll say it again.
Who are you!
m920048.もし生存者がいるのならば一緒に王子に\n協力したい……っ。: If any survivors remain, I'd like to cooperate with you…!
m920048.よかったですね。見つかってなによりです……。: That's good news. At least we found it...
m920048.わかった。魔物たちとの戦いをやり直すことは\nできないが、もう一度共に戦おう！: Understood. We can't redo the fight, but let's battle together once more!
m920048.ブレスだって、あまり遠くには届かないのが\n惜しいところだけど、威力はすごいのよ: Even its breath doesn't reach very far, which is a shame, but the power is tremendous.
m920048.一つ提案なのだが、王子たちが魔物を\n引きつけている隙に私がこっそりと\n船に乗: I have a suggestion—while you, Prince, and the others draw the monsters' attention, I could slip aboard the ship unnoticed. How does that sound?
m920048.一回死んでみれば考えも変わるでしょう……。\nまた必ず、坊やを殺しに来てあげるわ:
One taste of death and you'll change your mind…
I'll definitely come back to kill you, kid.
Until then, be a good boy and wait, okay?
m920048.亡霊は倒すことができません……。\nなにか強い怨念が彼女たちを\nここに縛り付け: We can't defeat the ghosts... Something strong lingering here must be binding them.
m920048.人間の可能性は生前ではなく、\n死後にこそあるというものよ……？\nそれが理解で:
Human potential lies not in life, but after death…?
It's sad, sister, that you can't understand.
m920048.先に中に入った彼女が心配です。\n私たちも早く行きましょう。: I'm worried about the one who went in first. Let's hurry inside ourselves.
m920048.報告します！ あちらに船らしきものを発見\nしたのですが……。: Report! We spotted what looks like a ship over there...
m920048.報告！ 敵がこちらに迫ってきています！: Report! The enemy's closing in on us!
m920048.報告！ 魔物がこちらに向かってきています！: Report! Monsters are heading our way!
m920048.実体を持たない亡霊相手では\n通常の武器は効きにくいです。\nご注意ください！: Ghosts have no physical form, so regular weapons are less effective. Be careful!
m920048.山賊ごときにこの私が……。: Someone like me, defeated by a mere bandit…
m920048.強い後悔を利用し、霊体を形成して留め置くことで\n実現する無敵の兵士を作り上げよ: I intended to use strong regret, shape it into a spirit, and forge an invincible soldier…
m920048.彼女たちの未練はなくなったようですね。\nこれで安らかに眠れるでしょう……。: It seems their lingering regrets have faded. They can finally rest in peace…
m920048.悪いけど、私の邪魔をするのは誰であろうと\n容赦しないわよ。後悔しながら死んで、: Sorry, but I won't show mercy to anyone who gets in my way. Die in regret and become my new test subject…!
m920048.悪い話でもないのよ？ 不死の存在になれば、\n魔物たちとの戦いも有利になるし。: It's not a bad deal, you know? As an immortal, fighting monsters would be a lot easier.
m920048.我々は……提督に失望したから逝くのでは\nありません……。: We aren't leaving because we were disappointed in you…
m920048.提督……、戻って、きて、くれたん……ですね。: Admiral... you came back, didn't you?
m920048.提督が一緒に戦ってくれたならば、\n絶対に負けなかった。: If the Admiral had fought alongside us, we would never have lost.
m920048.提督さんが戻るまで待つということが\nこの世に留まっている原因ならば、\nもう呪: If waiting for the Admiral's return is what's keeping us bound to this world, then we should already be freed from the curse…
m920048.提督の……優しさは、我々が……一番よく……\n知ってますから……。: Your kindness, Admiral… we know it better than anyone…
m920048.数日前に嵐に巻き込まれて海に投げ出され、\n気付けばここに流れ着いたらしい。: A few days ago I was caught in a storm, thrown into the sea, and apparently washed up here.
m920048.敵は、非常に強力……。撤退します……。: The enemy is extremely powerful... Retreating...
m920048.敵兵発見。我、偵察任務に出撃します。: Enemy troops detected. I will deploy on a reconnaissance mission.
m920048.最後に……提督と共に戦えたことが……、\n一緒にいられたことが……なにより嬉しか: Just being able to fight alongside you at the end… being together… that was the greatest joy for us… It alone saved us…
m920048.望み……。\nもし叶うのならば……私たちが全滅した、\n魔物たちとの戦いをやり、: A wish… If it could be granted… we'd like to redo the battle where we were wiped out by the monsters…
m920048.死霊術……！ まさか私の部下たちを亡霊に\nしていたのは……ッ！: Necromancy…! Could it be that you've turned my subordinates into phantoms…!
m920048.残念ですが、時間を巻き戻すことは……。: I'm afraid turning back time is…
m920048.王子、あれを！\nあれは亡霊のようです……っ！: Prince, that! It looks like a ghost...!
m920048.王子、お願いだ。どうか私たちの船を探して\nもらえないだろうか？\n彼女らは部下: Prince, please. Could you help us find our ship? They're my subordinates, but also my precious family…
m920048.王子、こっちです。\nこの辺の海でどっかの国の軍艦と\n魔物が戦ってやした。: Prince, over here. A navy ship from some country fought monsters in these waters.
m920048.王子、船上の戦いなら私に任せてくれ。\n私の武器はソードピストルと言って\n剣に: Prince, leave the ship battle to me. My weapon's a sword pistol—works as both blade and gun, very handy.
m920048.王子軍の者がこの海域で、提督さんの船と\n思われる船と魔物が、交戦していたのを\: Our forces observed a ship—presumably the admiral's—engaging monsters in these waters.
m920048.王子！ リーンベルさんが連れ去られます！\n急ぎ後を追いましょう！:
Prince! Reanbell's being taken away!
We must chase after them quickly!
m920048.申し訳ない……。私のせいで……。: I'm sorry... This is all my fault...
m920048.目を覚ますと、皆このような姿になって……\nいたのです……。: When we woke up, we were all like this... that's how it was...
m920048.相手は伝説の英雄の末裔と、その軍勢だ。: Our opponents will be the descendants of the legendary hero and their forces.
m920048.私のために、すまない……。\n本当に心から感謝する。: I'm sorry, for my sake... I truly thank you from the bottom of my heart.
m920048.私はリーンベル。とある国の艦隊の提督をしていた。\n……だが国は滅び、艦隊も自分: I'm Reanbell. I used to be the admiral of a nation's fleet. …But the country fell, and only my ship remained while the rest scattered.
m920048.私は死霊術を極めた存在。\n死霊術を使って皆を幸せにするため、日夜\n頑張ってい:
I am one who has mastered necromancy.
I work day and night, using it to bring happiness to everyone—such a grateful being, aren't I?
m920048.誰ですかっ、あなたは一体……！: Who are you? What on earth are you…!
m920048.貴様……！ 許さん、絶対に……！！: You…! I won't forgive you, never…!!
m920048.追いつきました！\nリーンベルさんを返してください！:
We've caught up!
Give Reanbell back!
m920048.逝ってしまいました……。じゃすまない話よ！\nちょっとちょっと……、私の大事な実: They've passed on… That's no excuse! Hey, hey… letting my precious test subjects become ghosts on their own, you troublesome brats?
m920048.部下を失望させてしまったが、\nせめて最後は一緒に……。: I've let my subordinates down, but at least let me be with them at the end…
m920048.酷いことを……。王子、ドラゴンゾンビを倒し、\nリーンベルさんを救出致しましょう: How cruel… Prince, let's defeat the dragon zombie and rescue Reanbell!
m920048.魔物に敗れた、口惜しさと……提督の船を\n護れなかった後悔が……、私たちをこの場: The bitterness of being defeated by the monsters, and the regret of failing to protect the Admiral's ship… that's what's keeping us stuck here, I think.
m920048.（そして私たちが敗れれば、\n私の力など大したものではないと、\n彼女たちもわか: (And if we fall, they'll see my power was never that great.)

m920110.――あれ？\n王子、向こうにいるのって確か……。: —Huh? Prince, I think they're over there…
m920110.――お疲れ様、王子。\n巨人たちを撃退してくれて、本当にありがとう。: —Good work, Prince. Thank you for driving the giants back.
m920110.――ぐがぁああぁああッ！！\nま……まだだ、まだ倒れるわけにはゆかぬ……ッ！: ――Gugaaah!! I… I can't… I won't fall yet…!
m920110.――って、なによこれ？\n地面が穴だらけになってるじゃない。: ――What's this? The ground's riddled with holes.
m920110.――へへーん、一番乗り～っ！\nさぁ～て、このあたしが報告にあった\n天使同士の: ――Hehe, I'm first! Now then, I'll quickly settle that little angelic quarrel I was told about… huh?
m920110.――やはり来たか、目障りな人間どもめ。\nだが、これ以上貴様らに\n『卵』の捜索: ――So they finally show up, you annoying humans. But I won't let you keep interfering with our search for the “egg.”
m920110.――セフィーレ様、観念なさってください。\nこれ以上、我らから逃げられるとお思い: ――Lady Sephire, accept your fate. Do you really think you can escape from us any longer?
m920110.――ッ！\nあのギガースが掲げているのは、まさか――！:
—!
That Gigars is holding… could it be—!
m920110.――ッ！？\n王子、向こうに凄く大きい巨人みたいな魔物がいます！\nあれって、ま: —! Prince, there's a massive giant-like monster over there! Could it be…?
m920110.――地を這う者どもよ、ひれ伏すがいい。\n我らが救い主、ヘカトンケイル様が遂に降: —Crawlers of the earth, bow before us. Our savior, Lord Hecatoncheir, has finally descended.
m920110.――王子、来ます！ 敵を迎え撃ちましょう！: —Prince, I'm coming! Let's meet the enemy head-on!
m920110.――神獣の威力を披露しようと言うのですか。\n……本格的な侵攻に先立ち、\n小手: —So you intend to demonstrate the divine beast's power? …It's just a preliminary test before the full-scale invasion.
m920110.――総員、進撃！ 今こそ千年の恨みを晴らす時ぞ！\nこの白き大地を人間どもの血で:
—All units, advance! Now is the time to settle a millennium-long grudge!
We'll stain this white earth red with human blood!!
m920110.――違うよ、ルミアンくん！\nたとえ戦場には出ていなくても、\nルミアンくんは一: —No, that's not true, Lumian! Even if you weren't on the front lines, you still fought with us!
m920110.…………いえ、案外その通りかもしれませんね。\n至高の存在であらせられる主が、意: …No, perhaps that's exactly right. The supreme being, the Master, wouldn't place me in this situation without purpose.
m920110.…………いた。\n王子、巨人たちだ。こっちに向かってくるぞ。:
…There they are.
Prince, giants. They're heading this way.
m920110.…………えへへ、ありがとうございます。\nそれじゃあ、担当する作業が終わって師匠:
……… Hehe, thank you.
Then, once I finish my assigned work and get the master's permission, I'll head to the kingdom right away!
m920110.……あの、ルミアンくん？\nそんな風に馬の後ろに隠れられると……。:
Um, Lumian...?
If you keep hiding behind the horse like that...
m920110.……あらためて、さっきはありがとう。\nそれと、私たちの国……都市国家の\n要請:
...Again, thank you for earlier.
And also for answering our city-state's request and rushing here.
m920110.……ありがとう、王子。また助けられたね。: …Thank you, Prince. You saved me again.
m920110.……ありがとうございます。\nボク、もう逃げてもいいんですね……？: …Thank you. So I can just run away now…?
m920110.……ううん。\n私一人だったら、敵は倒せても\nこの子を無傷で守り抜くのは難しか: …No. If I were on my own, I could've taken down the foes, but keeping this child safe would've been impossible.
m920110.……うむ、そろそろ引き上げるとしよう。\nヘカトンケイル様の御力の一端を知ること: …Hmm, it's about time we withdraw. We've gotten a glimpse of Lord Hecatoncheir's power—just that alone is a worthy harvest.
m920110.……え、お風呂は女の人と一緒でいいか？\nも、もうっ！ 何度も言ってますけど、\:
…Um, can I share a bath with a woman?
Ugh, seriously! I've told you a hundred times—I'm a proper girl!
m920110.……ご存知かもしれませんけど、巨人たちは\n都市国家の周辺は自分たちの土地だって: …As you may know, the giants claim the lands surrounding the city-states are theirs and are determined to reclaim them by any means.
m920110.……すみません、勝手な話ですよね。\nでも、ボクたちには他に頼れるものもなくて…:
…Sorry, that's presumptuous of me.
But we have no one else to rely on…
m920110.……そうか。\nここまで来たということは、\n我らの同胞の屍を踏み越えてきたのだ:
…I see.
Since you've come this far, you must have stepped over the corpses of our kin.
m920110.……そうだ。お礼に今度、一緒に天馬に乗りませんか？\n一人で乗るのは難しくても、:
…Speaking of which, as a thank-you, would you ride a celestial steed with me sometime?
Even if you can't ride solo, if you just sit on my back I'm sure you'll be fine!
m920110.……だとすると、どうして巨人たちは\n先ほどの地では徹底的に捜索していったのに、: …If that's true, then why did the giants conduct a thorough search at the previous site, but withdrew here midway?
m920110.……で、でもでもっ！\nボクが案内しないともっと多くの人たちが傷つくし、\n王子: …But! If I don't guide them, more people will get hurt, and I've heard the Prince is incredibly strong.
m920110.……でしたら、\n私たちの国に身を寄せるというのはいかがでしょうか？: …Then, how about taking refuge in our country?
m920110.……ですが、その人間たちに救われたのもまた事実。\nこの白き翼の誇りにかけて、\: …But it's also true that those humans saved me. On the honor of my white wings, I'll repay that debt someday… Farewell.
m920110.……でも、そのご提案はお断りします。\n巨人たちが『卵』を探してる場所に少しでも: …But I'll have to decline that. To get to where the giants are hunting for the “egg” as fast as possible, we'll need my knowledge of the roads.
m920110.……とにかく、次の地へ向かいましょう。\nルミアンさん、引き続き案内をお願いいた: …Anyway, let's head to the next area. Lumian, please continue guiding us.
m920110.……どうやら、そう都合良くはいかないみたいですね。\n皆さん、巨人が来ます。戦闘: …It seems things won't go that smoothly. Everyone, the giant's on its way. Prepare for battle.
m920110.……なぜ助けたのですか？\n主の使いとして貴方たち人間と敵対していた私を。: …Why did you save me? As the Master's envoy, I was opposing you humans.
m920110.……なるほど。\nルミアンが巨人の出現した地域に詳しいのは、\n鍛冶屋としての人: …I see. So Lumian knows the region where the giants showed up because of his blacksmith contacts.
m920110.……ふぅ、いい汗かきましたねぇ。: …Phew, we've worked up a good sweat, haven't we?
m920110.……ふふっ。\nこんな小さな坊やが頑張ってるんだもの。\n私たちも頑張って巨人を: …Heh. That little brat's really giving it his all. We should do our part and take down those giants too.
m920110.……まぁいい。どのみちこの地は外れらしい……。\nとなれば……『卵』が眠る可能性: …Well, whatever. This place seems to be on the outskirts anyway… So then… of all the places an “egg” might be sleeping, the only region we haven't searched is the deep-snowed north…
m920110.……また人間どもか。\n大人しく鳥かごの中で震えて暮らしておれば、\n家族や同胞: …Humans again. If you just sit quietly trembling in a birdcage, I'll kill you along with your family and comrades.
m920110.……わかりました。\nそれでは皆さん、行きましょう。\n倒れた巨人たちを踏み越え: …Understood. Then everyone, let's go. We'll step over the fallen giants and move forward.
m920110.……わかりました。\nルミアンさん、雪原への案内はお任せいたします。\n負傷した: …Very well. Lumian-san, we'll leave the snowfield guidance to you. As soon as the wounded are treated, we'll head out right away.
m920110.……ルミアン、無理しないでいい。\n王子たちのところに行きたいのはわかってる。: …Lumian, you don't have to push yourself. I know you want to go to the princes' side.
m920110.……ルミアン。\n私の大事な友人で、今回の件の協力者。: …Lumian. My dear friend, and a partner in this whole affair.
m920110.……ルミアンさん、ここまでご案内いただき\n本当にありがとうございました。: …Lumian, thank you so much for guiding us this far.
m920110.……主よ、私をお導きください。\n私はこれからどうすればよいのでしょうか……。: …Master, guide me. What am I to do from here…?
m920110.……人間たちを確認。\n神の命を妨げんとする愚かな者たちよ、\n貴方たちも共に粛: …Human presence confirmed. Foolish ones who would defy the will of God, we shall purge you as well.
m920110.……実に度し難いですね、人間は。お生憎様ですが、\n貴方たちの国に身を寄せるつも: …How infuriating, humans. I'm sorry, but I have no intention of seeking shelter in your land.
m920110.……巨人たちがなにを探しているにせよ、\n捜索は相当真剣に行われている、というこ: …Whatever the giants are after, they're searching for it with serious intent.
m920110.……息絶えたか。\nしかし、大変なことになってしまったね。: …They're dead, then. But this has become a serious mess.
m920110.……悔しいけど、今の都市国家の戦力では\n神獣ヘカトンケイルを加えた巨人の勢力に: …It's frustrating, but with the city-state's current forces, taking on the giants—including the divine beast Hecatoncheir—on our own is going to be tough.
m920110.……我々が以前、都市国家の軍と協力して\n進撃してきた巨人族を撃退したことを契機: …Ever since we teamed up with the city-state troops and drove back the giants, they've changed their invasion tactics and started searching for something…?
m920110.……残念だけど、その可能性は高いと思う。\n確かにヘカトンケイルは神によってつく:
…It's a shame, but I think that's likely.
Sure, Hecatoncheir is a kind of god-made beast, but its flesh is forged from giant blood and meat.
m920110.……気になるかい？\nこの辺りの地面がこうも深く掘り起こされていることが。: …Curious, aren't you? How the ground here has been dug so deep.
m920110.……王子、先を急ごう。\n確実なことはまだ判らないけど、\n巨人たちにその捜し物: …Prince, we need to hurry onward. We don't know for sure yet, but if the giants find what they're after, it'll be disastrous.
m920110.……王子、巨人たちが捜索をしていたと思われる\n坑道の奥の地面を確認してきたぞ。: …Prince, I've checked the far end of the tunnel where the giants were searching.
m920110.……確かに巨人の群れが見えますね。\n壁の薄い箇所を突破してきたのでしょうか。: …Sure enough, a herd of giants can be seen. They must've broken through a weak spot in the wall.
m920110.……神獣ヘカトンケイル。\n千年戦争の時……神と巨人との戦いで\n巨人に味方した: …The divine beast Hecatoncheir. During the Millennium War… it's said that in the war between the gods and the giants, the divine beasts sided with the giants…
m920110.……貴様らか、\n各地で我らの邪魔をしていた人間どもというのは。: …You lot, the humans who've been meddling with us everywhere.
m920110.……道もよくわからないのに、\nたった一人で雪原へ行き、巨人と戦うというのですか: …You don't even know the way, and you plan to go alone into the snowfield to fight a giant?
m920110.……雪が深くなってきましたね。\nルミアンさん、雪原とはこの辺りのことでしょうか:
…The snow's getting deeper.
Lumian, does “snowfield” refer to around here?
m920110.「裏切りの神獣」――そう呼ばれる所以だ。\nだから、復活を果たしたヤツらが巨人た: That's why they call it the “Traitorous Divine Beast.” So it wouldn't be surprising if the revived ones fought alongside the giants to wipe out humanity.
m920110.あ、ありがとうございます。\n……でも実はボク、致命的に乗馬の才能がないんです。:
Ah, thank you.
…But actually, I'm hopeless when it comes to riding.
m920110.あ、えと……ここが巨人たちが\nなにかを探してたっていう噂があった場所です。: Ah, um… this is the spot where rumors say the giants were searching for something.
m920110.あ、エレーヌから聞いたんですか？\nえへへ、ボクの師匠がそう決めたんです。: Ah, you heard that from Elene? Hehe, my master decided that.
m920110.ああ。神獣の卵が巨人の手に渡ったのは痛手だが、\nそうと知っていれば対策の立てよ: Yeah. Losing the divine beast's egg to the giants was a blow, but now we know that, we can devise a countermeasure. Lumian, because of you many lives will be saved, you hear?
m920110.あとはヘカトンケイル様を復活させられれば、\n我らの領土を人間どもから取り戻す上: All that's left is to revive Lord Hecatoncheir, and there'll be no obstacle left in reclaiming our lands from those humans… Ahahaha!
m920110.あれは――セフィーレ？\nなぜ彼女が他の天使たちに襲われているんだ？: That's—Sephire? Why is she being attacked by the other angels?
m920110.あわわわ……まだ追いかけてくる。\nごめんねエレーヌ。ボク、足手まといで……。:
Oh dear… they're still chasing.
Sorry, Elene. I'm just a hindrance…
m920110.い、いいんですか！？\nありがとうございますっ！ えへへ……天馬かぁ♪:
R-really?!
Thank you so much! Hehe… a celestial steed, huh♪
m920110.いえ、いいんです。\n馬には乗れなくても、ボクは鍛冶職人として\n馬具や騎兵の方:
No, it's fine.
Even if I can't ride, I can still forge tack and weapons for the cavalry as a blacksmith.
m920110.う、うん……ごめんね、いつも助けてもらってばっかりで。: Uh, yeah… sorry, I always get rescued…
m920110.う、ぐぅッ……そうか、思い出したぞ……。\n貴様らは以前、我らの領土奪還を妨害し: Ugh… right, I remember now… You lot are that army of the human hero who once interfered with us reclaiming our territory…
m920110.うぅ……吹雪になってしまいましたね……。\nこれだけ見通しが悪いと、\n遠くの敵: Ugh… the blizzard's rolled in… With visibility this bad, hitting distant enemies is going to be tough…
m920110.うぅ……寒い。\n闇雲に探していたら凍え死んじゃいそうですぅ……。:
Ugh… it's cold.
If I keep wandering around like this I'll freeze to death…
m920110.うぐッ……な、ならぬ……ッ！\n幾度も捜索隊を送り……此度の捜索で初めて、\nこ: Ugh… no… this can't be… We've sent out search parties countless times, and only this time have we finally pinpointed the location of the “egg” hidden in this frozen wasteland…
m920110.うげっ、こっちに向かってきた！\n仕方ないわね……王子、やっちゃいましょ！: Ugh, they're coming this way! Can't be helped… Prince, let's do this!
m920110.うわっ、そんな騒ぐなって。\n馬がびっくりするだろ？: Whoa, don't make such a fuss. You'll scare the horses!
m920110.うん……来てくれて本当にありがとう。\n詳しいことは、後でルミアンが説明する。: Yeah… thank you so much for coming. Lumian will explain the details later.
m920110.え、えと……大昔に封印された巨人の中には、\n魔法でできた氷のハンマーを振り回し: Uh, well… legend says that ages ago a sealed giant wielded a magical ice hammer, freezing any enemy nearby…
m920110.え、えと……巨人たちは最近、何かを探すような活動を\n都市国家の周囲を初めとする:
Um… lately the giants have been roaming around, searching for something, starting around the city-state and elsewhere…
Because of that, there's damage everywhere.
m920110.え、さっきのが一度に何体も攻めてくるんですか？\nそれってかなり深刻な事態なので: Wait, they could attack with multiple at once? That's a pretty serious situation…?
m920110.え、騎兵の皆さんが戦うところを見られるんですか？\nわぁ……っ！ ぜひ、ぜひお願: What? We get to watch the cavalry fight? Wow…! Please, please, I'd love that!
m920110.えぇっ、ボクが！？\nうぅ、うまく説明できるかな……。: What? Me!? I… I hope I can explain it properly…
m920110.ええ、とてもご立派でしたよ。\n……それでは皆さん、ひとまず帰還して\n今回の戦: Indeed, you were all splendid. …Now, everyone, let's return and report our victory to the city-state officials.
m920110.ええ。それに事情はよくわかりませんが、\n集団で一人を虐げることが\n良いことで: Yes. Though I don't fully understand the situation, there's nothing good about a group oppressing a single individual.
m920110.えと……ボクは城壁の強化や武具の準備の\nお手伝いを通じてエレーヌたちに協力する: Um… I plan to help Elene and the others by assisting with fortifying the walls and preparing equipment.
m920110.え？ あ、あの……ボク、坊やじゃなくて……。: Huh? Uh, um… I'm not a kid…
m920110.お……思い出しました！\nフロストジャイアントは吹雪の時に\n力を増すっていう言: I… just remembered! There's a legend that Frost Giants grow stronger during a blizzard…
m920110.おかげさまで、各地での被害報告は沈静化した。\nいずれ来る巨人の侵攻に向けて、\: Thanks to you, the damage reports from across the lands have calmed down. With the next giant invasion looming, our city-state's forces will be strengthening our defenses.
m920110.おそらく巨人の足音でしょう。\n彼らが捜索をしている地はそう遠くはなさそうですね:
That must be the giant's footsteps.
The place they're searching doesn't seem that far away.
m920110.く、苦しいどころか死んじゃいますよ！\n早く逃げましょう……ね、ね？: It's not just terrible, we'd die! Let's get out of here… okay?
m920110.くっ……なぜ同じ天使である貴方たちが\n私を滅ぼそうとするのですか？: Damn… Why are you, fellow angels, trying to destroy me?
m920110.ぐははははっ！ ハハハ、馬鹿め……グフッ！！\nせ、雪原には既に……別の部隊が、: Guhahaha! Hahaha, you fool… Guff!! But the snowfield already has… another unit securing the egg…
m920110.ぐふッ……ば、馬鹿め……ッ。\n貴様らが我らとの戦いに心血を注いでいる間に、\n:
Guh… you fool…!
While you were pouring your heart into fighting us, the “egg” was already taken away by someone else…
m920110.ぐッ……きょ、巨人どもめ……。\nこれ以上、街道の治安を乱させは……うぐッ……。: Guh… those damn giants… They can't keep disrupting the road's safety any longer… ugh…
m920110.こ……怖いですっ……。\n脚はガクガクしてるし、心臓は破裂しそうだし、\nおしっ: I… I'm scared… My legs are shaking, my heart feels like it'll burst, I might even wet myself, but…
m920110.こう見えてボク、鍛冶師の見習いなんですけど、\nボクが修行をさせてもらってる工房:
I may look like this, but I'm actually an apprentice blacksmith.
My master at the workshop was attacked by a giant right before my eyes and suffered terrible injuries…
m920110.ここで逃げたらボク、きっと後悔すると思うから！\n任せてください！ 雪原には前に: If I run away now, I'll definitely regret it! Leave it to me! I've been to the snowfield before, so I can guide us on the shortest route!
m920110.この子は私より、\n巨人が出現した場所の情報に詳しいから。\n……あとは頼んだよ:
He knows more than I do about where the giants appeared.
…That's all, Lumian.
m920110.この機を逃すわけにはゆかぬ……ッ！\n同胞たちよ……我ら巨人族の悲願成就のため、: I can't let this chance slip away… Fellow giants… for the fulfillment of our race's greatest wish, we'll become a wall and block the enemy's path…!
m920110.これはきっと、私に課せられた試練なのでしょう。\nであるならば、未だ死ねと命じら: This must be a trial placed before me. Since I haven't been ordered to die yet, I must keep living and endure until I grasp the Master's will…
m920110.ご、ごめんなさい。\nでも、ボク……巨人がたくさん\n出てくるって思うだけで、怖:
S-sorry.
But I... just thinking a bunch of giants are coming out scares me...
m920110.ご、ごめんなさい。大好きな馬と騎兵さんたちが\nたくさんいるのを見たら、つい興奮: S-sorry… Seeing so many horses and cavalry I love just gets me all excited…
m920110.さぁね。自分で考えたらいいんじゃない？: Well, I guess you should figure it out yourself.
m920110.さて……探せ、サイクロプスども。\n草の根を掻き分けてでも見つけるのだ。: Now then… Search, you cyclopes. Even if you have to tear through the grass roots, find it.
m920110.しかし、そう考えると巨人どもは\n複数体のヘカトンケイルの復活とともに\n都市国: That means the giants could launch an invasion with several revived Hecatoncheir along with it.
m920110.しかし妙だな……。\n彼女ほどの実力者なら、あの程度の群れくらい\n一人でも強引: But it's odd… Someone as strong as her should be able to push through a swarm like that on her own.
m920110.すぅ～、はぁ～、すぅ～、はぁ～……。\n……ふぇっ？ も、もうボクが話す番なの？:
*pant* *pant* …
…Huh? Is it my turn to speak now?
m920110.すみません、ルミアンさん。\n騎兵の訓練を見せて差し上げたかったのですが。: Sorry, Lumian. I wanted to show you our cavalry training.
m920110.そ……そっか。\nごめんね、辛い記憶を思い出させちゃって。:
I see…
I'm sorry I brought up a painful memory.
m920110.そ、そんな……間に合わなかったなんて。: No, no… we didn't make it in time.
m920110.そ、そんなぁ……。\n巨人を相手にするだけでも大変なのに、\nヘカトンケイルまで:
No, that can't be…!
Even fighting giants is hard enough, but now they're bringing Hecatoncheir into the fray…
m920110.そ、尊敬だなんて……。\nえへへ、そんなこと言われたの久しぶりかも。: Me—me, looking up to someone…? Hehe, it's been a while someone's said that to me.
m920110.そういえば、ルミアンさんの働いている工房は\n都市国家の軍に自主的に協力している: Speaking of that, I heard your workshop voluntarily assists the city-state's army, right?
m920110.そういえば、今回ご依頼頂いた件は\n各地を荒らしている巨人たちの\n撃退というこ: Now that you mention it, the request you gave us was to drive back the giants that have been ravaging the region, right?
m920110.そうか……これで二つのことが判明した。\nひとつは、巨人たちが捜していた物は\n: I see… That clears up two things. First, the thing the giants were after was indeed the egg of the divine beast Hecatoncheir.
m920110.そうも言ってられないんじゃないかな。\n天使たちが主の命令で動いていると言ってい: I don't think we can just stand by. If the angels are acting on the Master's orders, staying alone would almost certainly invite another attack.
m920110.そこに我らが救い主、『ヘカトンケイル』様の\n残るひとつの『卵』があるはず……。: There should be one “egg” there, the egg of our savior, Lord Hecatoncheir…
m920110.そしてもうひとつ、卵は複数あるらしい。\nその中の幾つかは既に巨人たちの手に渡っ: And second, there are multiple eggs. Some have already fallen into the giants' hands, and the remaining ones are in the northern snowfield—right?
m920110.そのことが巨人たちの捜し物に\n関係してるかもしれない、ってエレーヌが言ってまし: Elene suggested that this might be connected to whatever the giants are searching for.
m920110.そのようだ。そして巨人どもがヘカトンケイルの\n卵を複数手に入れているという予想: Seems so. And the theory that the giants have obtained multiple Hecatoncheir eggs now appears confirmed.
m920110.その人は命からがら逃げ出したそうなんですけど、\nそのあと巨人たちが大勢奥に行く: He barely escaped with his life, and then saw a huge group of giants heading deeper inside…
m920110.その結びつきのためか、かつての巨人との戦いで\n投入された際も、ヘカトンケイルは: Because of that bond, when Hecatoncheir was first deployed in the war against the giants, it betrayed the heavens and sided with the giants.
m920110.それに、ルミアンは王子たちと一緒にいたことで\n前よりもずっと成長した……強くな: And you've grown a lot stronger just by being with the princes… you're far beyond where you started.
m920110.それはそうですけど、もし負けたら……。: That's true, but if we lose…
m920110.そんな……。主よ、お答えください。\n貴方はなぜ私をお見捨てになるのですか？: That… Master, answer me. Why have you abandoned me?
m920110.そんなボクが他の国の人たちを\n巨人と戦わせるために案内するなんて……。\nうぅ: The thought of me leading people from other nations to fight giants… ugh… just thinking makes me shake…
m920110.だから……王国に行って王子たちの軍の戦力増強に\n努めてもらった方が、ルミアン自: So… sending you to the kingdom to help bolster the princes' army will aid your own growth and raise our overall strength against the giants, I think.
m920110.だから、ボクも大切な人たちを守るために\n心臓を捧げると誓います！\nエレーヌが: So I'll swear to offer my heart to protect those important people—just like Elene always says.
m920110.だからその、前に巨人たちに襲われた時に\n協定？ を結んでくださった王国の人たち: So, when we were attacked before, we made an agreement with the kingdom people who helped us, and it was decided they'd deal with the giants…
m920110.だからボク、正直に言うと巨人がすごく怖くて……。: So honestly, I'm terrified of giants…
m920110.だが、くれぐれも気をつけることだな。\nもし『卵』を見つけても、それを傷つけたら: But be careful. If you happen to find an “egg,” and you damage it… hmm?
m920110.だろうね。\n彼らがそこまで真剣に探すものが\n一体なんなのか、実に興味深いね。: I'd say so. It's fascinating to wonder what could be worth that much trouble for them.
m920110.ち、小さくなんかないですよぅ！\nっていうかボク、坊やじゃなくてぇ――: I-I'm not small at all! Besides, I'm not a brat—
m920110.ついに……ついに見つけたぞ。\nこれで三つの『卵』が我らの手に……！:
Finally… finally I've found it.
Now the three “eggs” are in our hands…!
m920110.で、ですからボクは男の子じゃ――: Well, you see, I'm not a boy—
m920110.で、でもっ！ 神獣の卵が巨人の手に渡る前に\n止めないと、ルミアンくんの国が――: B-But! If we don't stop the divine-beast egg from falling into the giants' hands, your country, Lumian-kun—
m920110.でしたら、もし王子たちがよければ\n今から私たちと模擬戦をしませんか？\nそうす: Then, if the princes are willing, how about a mock battle right now? That way you can see us cavalry in action.
m920110.ですから……お願いします、王子様。\nボク……なんでもします。一生懸命案内します:
So… please, Your Highness.
I'll do anything. I'll guide you with all my heart.
Please help us defeat the giants.
m920110.ですから、そういう物が必要になったら\nぜひともお力にならせてください。\nボク:
So, if you ever need anything like that, please let me help.
The spears and tack I make have a pretty good reputation, you know?
m920110.ですが、ここから先は今までとは\n別次元の危険が待ち受けていると思われます。: But beyond this point, a danger unlike anything we've faced awaits.
m920110.ですが、倒さなければ先へは進めません。\n王子、なんとしても巨人たちを倒し、\n: But we can't move forward unless we take them down. Prince, we have to defeat those giants at any cost and stop the divine beast's egg from falling into their hands!
m920110.ですが、先ほどのギガースの口ぶりからすると\n近日中に大規模な襲撃が行われる恐れ: But judging from Gigars' tone earlier, a large-scale assault may come soon. We can't let our guard down…
m920110.ですが、神獣とは神によってつくり出された存在の筈。\n仮に卵から復活したとして、:
But a divine beast should be a creation of the gods.
Even if it hatches from an egg, would Hecatoncheir act according to the giants' wishes?
m920110.では、この奥に巨人たちが……。: So, the giants are back there...
m920110.でも、見たところ巨人らしき影は見えませんね。\nもう立ち去った後なんでしょうか…: But I don't see any sign of a giant. They must've left already… huh?
m920110.でも、都市国家の兵隊さんたちは\n国の防衛とか被害を受けた地域への支援で手一杯で: But the city-state soldiers are swamped with defending the country and aiding the damaged regions…
m920110.でもでも、乗るのはあんまり上手くなくて……。\nだから、えと……上手に馬に乗れる: But… I'm not very good at riding… So, I really look up to people who can ride like that!
m920110.とすると、聞いていたほど巨人が多くなかったのは、\n私たちが来る前に彼らの多くが: So, the fact there weren't as many giants as we heard might be because many of them had already paused their search and retreated before we got here.
m920110.とにかく、いまはできることをするしかありません。\n都市国家の人たちと協力し、来: In any case, all we can do now is act. Let's cooperate with the city-state folk and ready our defenses as best we can for the coming decisive battle.
m920110.とはいえ、前回の大きな襲撃があったあとは\n大掛かりな侵攻はなく、小競り合い程度: That said, after the last major raid, there hasn't been any large-scale invasion—just skirmishes, and a sort of uneasy calm has persisted.
m920110.どうやら敵も命懸けのようですね……。: Looks like the enemy's risking their lives too…
m920110.な……馬鹿なのですか、貴方は？\n人間の敵である私を陣中に招こうとするなんて。: W-…Are you stupid? You'd actually invite your enemy, a human, into the camp.
m920110.な、なによその態度は。\nせっかく助けてあげたっていうのに。: Wh-what's with that attitude? After we went out of our way to help you.
m920110.な、なにを愚かな……。\n主のご意思にない考えを持つなど――: Wh-what a foolish… To think I have thoughts not aligned with the Master's will—
m920110.なぜ、と言われましても……。\n大勢が一人を襲っているのを\n放っておくことなん: As for why… I can't just stand by while a crowd attacks one person.
m920110.なるほど……その子に王国を案内するついでに、\n私たち騎兵の訓練を見せてあげよう: I see… So you were planning to give the kid a tour of the kingdom and, in the process, let them watch our cavalry drills.
m920110.なるほど……鎧で身を守っていても\n鎧ごと魔法で氷漬けにされたら苦しいですね。: I see… Even if you're armored, being frozen solid with your armor on would be terrible.
m920110.なんだって！？\n……クソッ、謀られたか！:
What the—!
…Damn, we've been set up!
m920110.は、はい……といっても、雪原自体は\nかなり広い範囲に広がっているんですけど。: Y-yes… Though the snowfield itself stretches over a huge area.
m920110.は、はい。武具の修理とかをやっている関係で、\n巨人を見かけた警備隊の兵士さんや: Y-yes. Because I do weapon repairs, I often hear stories from the guard soldiers and adventurers who've run into giants…
m920110.はぁ……カッコよかったぁ♪\nこんな近くで騎兵の皆さんの\n勇姿を見られるなんて:
Ah… that was so cool♪
To be able to see the cavalry up close like that feels like a dream♪
m920110.はぁッ、はぁッ……やっと片付いたか。\n……よし、今のうちに神獣の卵を奪い返すぞ:
Haa— haa— finally it's over.
…Alright, while we have a chance, let's seize back the divine beast's egg!
m920110.はい……でも、\nこの辺りで採掘していた人が巨人に襲われて……。: Yes… but the miner around here was attacked by giants…
m920110.はい……でも、あいにく吹雪になりそうです。\n吹雪が起こると遠くの物が見づらくな: Yes… but unfortunately it looks like a blizzard's coming. When a blizzard hits, it's hard to see anything far away, so I hope we don't get ambushed right now…
m920110.ひッ……。\n巨人たちが、折り重なって道を塞いでいってる……。: Huh… The giants are piling up, blocking the road…

m920110.ひッ！ ま、魔物がこっちに……！: Huh! A monster's coming this way!
