Right then――let's get the plan started!!
m920159.ごめん、そんなのの封印解いちゃって。\n本当はひとりでアレを倒さないといけないの: I'm sorry for having broken its seal. I really should have been the one to defeat it on my own……
m920159.ごめん、みんな。力を貸してほしい。\nあのぬえを倒して、この里を助けてほしい。: I'm sorry, everyone. I need your help. Please defeat that Nue and save this village.
m920159.ごめんなさい、傷を負わせてしまったわね。: I'm sorry. We ended up hurting you.
m920159.そういうわけだから、よろしくね、王子？\n――ひとりでお風呂に入れないくらい、\:
So that's the situation. It's nice to meet you, Prince?
If you ever get scared enough that you can't take a bath alone,
just call us, okay♪
m920159.そうならないよう、\n人と妖怪の関係改善には全力を尽くしましょう。\nまずは憧憬:
So that doesn't happen,
let's do our best to improve relations between humans and youkai.
How about we start by going to a play together to eat some admiration?
m920159.そうね！\n妖怪たちの未来のため、じゃんじゃん畏れを刈り取るわよ！\nそれじゃ、:
That's right!

For the future of our kind, let's reap the fear!

Alright, on three♪
m920159.そうよ、ひとりでお風呂入れなくなるくらい、\nめっちゃくちゃ怖い目に合わせてやる:
That's right. I'm going to scare you so badly you'll never be able to take a bath alone again!
I'll start with that Prince over there!!
m920159.そこで何が起きたのか、どんな話をしたのか、\n定期的にヨユキに聞かせに来るの。\:
We'll come back regularly and tell you what happened,
what we saw, and what we talked about.
Don't you think that's a good idea?
m920159.それじゃ、アタシたちも村の防衛に行くわ。\nほらヨユキ、あなたも皆を手伝うの！: Then we'll go help defend the village. Come on, Yoyuki, you need to help everyone too!
m920159.それじゃあ、あっちの裏門は任せて。\nあやかしはんたー？ と呼ばれた実力、見せて: In that case, I'll take the back gate. Let me show you the skill that earned me the title of "Yokai Hunter."
m920159.それでは王子、シズカさん、\n情報を探りつつ都へ向かいましょう。:
Then, Prince, Shizuka,
let's head to the capital while we gather more information.
m920159.それならぁ、真正面から突破して、\nちゃんとお話する時間をつくらないとねー♪:
Well then, we'll just have to break through
head-on and make some time for a proper conversation~♪
m920159.それに、畏れに頼らず、\n妖怪が生きていける道を模索しているのだとか……？:
And you say you're exploring a way for youkai to live
without relying on humans' fear……?
m920159.それは確かに奇妙ですね。\n辻斬りといえば、刀の切れ味を試すために、\n通行人を:
That is certainly odd.

A highwayman is supposed to slash passersby to test the edge of his blade, isn't he?
m920159.それよりまずいよ。\nぬえが走っていった先、妖怪の隠れ里の方だ。:
That's not the worst part.
The Nue is heading toward the youkai's hidden village.
m920159.そんな……術式が間違って……？\nいや、違う……もうずっと畏れを摂取してないから:
No way… did I mess up the ritual…?
No, that's not it… it's because I haven't consumed any fear in a long time,
so my youkai powers have weakened…
m920159.そんなの許せないって言ったのは、\nやぎょーちゃんのヨユキ、あなたじゃないの！:
The one who said she couldn't stand that
was Yagyo-chan, Yoyuki, wasn't it!
m920159.そんな悪人が、自分の姿を見た被害者を、\n生きたままにするなんて、ありえないです: It's impossible for such a villain to leave his victims alive after they've seen his face.
m920159.ただの暴れん坊ならまだしも、\nおまんまの元である人間サマを食い殺しちゃいただけ: If it were just a troublemaker, I could let it slide, but it absolutely must not be allowed to devour the humans who are our source of sustenance. We youkai are meant to frighten without killing. That is the way of things.
m920159.だ、だって、人間を脅かす以外の目的で、\n人間に話しかけるの初めてなんだもの……:
B-But, it's just that this is the first time we've talked to humans
for a reason other than scaring them…
m920159.だからこそ、ボクらが「人に敵対した妖怪」として、\nうまく一緒に歩んでいけるか示:
That's exactly why we, as "youkai who oppose humans,"
need to show that we can walk this path together successfully.
m920159.でも、そうじゃないかもしれない。\n本当に妖怪と人間が一緒に生きてける未来を作る:
But maybe not.
If we're truly serious about creating a future where youkai and humans can live together,
we have to resolve those kinds of conflicts too.
m920159.でも、弱い妖怪を見捨てるようなことはしてないの！\nそのために、妖怪が生きていく:
But they are not abandoning weak youkai!
That's why they are trying to find a source of sustenance for youkai
other than fear.
m920159.となれば、今後も辻斬りを繰り返す可能性が高いわね。\n王子、私は急いで都に戻るけ:
If that's the case, there's a high chance they'll continue their attacks.
Prince, I'm going to rush back to the capital, but—
m920159.なっ……あ、危ないぞ、そんな鎌を持ち出しちゃ。\nだから――こ、こらやめろ！\n:
Wha— oh, watch out, don't pull out a sickle like that.
I'm telling you— hey, stop it!
If you point that blade at me, it's dange— ughhh!
m920159.なるほどね……。\nこれはますます、\nあの子たちと話をしないといけなくなったわ:
I see…….
Looks like I really do need to have a talk with them.
m920159.ぬ、ぬえまで王国に恭順しているの……？\nどれだけ絶望的な戦いなのこれ……。:
Even the Nue is submitting to the Kingdom…?
How hopeless is this battle…
m920159.ぬえの妖力が消えていきます。\n完全に消滅したかは分かりませんが、\nもうこの里:
The Nue's youkai power is fading away.
I can't say for certain if it's completely gone,
but it shouldn't be able to appear in this village again.
m920159.ぬえを倒したら、ぬえに褒められるなんてね……。\nふふ、結構愉快じゃない王国って:
So we defeated the Nue, and now the Nue is praising us……
Heh, what a rather amusing kingdom this is♪
m920159.ぬらりひょんと人間が、弱い妖怪たちを見捨てて、\n平和な道を歩もうと言うのなら…:
If Nurarihyon and the humans are going to leave
the weak youkai behind and walk the path of peace…….
Then we have to fight, too.
m920159.ぬらりひょんと王国が手を結び、\n人と妖怪が手を取る世界が訪れつつあるいま、\n:
With Nurarihyon and the Kingdom joining forces,
and a world where humans and youkai work together drawing near,
weak youkai have no choice but to vanish in silence.
m920159.ね、ねぇ、あのぬえ……暴走してないかしら！？: Hey, hey, is that Nue… going out of control?!
m920159.はぁ、ヨユキって本当に後ろ向きよねぇ。\nそんな風だから、異界の妖怪なんかにたぶ: Haa, Yoyuki, you're such a pessimist. It's because you're like that that you get played by youkai from other worlds, and end up breaking the seal on a rampaging Nue like that!
m920159.はぁ？ そんなナヨナヨでヘニャヘニャな\nやぎょーちゃんを放って逃げるはずないわ:
Hah? We're not leaving that wimpy,
flimsy Yagyo-chan behind and running off!
m920159.は～、大活躍大活躍♪\nみなさんなかなかやりますなぁ♪:
Haa, what a performance, what a performance♪
You all did a splendid job♪
m920159.ひょーひょー♪\nどうやら話はまとまったようですな♪\nそれではツグミたちは、里:
Hee-hee♪
Looks like we've reached an agreement♪
Well then, Tsugumi and the others will head back to the village!
--- scene: story talk 1 ---
m920159.ふっふっふ、今日も「畏れ」が豊作ね！\nこれならやぎょーちゃんも大喜びよ！:
Fufufu, another bountiful harvest of "fear" today!

Yagyō-chan is going to be over the moon!
m920159.ふふっ、一緒に来てほしいってお願いするより前に\n頷かれると困っちゃうわね。:
Hehe, you're nodding before I even ask you to come with me.
That's a bit troublesome.
m920159.ふふっ、知ってるわ、そんなこと。\nヨユキは誰より優しくて――:
Hehe, I know. That's just how she is.
Yoyuki is the kindest person I know, and――
m920159.ふふん、アタシたちが食客になった以上、\n王国の財政はどんどん破綻していくから覚:
Heh, now that we've become your guests,
the kingdom's finances are going to go bankrupt. Just you wait!
m920159.まぁまぁ、お嬢さん。\nまずはその物騒な鎌をしまってはくれまいか。\n――さ、今:
Now, now, miss.
Please put away that dangerous sickle first.
—And, you'd best leave while you still can.
m920159.まだ、納得してないし、\n気持ちの整理もついてないし、それに、それに……。:
I'm not convinced yet,
and I haven't even sorted out my feelings. Besides, besides……
m920159.まっかせなさい！\n紫苑姉妹と夜行さん、ここにありよ！:
Leave it to us!
The Shizuka sisters and Yoko are right here!
m920159.まったく、里の子たちに先に食べさせてって言い張って、\n自分は全然畏れを食べない:
Honestly, she insisted on letting the village children eat first,
and didn't eat any fear herself, so of course this is what happens?
m920159.むぅ、まだ納得しないのね。\nじゃあこうしましょう。:
Hmph, you're still not convinced.
Then let's do this.
m920159.むっ、そうだったかしら？\nそれは後で謝らないといけないわね！:
Hmph, was that right?

I'll have to apologize to her later!
m920159.もちろん、ぬらりひょんは、\nそういう戦後処理まで含めて面倒を見てくれるのよね？: Of course, Nurarihyon is going to handle all the post-war cleanup, right?
m920159.やぎょーちゃんじゃないってば。\nでも……夜行さんの跡継ぎ娘失格ではあるかもね…:
It's not Yagyo-chan.
But…… I suppose I really am unworthy of being Yoko's successor.
m920159.やぎょーちゃんは思い込み激しいものね。\nでも、人一倍……妖怪一倍仲間想いなのよ:
Yagyoo-chan is a real stubborn one.
But she cares about her friends more than anyone else…… more than any other youkai?
m920159.よしよし、それじゃあささっと捜索して――っと、おや？: Alright, alright. Let's search the area quickly―wait, what's this?
m920159.ん？ どうしたんだい嬢ちゃんたち。\nははぁん、その名乗り、さては王子ごっこだな:
Hm? What's the matter, girls?
Hah, hearing that name, I'd say you're just pretending to be the Prince.
m920159.シマイ姉さま、やぎょーちゃんではなく、\n夜行さんのヨユキさんですよ。\n夜行さ:
Older sister Shimai, it's not Yagyō-chan,

it's Yūki from the Night Walkers.

"Night Walkers" is the name of the race.
m920159.ハハハ、そんな物騒な。\nただ王子たちの到着まで雑談し、時間を稼いだだけですぞ。:
Hahaha, don't be so tense.
I was just chatting to kill time until the Prince's party arrived.
m920159.ヨユキ、あなたは誤解してるの。\nぬらりひょんと人間が手を結んだのは本当だし、\:
Yoyuki, you're misunderstanding.
It's true that Nurarihyon and the humans have joined forces,
and they are truly seeking a future where humans and youkai live together.
m920159.ヨユキ、どうしてそんな後ろ向きなのよ！\nアタシたちは畏敬を集め、\n夜闇にまぎ:
Yoyuki, why are you so down in the dumps!
We're youkai who gather awe and
deceive people in the shadows of the night!
m920159.ヨユキが話をなかなか聞いてくれないから、\n説明できなかったんだけどね。:
Yoyuki wouldn't listen to a word I said,
so I couldn't really explain anything.
m920159.レンゲ、強がっててごめん。\n王子、だっけ？ あなたは気に入らないけど、\n今は:
Renge, I'm sorry for putting on a brave face.
Prince, was it? I don't exactly care for you,
but I won't attack you right now, so hurry home.
m920159.人間を散々攻撃したんだから、\n今更そんな、仲良しこよしなんてできないよ！:
We spent so much time attacking humans.
It's too late for us to just become friends now!
m920159.今は都の人々を守れただけでよしとしましょう。\n王国のシノビが後を追っていますか:
Let's be glad we managed to protect the city's people for now.
The Kingdom's shinobi are giving chase, so
I'm sure we'll find their base soon.
m920159.今後はアタシたち紫苑姉妹が、\n夜行さんのヨユキとの橋渡しになるわ。:
From now on, we, the Shiroyama Sisters,
will serve as the bridge between Nightwalker Yoyuki and the humans.
m920159.以前に戦った時に、もう少しだけ\n時間をくれないかって頼んではいたんだけど……。:
When we fought before, I did ask them
if they could give us a little more time…….
――I guess that time has finally run out.
m920159.何というのか、近所の子供が\n悪ふざけをしているように感じたというか……。:
It was more like……
a neighborhood kid playing a rough game.
m920159.妖怪が人を襲っているとなれば、\n王国も他人事ではありませんからね。:
If youkai are attacking people,
it's not an issue that the Kingdom can ignore.
m920159.妖怪とは人間の感情を喰らうもの。\nなれば畏れだけでなく、他の感情からも\n糧を:
Youkai are creatures that feed on human emotions.
If that's the case, perhaps we can draw sustenance
from emotions other than fear――
m920159.姉さま、こういう手合は話しても無駄ですわよ。\n――ほら、いつでも刀を抜くって顔:
Big sis, there's no point in talking to someone like that.
—Look at her face. She's ready to draw her blade at any moment.
m920159.姉さま、挨拶の仕方はさっき教えましたわ？\nこういう時はぺこりと頭をさげて――:
Big sister, didn't I just teach you how to greet people?
You're supposed to bow your head politely in a situation like this—
m920159.姉さまはこういうの大好きですから♪\n紫苑姉妹が三女、ヤタケ！:
Big sis loves doing that, you know♪

The Scythe Sisters' third, Yatake!
m920159.姉さん、もう少し優しい言い方を……。\nヨユキさんだって、皆のために戦っているん:
Sis, try to be a little kinder…….
Yoyuki-san is fighting for everyone, after all?
m920159.姉さん、一度ヨユキさんに相談しよう。\n王国が妖怪を潰す気になったなら、\nもう:
Sis, let's go talk to Yoyuki.
If the Kingdom decides to crush the youkai,
this is no longer something we can handle on our own.
m920159.姉さんは適当だなぁ……。\nまぁ反省会は後にして、次はあそこの人だかりを狙おうか:
You're so careless, big sis…

Well, we can save the self-reflection for later. Let's target that crowd over there.
m920159.我らかまいたち、紫苑姉妹っ！！: We are the Scythe Sisters, the Shiobara Sisters!!
m920159.敵がかまいたちとなれば、\nあの三人は連携して攻撃してくるはずです。\nそれぞれ:
If the enemy is the Scythe Sisters,
they'll definitely coordinate their attacks.
Since each of them acts independently, be careful!
m920159.斬って！ 転がして！ 治す！\nそれが我らかまいたち、紫苑姉妹なのよ！:
Cut! Toss! Heal!
That's what we, the Scythe Sisters, the Shiobara Sisters, do!
m920159.未熟な剣士が、うぬぼれて剣を振り回しているのか、\nあるいは何かの陰謀が隠されて:
Perhaps it's an unskilled swordsman showing off,

or maybe there's some kind of conspiracy behind it…
m920159.本当に助かりました……。\nまさかあんな女の子たちが\n鎌で襲いかかってくるなん:
Thank you so much for saving us…….
I never would have guessed those girls would
come at us with sickles…….
m920159.本当に助かりました……。\n鎌を向けられた時にはどうなるかと思ったものですが……:
You really saved us…….
When you were aiming those scythes at us, I thought it was all over…….
m920159.死者が出ていないとは言っても、\n斬られた被害者は痛いし、怖かったはずよ。:
Even if no one has died,

the victims must be in pain and terrified.
m920159.殺さなかったから許す、なんてわけにもいかない。\nみんな、絶対に犯人を捕らえまし:
We can't just let him go because he didn't kill anyone.

Everyone, we absolutely must catch this culprit.
m920159.気に食わない人間は、\n全部終わった後で恐怖させればいいのよ！！:
We can scare all the humans we don't like
after everything is over!!
m920159.無言で、自信満々に頷いて、\n人間も妖怪も全部助けちゃうの。:
He nods confidently without a word,
and ends up saving every human and youkai in sight.
m920159.王子、もしかしたら件の辻斬り犯かもしれません。\n急ぎ迎撃の準備をお願いします！:
Prince, this might be the highwayman we're looking for.

Please prepare for an ambush immediately!
m920159.王子が良いって言っても、レンゲが良いって言っても、\n襲われて、怖がらせられた人:
Even if the Prince says it's fine, even if Renge says it's fine,
the people who were attacked and terrified wouldn't see it that way.
m920159.畏れを刈り取る、なんて自分でいってるものね。\nあっ、作戦会議を始めたわ。:
"Reap the fear," huh. She's announcing it right out loud.

Ah, they're starting a strategy meeting.
m920159.知り合いっていうかなんていうか、\n同じかまいたちだから知ってるっていうかー……:
It's not exactly like we're friends, I guess...
We just know about them because we're both Scythe Sisters... Hm?
m920159.紫苑姉妹が――人里を襲いまくったばかりのアタシたちが、\nまずは偵察として人里の:
The Shiemi Sisters――us, who just finished raiding the human village――
will go check out the village first, as a sort of reconnaissance!
m920159.紫苑姉妹は皆を連れて先に逃げてて。\n王国軍の足止めはひとりで十分だから。:
Shizuka sisters, take everyone and go ahead.
I'll hold the Kingdom's forces back on my own.
m920159.紫苑姉妹は裏切らないの。\n誰かを助けると決めたなら、\nちゃんと助けるまで戦い:
The Shizuka sisters never betray.
Once we've decided to help someone,
we'll keep fighting until we've done it.
m920159.脅かし方が迷走してますわよ……？\nそろそろちゃんとご挨拶をですね……。:
Your threatening is getting a bit off track…?
You really ought to introduce yourselves properly…
m920159.遠くで悲鳴が聞こえたような……。\n――間違いない、これは戦場の匂いです。\n向:
I think I heard a scream from far away…

No doubt about it, I can smell a battlefield.

Something is coming our way!
m920159.関係ないわ。\n大義はアタシたちにあるんだから！\nさぁ、この都で大暴れして畏れ:
It doesn't matter.
We're on the right side of this!
Now then, let's cause a ruckus in this city and spread our fear!
m920159.魔王ガリウスを倒したっていうあの王子……？\nそれってヤバイんじゃない？\n姉さ:
The Prince who defeated the Demon King Garius...?
Isn't that dangerous?
Sis, let's run! Hurry!

m920214.――うおっ、なんじゃこの剣？\nおぉーい、ジュウベエ殿！\n何やら奇妙な剣が出て:
—Whoa! What is that sword?
Hey, Juubei!
A strange sword has turned up!
m920214.――うへ、うへへ。\nすごいなぁこれ、うわぁ、うわぁー♪:
――Heh, hehehe.
This is amazing, wow, wow—♪
m920214.――その果てに、\nすべての誤った文明を焼き尽くす者となった、でしょう？: —and in the end, they became the one who would burn away all misguided civilizations, right?
m920214.――それでも、あなたたちは求めますか？\nこの技術は確実に、戦乱の火種となります:
――Even so, do you still seek it?

This technology will inevitably become a spark of war.

Do you still desire what belongs to the future?
m920214.――それは、人類の歴史が始まった頃のこと。: —That was when the history of humanity began.
m920214.――た、助かりましたぁ……。\nもう溶岩は迫ってきてないですよね？:
――P, Phew…
The lava isn't closing in anymore, right?
m920214.――た、大変だ！\nトロッコが暴走してるぞー！！:
――H-help!
The mine carts are out of control!!
m920214.――ふふっ、ああ、もちろんだとも。\nさぁみんな、上層にぶっ飛ばすよ！:
――Heh, ah, of course.
Now then, everyone, let's launch you to the upper levels!
m920214.――ふふっ、王国にもいい剣士がいるじゃないか。\n次はいつ様子を見に行こうかな？:
――Fufu, the kingdom has some fine swordsmen, don't they.
I wonder when I'll go check on them next?
m920214.――ギャギャ……トロッコタノシイ……。\nブンメイバンザイ！ ブンメイバンザイ！: Long live civilization! Long live civilization!
m920214.――何を悩んでいるかと思えば、\nせっかく高性能な機関を手に入れたのに、\nそん:
??? : I was wondering what you were fretting over.
You've got your hands on a high-performance engine,
and you were stuck on something like that?
m920214.――同時に、知識を人類に与え、\n超古代文明が滅ぶ原因を作った神のひとり。:
—and at the same time, one of the gods who granted knowledge to humanity,
ultimately causing the downfall of the Hyper-Ancient Civilization.
m920214.――手加減するつもりが一切ないということです！\n王子、戦闘の指揮を！:
――She has no intention of holding back at all!

Prince, take command of the battle!
m920214.――来ましたか。\nオラティル、これは人類と私の問題ですよ？\n手を貸したりしな:
――So you've come.
Ollathair, this is a matter between humanity and me, alright?
Don't try to get involved.
m920214.――王都近郊\n超古代文明遺跡、発掘地点:
(narration): ――Outskirts of the Capital
Excavation site of a prehistoric ruin
m920214.――見事。\n人の身で、よくぞここまで剣を練り上げたね。:
――Magnificent.
For a mortal, you have honed your swordsmanship remarkably.
m920214.――証明してください。\n誤った力を御するだけの、正しき力を持つことを。:
――Prove it.
Prove that you possess the true power to control a false one.
m920214.――超古代文明の船、不時着したよ！\nよ、よし、見た感じ中身は無事みたい！:
The ship of the hyper-ancient civilization has crash-landed!
P-Phew, from what I can see, the cargo is intact!
m920214.…………あの、さきほどから、\nまるでここに、タカマガハラの神さまが\n遊びに来:
…………Um, from the start,
aren't you talking as if the gods of Takamagahara
had come here for a visit?
m920214.…………お、王子、私の感覚が\nおかしいのでしょうか？:
…………P, Prince, is my perception
off somehow?
m920214.…………かっこつけるだけつけて、\n全部の責任をひとりで負おうとしたのに、\nぜ:
...You put on such a brave front,
trying to bear all the responsibility alone,
and yet you've ruined it all.
m920214.…………そう、私の本気にまで、\n手を届かせる決意と力をもう持っているのですね。:
…………So, you already possess

the resolve and the power to reach even my true strength.
m920214.…………それだけの力があれば、\nいずれ亜神ディアスにも手が届くでしょう。: …………If you had that much power, you would eventually be able to reach even the Demi-God Dias.
m920214.…………早かった、ですね。\nこの船を溶かし切る前にたどり着いてしまうなんて。:
…………You're fast.

To reach us before I could finish melting this ship.
m920214.…………！ あいつの娘か！\n遠慮なく、全力で来るといい！:
………! So you're that man's daughter!
Don't hold back. Come at me with everything you've got!
m920214.……あの方が、人類に火を与えた亜神。: ……That being is the Demi-God who gave fire to humanity.
m920214.……あはは。\nお姉ちゃんくらいにしておきましょうよ。\nお母さんだと、色々口出:
……Hehe.
Let's settle on "big sister."
If I were your mother, I'd probably be sticking my nose into everything.
m920214.……えっ？ 何？ 誰！？\nここは発掘現場だから勝手に入ったら危ないぞ！:
…Huh? What? Who is it?
This is an excavation site! It's dangerous to just waltz in!
m920214.……お、おい！ 魔界アリまで出てきたぞ！？: …H-hey! Demon ants are coming out too!
m920214.……さすがにちょっとだけ、心が痛みました。: ……I suppose that did hurt a little.
m920214.……そうですね。\nそれでは世界を滅ぼした神の生き残りとして、\n私と共に、彼ら:
...I suppose so.
Then, as a survivor of the god who destroyed the world,
let us hear their answer together.
m920214.……それ、天界の神サマたち\nめちゃくちゃ怒ったんじゃない？: …Didn't the gods in the Heavens get really angry about that?
m920214.……な、慰めるつもりですか？\nそれはただの言葉遊びです。:
...Are you trying to comfort me?
That is just a clever turn of phrase.
m920214.……まぁ、落ちたら溶けちゃうけどね。\n皆気をつけて発掘のお手伝いするのよ？:
……Well, we would melt if we fell in, though.
Everyone, please be careful while helping with the excavation, okay?
m920214.……プロメ様の説得、できるのでしょうか。: ……Do you think we'll be able to talk Lady Prome out of this?
m920214.……一瞬も、迷うことなく答えますか。\n分かりました。ならばここで、\n私があな:
……You answer without a moment's hesitation.

I see. Then, here and now,

I will burn you all to ashes.
m920214.……何を言っても、無駄のようですね。\n分かりました。では、この先で待っています: ……It seems nothing I say will change your mind. Very well. I will be waiting for you ahead.
m920214.……俺たちと、共に歩んでくれないか。\n神と人ではなく、母と子として。:
……Will you walk this path with us?
Not as god and mortal, but as mother and children.
m920214.……証明？\nって、うわっ、何だこの振動！？:
……Prove it?
Wait, what is this shaking?!
m920214.……驚いた。\nプロメだけでなく、私まで救う気かい？:
...I am surprised.
You intend to save Prome, and me as well?
m920214.あ、あのぉ……この方はいったい……？: U-Um... who is this person, exactly...?
m920214.あ、あのっ！\n長話になるなら先に地上を目指しませんか？\n何だか、今にも崩れそ:
U-um!
If this is going to take a while, shouldn't we head for the surface first?
I've been hearing sounds like the place is about to collapse…!
m920214.ああ、さっきまでいましたよ？\n入れ違いでしたねぇ。:
Ah, yes, he was just here a moment ago?
We must have missed each other.
m920214.ああ、神話でもあのおふたりは仲が悪いですからねぇ。\n小さい頃、父にせがんで\n:
Ah, even in the myths, those two don't get along, do they?
As a child, I begged my father
and he often told me stories about them.
m920214.あっ……あの時出会った、亜神さまの……？: Ah… the one we met back then, the Sub-God's…?
m920214.あっ、あっ、ああぁぁぁあッ！！\nてめぇ！ どのツラ下げてここに来やがった！！:
Ah, ah, AAAAAGH!!
You! What gives you the right to show your face here!?
m920214.あっ、あー！！\nそれっ、溶かし、えっ、えぇ！？ もったいない！！:
Ah, ah-!!

There! Melting, wh-what?! That's a waste!!
m920214.あっ、この剣はもらっていくよ。\n見事な装飾……儀礼剣かな？\n実用性はないけど:
Ah, I'm taking this sword with me.
Beautiful ornamentation… A ceremonial blade, perhaps?
It's not practical, but it's quite a fine piece.
m920214.あっはっは、取れるものなら取りにおいで。: Ahaha, come and take it if you can.
m920214.あとは、きみがどう返事をするかだけだ。\n試練を乗り越えた以上、\n超古代文明の:
Now, it is up to you to decide.
Since they have passed the trial,
will you reluctantly hand over the legacy of the hyper-ancient civilization—
m920214.あなたが上層まで転送してくれたのですね。\nえぇと……確か、オラティル様でしたか:
So you teleported us up here.
Um… if I recall correctly, you were Ollathair, right?
m920214.あなたが愛した人類は、ちゃんと成長してる。\nかつての過ちを、もう一度繰り返した:
The humanity you loved is growing properly.

It will not repeat the mistakes of the past.
m920214.あなたが！ 片っ端から燃やして、溶かして、\n超古代文明そのものの痕跡を消してた:
It was you! You burned and melted everything,

erasing all traces of the Hyper-Ancient Civilization itself!
m920214.あなたは、あなたたちは、きっとそうなのでしょう。\nその強い決意が私にも、ちゃん:
You, all of you, are certainly that way.

I can feel that strong resolve reaching me.
m920214.あなたも、オラティルも、人類を甘く見すぎている。\n教わった知識がなくとも、超古:
You, and Ollathair, are underestimating humanity.
Even without the knowledge we were taught,
the people of the Hyper-Ancient Civilization must have known
that they held the power to destroy themselves.
m920214.あの火は近づくだけでも危険です！\nできれば遠くから無力化してください！:
That fire is dangerous just to approach!
Please neutralize it from a distance if you can!
m920214.あの船だ！\nあれが――浮上しようとしてる！！:
It's that ship!
It's――rising to the surface!!
m920214.あはは……自分勝手なこと言っちゃってるのは\nたぶんみんなも分かってるけどね。\:
Ahaha... I'm sure you all realize
how selfish this is.
But still, how should I put it? The fact that we met you two here—
m920214.あるいは、愛する子らを信じ、\nきみが彼らの世界に飛び込んでいくのか。:
Or will you trust your beloved children
and leap into their world?
m920214.あるいはプロメを――\nいや、これはきみたちが、\n自分で答えを見つけ出すべきも:
Or perhaps Prome—
No, that's something you
should find the answer to yourselves.
m920214.あれが……超古代文明の船。\nすごい、本当に飛ぶんだ……。:
That's it... the ship of the Hyper-Ancient Civilization.
Amazing... it really does fly...
m920214.あれが使えそうだ。\nやたらと頑丈で、あの図体で自壊しない軽さを持ち、\nその上:
??? : That sounds like it could work.
It's incredibly sturdy, light enough that it doesn't collapse under its own weight,
and it has a decent range of motion.
m920214.あれなるは伝説に語られる剣の亜神。\n天墜神星と激闘を繰り広げた、\n祓剣主神様:
That one is the Lesser Deity of Swords spoken of in legend.
It is undoubtedly Futsunushi-sama himself,
who engaged in a fierce battle with the Fallen God Star.
m920214.あれは……ゴブリン軍団の鉱夫？\nどうしたのかしら、ランタンなんか見つめて。:
Is that…… a miner from the Goblin Legion?
What's wrong with her? She's just staring at a lantern.
m920214.あれはまさか……。\n皆さん、彼らはランタンの火に魅入られているんです！:
Could it be……
Everyone, they're entranced by the lantern's flame!
m920214.あー……でも、これじゃまだ足りないかも……。: Ah… but this might still not be enough…
m920214.あー、こらこら。\n自己紹介より前に罵るから\nいつまでたっても友達できないんだ:
Oh, oh, hold on there.
You're insulting me before even introducing yourself.
No wonder you never make any friends.
m920214.あー、これ？ こういうこと？\n剣士が剣の呼び声に惹かれたとか？:
Ah, this? You mean this?
Like a swordsman drawn to the call of his blade?
m920214.いいや、それもあるけど、本命はこの後です。\n来た……この剣気、間違いありません:
No, that's part of it, but the real thing is coming up now.
It's here… I can feel the sword's aura. I'm certain of it.
Right now, in this place—
m920214.いえ、当時の航空艦の建造ドックであれば、\nその規模は都市ひとつにも及ぶものです:
No, if it were a construction dock for an airship from that era,
it would be on a scale comparable to an entire city.
m920214.いつか己を滅ぼすような選択をする、\nそんな人々が現れないとも限りませんが……。:
Though I can't rule out the possibility
that someday, some will make a choice
that leads to their own destruction...
m920214.いや、あちらも死合うつもりはなさそうです。\n純然たる腕比べとなれば、ここはひと:
No, he doesn't seem to want a deadly fight.
If it's purely a test of skill, then let us…
m920214.いや、レクテ嬢が困っているようだったからね。\n顔見知りのとりあえず頭のいい子を:
Well, it seemed like Miss Rekte was in a bit of a bind.
So I just brought along a smart acquaintance I know...
m920214.いや、様子がおかしい！\nゴブリンの鉱夫たちが……なんつーのか、\n上の空みたい:
It's not that! Something's off!
The goblin miners are…… I don't know,
they're all spaced out or something!
m920214.いやぁ、ちょっといい剣の気配がして来てみたら、\nなに？ 剣の付喪神たちに――:
Oh, I just felt a strong sword aura and came to check it out.
And what do I see? The sword tsukumogami—
m920214.いやぁ、でもおかしいんだよ。\nこの場所だって、大型の何かがあったみたいな\n大:
Yeah, but it's weird.
There's a massive hollow space here, the kind that suggests
something huge used to be here.
m920214.いやぁ、でもこういう時に水を差しちゃいけないぞ？\nジュウベエ、勝負は預けておく:
No, no. You shouldn't pour cold water on a moment like this.
Juubei, I'll leave the outcome to you.
m920214.いやいや、今この上は大変なことになってるんだよ。\n事前に戦闘準備する余裕くらい:
Oh, no, no. Things are quite chaotic up there right now.
You'd at least want some time to prepare for battle, wouldn't you?
m920214.う、うるさい！\nさぁ図面を見せてみろ。\nふむ……なるほど……拡張性はありそう:
??? : U-You're so noisy!
Well then, show me the blueprints.
Hmm... I see... There's some room for expansion...
m920214.うっわぁ、思いっきりぶつける気じゃねぇか。\nあんなの激突したらめちゃくちゃ痛い: If we collide with something like that, it's gonna hurt like hell!
m920214.うわ、また溶岩を掘り当てちまったのか？\nおーい、けが人はいないかー？:
Whoa, did we strike another vein of lava?
Hey, anyone hurt down there?
m920214.えぇ、そのとおりです。\nこれはあってはならない技術。\n私が誤ったせいで、伝え:
Yes, that is exactly right.

This is technology that should not exist.

A relic of the future I mistakenly passed on.
m920214.えっ、おい！ 剣士だけで分かり合ってないか！？\nちゃんと事情を説明してくれよ！:
Hey, wait! Can't the swordsmen just work this out between themselves?
Explain the situation properly!
m920214.えっ、なんであたしの名前――: Huh? Why are you saying my name――
m920214.お、大きくなってない？\nプロメさんこんな大きかったっけ！？:
O-oh, are you getting bigger?

Was Prome always this big?!
m920214.おい、オラティル。\nこういうことなら、僕をもっと早く呼ばないか。:
??? : Hey, Ollathair.
If it's this kind of problem, you should have called me sooner.
m920214.おい、確か過去に王国軍は、\n例の木馬を撃破していたはずだな？:
??? : Hey, if I recall correctly, the Kingdom's army
managed to destroy that Trojan horse in the past, right?
m920214.おいおい、待ちたまえよ。\n私もまた、きみと同じく文明を滅ぼした大罪人だ。\nこ:
Oh, oh, hold on a moment.
I, too, am a great sinner who destroyed a civilization, just like you.
I have the right to witness humanity's answer here, don't I?
m920214.おいレクテ、木馬を用いた拡張案を出せ。: ??? : Hey, Rekte, come up with an expansion plan using the Trojan horse.
m920214.おぉおぉ、いいねその殺気。\nこれなるは剣の亜神、名を祓剣主神という。:
Oho ho, I like that killing intent.
I am the Lesser Deity of Swords, Futsunushi.
m920214.おっと、申し遅れた。\n我が名はジュウベエ。\n剣が亜神よ、ひとつご指南賜わろう:
Oh, my apologies for not introducing myself.
I am Juubei.
Lesser Deity of Swords, please allow me to test your skills!
m920214.おや、トラムもいたのかい？\nそれにアランも！ ふふっ、姉妹の感動の再会だね！:
Oh, so Tram is here too?
And Aran! Haha, a heartwarming reunion for the sisters!
m920214.おや懐かしい顔だ。\nイムラウ、今までいったいどこにいたんだい？:
Oh, what a familiar face.
Imlau, where on earth have you been all this time?
m920214.おや？ 一騎打ちに絡んでくるとは、\nもしかして混ぜてほしくなったのかな？:
Oh? Interrupting a one-on-one fight.
Do you want to join in, perhaps?
m920214.お姉ちゃんなので、悪いことをしていたら叱ります。\nそれでも、弟たちの選択を、無:
As your big sister, I'll scold you if you do something wrong.
But I will never make the choices of my little brothers meaningless.
m920214.お母さん、みんなに分かるように説明して。: Mom, explain it in a way everyone can understand.
m920214.かつて、天界はひとつの伝承を秘匿しました。\n人類が文明を獲得し、\n今この時代:
Once, the Heavens concealed a certain legend.
It was about the event that allowed humanity to acquire civilization
and led us to this very era.
m920214.きみたちは、それを否定しなければならない。\n今の人類は未来にあるべき技術を手に:
You must deny that.
You have to show that even with the technology humanity should have in the future,
they can walk the right path without falling into error—
m920214.きみの与えた試練だろう？\n彼らは、見事にそれを乗り越えた。:
Wasn't that the trial you gave them?
They have overcome it splendidly.
m920214.きゃっ……そうね、坑道が崩落し始めているし……。\nこんな大きな落石、当たったら:
Kyah… You're right, the tunnel is starting to cave in…
If a boulder that big hit us, we'd be seriously hurt.
m920214.くっ……主殿！ 真剣勝負の最中だぞ！\n近づくと危な――おっとぉっ！？:
Tch… Prince! We're in the middle of a serious duel!
It's dangerous to get close— Oh, no you don't!
m920214.けれど、それ以外は？\nあなたたちの手が届かない場所では？\n悪意ある者にこの技:
But what about the rest?
In places beyond your reach?
What if this technology falls into the hands of those with ill intent?
m920214.ここから先にもトロッコの軌道は通したけど、\n正直、ふらふら歩き回れる状況じゃな: Honestly, it's not a place where you can just wander around.
m920214.ここみたいな空洞ばかりが存在していて、\n肝心の超古代文明ちゃんが出てこないのよ:
It's just that there are only hollow spaces like this,
and the actual prehistoric civilization itself isn't turning up……
m920214.この前の遺跡から出てきた遺物くんは、\nここについて何か話してなかったのか？:
Did that relic we found at the last ruin
say anything about this place?
m920214.この機体は、大破して久しいものです。\n今も私の火で、\n無理やり機関を動かして:
This vessel has been badly damaged for a long time.
Right now, I am merely forcing its engines to run
with my fire.
m920214.この船、たぶん騎馬兵みたいなものなんだ。\n大きな軍勢――つまり母艦から発進して:
This ship is probably like a cavalry unit.
It launches from a large fleet—meaning the mothership—
and is a type of ship that moves nimbly to engage in combat.
m920214.この船の力を手にしたとしても、\nそれが世界を壊してしまうのか、救うのか、\nど:
Even if we were to gain the power of this ship,
whether it will break the world or save it,
and which path we choose to walk,
is a responsibility that we, humanity, must bear.
m920214.これが最初で最後の警告です。\nこの先へ進むことは、このプロメが許しません。: This is my first and final warning. I, Prome, will not permit you to go any further.
m920214.さっきは力を抑えてくれていたのよ。\nつまり、今この状況は――:
She was holding back her power earlier.

In other words, the current situation is――
m920214.さてと……。\nこの先が、プロメの待つ領域ってことかしら。: I suppose this is the domain where Prome is waiting.
m920214.しかし、確かに何かしらの、\n予感のようなものがあったのは確か……。\nほら、お:
Still, I did have a sort of…
premonition.
Well, it's probably about time for—
m920214.じゃあ、たぶん無理だよ。: Well, I guess it's probably impossible.
m920214.すでに誰かに発掘されてしまった後、\nということですか？: Could it be that someone else has already excavated it?
m920214.そいつは何より。\n発掘は安全第一だからな！:
That goes without saying.
Safety first on any dig!
m920214.そういうわけで王子、\nさぁ、木馬を回収しに行くぞ！:
So, Prince,
let's go retrieve the Trojan horse!
--- scene: The Ship That Destroyed Civilization (battle, start) ---
m920214.そうですね……。\n王子、崩落がさらに進んでいます。\n落石地点も多くなっていく:
I see…
Prince, the collapse is worsening.
There should be more places where boulders are falling—
m920214.そう言いつつ、機関系はともかく、\n駆動系の技術はもうマスターしつつあるんですよ:
Even as you say that, aside from the machinery,
you're already mastering the propulsion technology.
Hehe, the engineers of this age are truly impressive♪
m920214.そしてその罪がゆえに、\n天界の伝承からその名を消された者。: And because of that sin, the one whose name was erased from the legends of the Heavens.
m920214.そのランタン、見せてください。\n……ふむ、やっぱりこれは……文明の……。:
May I see that lantern?
…Hmm, as I thought, this is… of the Civilization…
m920214.その時には、人と人の対話で乗り越えてみせると、\nそう言いたいのですよね、彼らは:
In that case, they would say
that they want to overcome it through dialogue between people.
m920214.その様を哀れに思った少数の神々が、\n天界に輝く火と叡智を奪い、人類に分け与えま:
A few gods, moved by pity for their plight,
stole the fire and wisdom shining in the Heavens and shared them with humanity.
m920214.それでも、この先へ進むつもりですか？: Despite all that, do you still intend to press on?
m920214.それなのに……私たちの責任まで、\n全部自分たちで背負おうとするなんて、\nそん:
And yet... to try and shoulder
all of that responsibility yourselves...
That's just... too unfair... it's so unfair...!
m920214.それにしても、どうしてこんなに\n刀に縁のある人ばかり\n発掘の手伝いにきてくれ:
Still, why is it that so many people
with a connection to swords
have come to help with the excavation…
m920214.それゆえに人類に牙を剥きましたが、\nそれでも、その責任を神に押し付けるようなこ:
That is why he bared his fangs at humanity,
yet he never once tried to pin the weight of that responsibility
onto the gods.
m920214.ただ、なんつーのか……。\n何かが埋まってた感じはあるんだけど、\nお目当ての大:
It's just, how do I put this……
I can feel like something's buried down here,
but that big dock we're looking for just won't show up.
m920214.ただ、人が力を手にすることに\n烈火のごとき怒りを示した神々は、確かにいました。: That said, there were certainly gods who reacted with burning fury to the idea of humans gaining such power.
m920214.たとえばタカマガハラやアヴァロンの者たちは、\n人が正しき成長の道を――争いなが: The gods of Takamagahara and Avalon, for instance, welcomed the fact that humanity had begun to walk the path of true growth—the path of progress, even through conflict.
m920214.だいぶ深いところまで降りてきたな……。\nここが、まともに歩き回れる最後の深度だ: This is the last depth where we can walk around freely.
m920214.だから、その力は……間違ってるんですよぉ……。\n己を滅ぼす力、それも、誰ひとり:
So, that power is... wrong...
Power that destroys oneself,
power that leaves no one with the choice but to walk the path to extinction...!!
m920214.だからこそ、トロッコの軌道も簡単に敷設できたし、\nどんどこ掘り進められるってわ:
That's why we were able to lay the mine cart tracks so easily
and keep digging forward without issue――
m920214.ちっ……あんなのが浮上したら、\n戦う前に溶岩に呑まれて溶けちまうぞ！:
Tch… If that thing surfaces,
we'll be swallowed by the lava and melt before we even fight!
m920214.つまり、ただの事故じゃなさそうってことね。\nみんな、周囲の警戒をお願い！:
So it doesn't look like a simple accident.
Everyone, keep watch on your surroundings!
m920214.つまり、気をつけて進めってことさ。\n火に魅了された鉱夫たちも\nまだまだ大勢い: There are still plenty of miners out there who've been bewitched by the fire.
m920214.て、転移も間に合わないです！\n溶岩の魔力が濃すぎて術がっ！？:
T-Teleportation won't make it in time either!
The lava's mana is too dense, the spell is――!?
m920214.ですが、あなたが求めている古の技術は、\n本来ならば未だ人類が手にすることが\n: But the ancient technology you seek is technology from a far-off future that humanity was never meant to possess yet.
m920214.ですが、これは本来、\n人類が今より数千年後に獲得する技術です。\nきっとあなた:
But this is technology

that humanity is not supposed to possess for another few thousand years.

Your descendants will surely reach it in time.
m920214.というと……？: What do you mean by that?
m920214.とんでもない剣士同士が遊びで殺し合うんです！\nこんな楽しそうなの見逃したら――:
Two formidable swordsmen are about to kill each other for fun!
It'd be a shame to miss such a spectacle— no, wait,
it's dangerous for everyone around, so I'm going to get the Prince!!
m920214.どうしたらいいと思いますぅ……？\nもう親離れできるよって、\n思いっきり見せつ:
What do you think I should do...?
You've shown me, in no uncertain terms,
that I can finally let go of my children.
m920214.なぜです？\n私たちと同じく、手を取り合えるのでは？: Can't we reach out to her, just as we would to one another?
m920214.なぜ焦るのですか。\n人類の苦しみはしばらく続くでしょうが、\nいつか、あなたの: Why are you in such a hurry? Humanity will continue to suffer for a while, but surely, one day, your descendants will put an end to it.
m920214.なるほど、こういうことね……。: I see, so that's what this is…
m920214.なるほど、道理だ。\nプロメ、覚悟したまえよ。\n彼らは本気で、私たちを過去から:
I see. It makes sense.
Prome, prepare yourself.
They are genuinely trying to save us from the past.
m920214.ねっ、ねぇ！\nフツヌシ様がここに来てたって聞いたんだけど！？:
Hey, hey!
I heard Futsunushi-sama came here!?
m920214.はぁ……はぁ……。\nようやく……あとちょっとで出口だ……。:
Haa… haa…
Finally… just a little more to the exit…
m920214.はぁ……まったくもー！\n超古代文明の遺跡が極端に少ない理由、これか！:
Haa……I see!

So that's why there are so few ruins of the Hyper-Ancient Civilization!
m920214.はぁ……主殿の模擬戦好きにも困ったものだ。\n剣が亜神よ、勝負は預けたぞ！:
Haa… I really can't do anything about your love for sparring.
Lesser Deity of Swords, I leave the match to you!
m920214.はぁ……寝てるはずのアマツミカボシ様から、\nちょっとぶった斬ってこいって言われ:
Haa… Amatsumikaboshi-sama was supposed to be sleeping,
but he told me to chop off a piece of him,
so I rushed out in a panic…
m920214.はぁぁ……またこいつと共同戦線か……。\nなぁ、常勝の智将ユリクセス様よぉ？:
Haaah... I'm stuck on the same side as this guy again...
Hey, you, the ever-victorious strategist, Ulyxes?
m920214.はぁー、うるっせぇなぁ……。\nいったいどこのどいつが――:
Haaah, you're so loud...
Who the hell are you, exactly――
m920214.はっ、はぁー！？ なにその二つ名！\nあたしには魔電流の発明家ってすごい二つ名が:
Hah, what the heck!? What's with that nickname!
I have a cool nickname, "Inventor of the Arcane Currents"!?
m920214.はっはっは、どんなお告げですかそれ。: Ha ha ha! What a prophecy that is.
m920214.ぴぇ……えぇと……。\n確証はないので、あくまで可能性という話で……。:
P-Please… um…
I don't have any proof, so this is just a possibility…
m920214.ふぅ……ランタンの火を奪えば\n正気に戻せるみたいだな。:
Phew… it looks like taking the lantern's fire
will bring them back to their senses.
m920214.ふぅ、自己紹介の手間を省いてくれるとは。\nさすが、持つべきものは有能な戦友だな:
Phew, saving me the trouble of introducing myself.
As expected, it pays to have a capable comrade-in-arms, doesn't it?
m920214.ふふっ、どうしてこんなに、\n自信満々に断言できちゃうんでしょうねぇ。:
Hehe... why are you so
confident in your assertion?
m920214.ふふっ、腕の立ちそうな\n東の国の剣士まで集まってるじゃあないか。:
Heh, and even swords from the Eastern lands
who seem quite skilled have gathered.
m920214.へぇ、私に黙って楽しそうなことを……。\n後で土産話を聞かせてもらおうかな？\n:
Hm, doing something fun without telling me…
I suppose I'll let you tell me all about it later.
Consider it payment for the staff I gave you back in the day.
m920214.ま、とりあえず掘ってみるさ！\n千年戦争以前の文明なんだろ？\n地形だって変わっ:
Well, let's just keep digging!
It's a civilization from before the Millennium War, right?
The terrain might be different too――
m920214.ま、親から何を教えられたとしても、\n将来何を考えて生きるかなんて、そいつの自由:
Well, no matter what is taught by one's parents,
how one chooses to live in the future
is entirely up to that person.
m920214.まぁ、見れば分かるよ。\n今は心構えをしつつ、ここから脱出しよう。:
Well, you'll see for yourself.
For now, brace yourselves and let's get out of here.
m920214.またひとつ楽しみができた。\n今後も鍛錬を怠らないように。:
I've gained a new source of amusement.
Do not neglect your training going forward.
m920214.まだ、完全に信じたわけでは、ないです。\nでも、少なくとも彼らは、\n私の与えた:
I don't trust them completely, not yet.
But at least, they won't
misuse the knowledge I gave them.
m920214.まるで超古代文明の誰かから、\n未来を託されたみたいな顔してますよぉ。:
You look as if someone from the hyper-ancient civilization
has entrusted you with the future.
m920214.もう、答えは決まっているんでしょう？\n大丈夫、みんなあなたの答えを、信じている:
Oh, you've already made up your mind, haven't you?
It's okay. Everyone believes in your decision.
m920214.もうっ、オラティル様なら\n上層までじゃなくて、地上まで転送できたんじゃないの？:
Oh, come on, Ollathair,
couldn't you have teleported us straight to the surface instead of just up here?
m920214.もう一歩踏み込めば本当の殺し合いになる……。\nだからこそ、互いに剣を止めたのよ:
One more step and it would have become a genuine fight to the death…
That is precisely why we both sheathed our swords.
Perhaps we judged each other too valuable to kill here.
m920214.もう！ 安全第一で、\nトロッコの管理はしっかりしろって言ったのに！:
Ugh! I told you safety comes first
and to keep a proper eye on the carts!
m920214.もちろん、天界の神々すべてが\n火の簒奪を責めたわけではありませんでした。: Of course, not every god in the Heavens condemned the theft of fire.
m920214.もちろん、生きてここを出られたら、ですが。: Of course, assuming you survive to leave this place.
m920214.よっし、分かった！\nみんな、主様呼びに行きますよ！:
Got it!
Everyone, I'm going to get the Prince!
m920214.れ、レクテ……？\n大丈夫？ 寝不足でおかしくなった……？:
R-Rekte…?
Are you okay? Did you lose it from lack of sleep…?
m920214.わぁぁぁ……。\nずいぶん掘りましたねぇ……。:
Whew…….
We've been digging quite a bit, haven't we……?
m920214.わがまま……わがまま過ぎます……。\n我が子の死に様を見たいママなんて、\nどこ:
It's selfish... far too selfish...
There is no mother anywhere
who wants to see how her child dies!?
m920214.ん……説明するのは、ちょっと面倒だな。\nまた遊びに来るから、自己紹介はその時に:
Hm… Explaining would be a bit of a hassle.
I'll come by to play again, so I'll introduce myself properly then.
m920214.ん、なんじゃあのトロッコ？\n改造されておらんか？: It looks like it's been modified.
m920214.ん、なんだアキレアか。\n――それでレクテ、この接続機構の新規開発を……。:
??? : Oh, so it's Achillea.
――Anyway, Rekte, about the new development of this coupling mechanism...
m920214.んん、明るく暖かくなるのはいいことだろ？\n怒る理由どこかにあったか？:
Hmph, isn't it a good thing that things get brighter and warmer?
Where's the reason to get angry?
m920214.んー、どうしてですかねー。\nなんだか、今日の発掘はマジで手伝ったほうが\n楽し:
Hmm, I wonder.
It feels like today's dig is going to be really fun,
like there's something cool to see, you know?
m920214.オーバーホール中の彼？\n確かに、この座標には大型ドックがあったと言ってたよ。:
The one that's being overhauled?
He did say there was a large dock at these coordinates.
m920214.ギャギャ……アッタカイホノオ……ドコ……？\nアレ……？ ココドコ？:
Gya-gya… warm fire… where…?
That…? Where is this?
m920214.ギャギャ……ランタンドコ……？\nポカポカナイ……ウッ……アタマガ……。: It's so warm… Ugh… My head…
m920214.ゴブリン軍団も協力してくれているからね。\nこういう発掘作業といえば、\n私たち:
Well, the Goblin Legion has been helping out.
When it comes to excavation work, it's usually
us dwarves and the goblins, right?
m920214.テンション上がってるだけだよ！？\nほら見てよクレール！ このエンジンどうやって:
I'm just excited, that's all!
Look at this, Krehl! I have no idea how
this engine works!!
m920214.フっ、ツヌシ！？ フツヌシ！？\n……じゅーべー殿、助太刀いります！？:
Huh, Futsunushi? Futsunushi!
…Juubei-sama, do you need backup?
m920214.プロメにも困ったものだよねぇ。\n大好きな人類に、こんな試練を与えるなんて、さ。:
It's a real headache with Prome, isn't it?
Giving humanity, which he loves so much, such a trial.
--- scene: Sword Sub-God (battle, start) ---
m920214.プロメ様って、\n古の人類が超古代文明に至った原因なんだよね？: Prome-sama is the reason ancient humanity reached the height of the Hyper-Ancient Civilization, right?
m920214.プロメ様に監視者となってもらい、\nすべての戦いを終えた後、\n超古代文明の技術:
Or, ask Lady Prome to act as a guardian,
and promise to return the Hyper-Ancient Civilization's technology to nothing
once all the battles are over…
m920214.ヤサシイ……ココロポカポカ……。: So kind… My heart feels warm…
m920214.ランタンは回収するけど、\nほら、毛布わけてやるから。ちょっと休んでいきな。: Here, take a blanket. Go on and rest for a while.
m920214.不可能じゃない、けど……。\n要塞宮殿からの雷撃に耐えられるような装甲、\n今か:
It's not impossible, but…
Developing armor that can withstand the lightning strikes from the Fortress Palace
starting from now would be a bit too much, wouldn't it?
m920214.世界を滅ぼしたという人類の過ちを、\n勝手に、自分たちだけの責任だと思わないでほ:
Please do not assume that the mistake of humanity
which destroyed the world is solely our responsibility.
m920214.世界を滅ぼしたのは、神じゃない。\n滅亡の道を進んだのは、かつての俺たちの選択だ:
It wasn't the gods who destroyed the world.
It was our ancestors' choice
to walk the path toward extinction.
m920214.世界を滅ぼせる力に勝てるなら、\nそれはすなわち、自分たちの手で\n世界を滅ぼし:
If you can defeat a power capable of destroying the world,
that means you are showing
the possibility of destroying the world with your own hands.
m920214.事実として、高度な文明を得たことで、\n自滅してしまった超古代文明だってあったわ:
As a matter of fact, there were Hyper-Ancient Civilizations
that gained advanced technology and destroyed themselves.
m920214.亜神ディアスに先手を打たれてしまいそうですね……。: We would likely be one step behind the Demi-God Dias…
m920214.人の話を聞けよクソ天才野郎！: Listen to what people are saying, you damn genius!
m920214.人類の母に反逆するようなものですね。\nそれでも、私たちは進まねばなりません。: Even so, we must press on.
m920214.今まさに、この子たちが語ったばかりでしょう？\n文明を与え、滅びをまねいた者。: Haven't these children just told you? The one who bestowed civilization and brought about destruction.
m920214.伝承は後で！\n何をどうしたらいいの、母さん！:
Legends can wait!
What are we supposed to do, Mom?
m920214.先に見つけた者がいても、\n分解して持ち出すのは、まず不可能でしょう。:
Even if someone had found it first,
it would be nearly impossible to dismantle and move it.
m920214.先ほどのプロメの言動……。\n彼女は人類を深く愛しているように見えました。\n話: I hope we can resolve this through dialogue.
m920214.全盛期の、都市を焼き、空を墜とした力はありません。\nけれど、誤った力を欲する愚:
It no longer possesses the power to burn cities and hurl them from the sky
that it once had in its prime.
However, it retains more than enough performance
to melt away the fools who crave such misguided power.
m920214.分かりました。\nならばその言葉が偽りでないと、証明してもらいましょう。:
I see.
Then let us see if your words are true.
m920214.剣神様に褒められると、\nどうにも背中がむずむずしますなぁ。:
Being praised by the Sword God makes
my back itch, somehow.
m920214.助けを呼べって、言っていたものね。\n――助けてくれるのでしょう？\nオラティル:
You said to call for help, didn't you?
――You will help us, won't you?
Ollathair――the other Sub-God of Civilization!
m920214.坑道が崩れて巣穴と繋がったのね。\n落石と、アリと……とにかく！\n全部気をつけ:
The tunnel must have caved into their nest.
Boulders and ants… anyway!
Watch out for everything!
m920214.夜の闇、冬の冷たさに、\n人々はただ翻弄され、その数を減らし続けた時代。:
In the darkness of night and the cold of winter,
people were tossed about by fate, and their numbers continued to dwindle.
m920214.大きな甲板を貼り付けるのではだめでしょうか？\n建物のように周囲を囲えば、\n上:
Would it not work to attach a large deck?
If we enclose the surroundings like a building,
it might be able to withstand the winds at high altitude…
m920214.大丈夫。王子ならきっと、\n彼女に言葉を届かせられるから。: It's all right. If anyone can reach her, it's you, Prince.
m920214.子の人生の終焉にまで、\n親であるあなた方が責任を負う必要はない。\nただ、子ら:
You, as the parents, do not need to bear responsibility
for the end of your children's lives.
We only ask that you watch over
the path your children choose for themselves.
m920214.存在するはずなのに、存在しない遺跡、ですか……。: A ruin that should exist, yet doesn't……
m920214.完全に失念してました……。\n超古代文明に触れようとする者には、\nその番人が火:
I completely forgot about that…
Those who seek to touch the Hyper-Ancient Civilization
are punished by its guardians with fire…
m920214.完全破壊に至るまでに、今の文明の人類なら、\nその半数は殺せるでしょう。\nそん:
Before it is completely destroyed,
it could likely kill half of the current human population.
Why do you desire a weapon like that?
m920214.嵐雨の亜神アスバール様と並び、\nこの世界に豊穣をもたらす偉大な神で――:
Alongside Asbail, the Lesser Deity of Storms and Rain,
she is a great god who brought plenty to this world—
m920214.己の器を超えた力を求めた結果は、\n同族による殺し合いと、力の暴走。\n文明の終: The result of seeking power beyond one's capacity is nothing but slaughter among one's own kind, the runaway of that power, and the end of civilization.
m920214.彼は背負った使命を誇りとして、\n人類とは何か、守るべき存在とは何かを\nずっと:
He took pride in the mission he carried,
always asking himself what it meant to be human,
and what it was that we were meant to protect.
m920214.我々は刀の付喪神ですからね。\nその生まれからして、\n燃え盛る炎はよく見慣れた:
We are tsukumogami of swords, after all.
By nature,
we are quite accustomed to raging flames.
m920214.戦うしか、なさそうですね……。\n王子、戦闘準備をお願いします！: It seems we have no choice but to fight……. Prince, please prepare for battle!
m920214.戦闘艦だから、大人数を輸送するような能力はないんだよ。\nでも、要塞宮殿に乗り込:
Since it's a warship, it doesn't have the capacity to transport large numbers of troops.
But if we're going to board the Fortress Palace,
we'll need to bring an elite force of the Material Realm Coalition Army, right?
m920214.断言は、できない。\nでもそうあろうと、私たちは努力し続けている。:
I cannot say for certain.
But even so, we continue to strive.
m920214.既に大破して久しい船ですが、\nその炉に、私の火を投げ入れました。:
Though it has been in ruins for a long time,
I have cast my fire into its furnace.
m920214.未来に負債を残すわけにはいかない、と？: You cannot leave a debt for the future, is that it?
m920214.火は文明の始まり。\n人が火を手にするというのは、いつの日か、\n人類が神と同じ:
Fire is the beginning of civilization.
For humans to hold fire in their hands means that one day,
humanity will reach the same place as the gods.
m920214.物質界でこんなに神々が集まってる様を見るなんて、\nやっぱり、私は誤った道を\n: To see so many gods gathered in the Material World… it seems I really did teach humanity the wrong path.
m920214.王子、あなたの志は称賛すべきものです。\nけれど、古の技術を、与えるわけにはいき: Prince, your ambition is admirable. However, I cannot allow you to be given the technology of antiquity.
m920214.知らないというより、\n忘れさせられた伝承と言うべきでしょうか。:
Rather than unknown,
it should be called a legend that was made to be forgotten.
m920214.知りません！ そんなの、そんなの……！\n私たちの子が……文明の種が……。:
I don't know! That's just... that's...!
Our children... the seeds of civilization...
m920214.神サマでも知らない昔の話ってことか？: So it's a story from before even the gods knew about it?
m920214.私が目をそらしていた間に、\nこんなに強く、\n未来を目指して、育っていたなんて:
While I was turning a blind eye,
they had grown so strong,
reaching for the future...
m920214.私たちみんなの、お母さんなんだよね……？\nそれなら、誰に責任があるとか、そうい:
You are our mothers, aren't you...?
If that's the case, it's not about who is responsible,
but rather, I want to say thank you
for teaching us civilization.
m920214.私たち亜神ではなく、人類自身の力と言葉で、\nもう一度彼女に心を開いてもらうしか: To make her open her heart to us once again.
m920214.私は時代の番人。\n人が過ぎたる力で己を滅ぼさぬよう、\n世界の歩みを断絶させる:
I am the Guardian of the Ages.

One who severs the world's path

so that humanity does not destroy itself with power it cannot control.
m920214.私も多くは知りませんが、\n少しだけ、人類の始まりについて語りましょうか――。:
I don't know much about it either,
but may I tell you a little about the beginning of humanity—
m920214.簡単ではないだろうね。\n彼女は超古代文明の滅亡を、自分の責任だと考えている。\:
It won't be easy.
She believes the fall of the Hyper-Ancient Civilization is her fault.
Because she gave the fire of civilization to humanity.
m920214.約束しましょう。\nとはいえ、次はその首もらいますよ。:
I promise I won't.
But next time, I will be taking your head.
m920214.結果として、簒奪者たちは神の座を追われ、\n天界の記録からも抹消され――: As a result, the usurpers were cast out of their divine seats and erased from the records of the Heavens—
m920214.腕が立つ、とまで言ってもらえるのは嬉しいな。\nそちらもさぞかし名のある剣士とお:
I'm flattered to be called skilled.
And you, I take it, are a swordsman of renown as well?
m920214.腕利き、頭の回るやつ、わけのわからない天才は好きなんだ。\nお前の名前はそこそこ:
??? : I like skilled, quick-witted, and inexplicably genius people.
Your name is fairly well-known, you mad, demonic engineer.
m920214.自分が与えたもので、\n愛する人々が大勢死んだんだよ？\nそんなの、もう二度と繰: She wouldn't want to repeat that, would she?
m920214.落ち着いてアルレット！\nって、わっ、わー！？ 機関部見えてる！\n溶岩流れ込ん:
Calm down, Arlette!

Wait, wha-?! I can see the engine room!

The lava's flowing in, haa, it's going to break!!
m920214.要塞宮殿に座すディアスを倒さねば、\n物質界はいずれ、停滞という滅びを迎えるので: Otherwise, the Material Realm will inevitably meet its end in stagnation.
m920214.見ていてくれ、文明の母たち。\n俺たちの選ぶ未来を。:
Watch us, mothers of civilization.
Watch the future we choose.
m920214.覚悟しておきたまえよ。\nここを出たら、アレと戦うことになるからね。:
You should be prepared.
Once we get out, we'll have to fight that thing.
m920214.証明するわ。\n今の私たちがその船に勝利すれば、\nもはや、あなたが思い悩む必要:
I'll prove it.
If we defeat that ship now,
there's no need for you to torment yourself anymore, is there?
m920214.話せば長くなるんだけど……ちょっと異世界に……？: That's a long story, but… I was in another world, I guess?
m920214.認めて、もらえないかしら？\n人類は道を過つこともあるけれど、\nそれを正し、も:
Will you not understand?

Humanity may stray from the right path,

but it can correct its course and move forward again.
m920214.豊穣神オラティル様といえば……。\n今でも各地に神殿の残る\nとても古い時代の神:
Ollathair, the God of Plenty…
She's a deity from a very ancient era!
Temples to her still stand in various places to this day!
m920214.走ってくるトロッコには気をつけて！\n当然だけど、激突したら痛いわよ！！:
Watch out for the oncoming carts!
And of course, if you get hit, it's gonna hurt!!
m920214.超古代文明に関わろうとする者には、\n文明の火が罰を与え、燃やし尽くすという伝承:
Legend has it that those who try to involve themselves with the Hyper-Ancient Civilization
are punished by the Civilization's fire, which burns them to ashes…
m920214.超古代文明の滅びの原因は無数にあるけどさ、\nそのほぼ全てが、制御できない域に達: Almost all of them were caused by humanity's own technology reaching a level it couldn't control.
m920214.転ぼうが滅びようが、\n何度でも立ち上がる者が大好きだからね、\nタカマガハラの: The gods of Takamagahara simply love those who keep getting back up, no matter how many times they fall or how close they come to ruin!
m920214.道を踏み外した時に、\n人類が滅びへ歩みだしたその時に、\nその間違いを正せるだ:
When humanity strays from the path,
when it begins to walk toward extinction,
will you possess the power to correct that mistake?
m920214.馬鹿なことを言っている暇があったら、\n知っている情報を全部吐いてください。\n:
If you have time for nonsense,
then spill everything you know.
The Kingdom's army is about to clash with Prometheus.
m920214.（……来てしまったのですね。ここに、この場所に）: (…So you have come. To here, to this place.)
m920214.（おや……なぁトラム？\nアランの罵りがちょっと優しくなっていないかい？）:
(Oh… hey, Tram?
Doesn't Aran's scolding sound a little gentler than usual?)
m920214.（彼らこそ、この時代を守護する者たち。\nけれど、だからこそ、\nこの地の遺跡に:
(They are the ones who protect this era.
But precisely because of that,
we must not let them touch the ruins of this land.)
m920214.（指摘するとまた激しくなるからやめておいたら？\n姉さんがいない間に、こっちも色:
(If I point that out, she'll just get even more worked up, so I'd better leave it alone.
There's been a lot going on on our side too, while Sis is away.)
m920214.（早く焼き尽くしてしまわないと。\n早く、溶かし尽くしてしまわないと――）:
(I must burn it all to ashes before it's too late.
I must melt it all away before it's too late—)

m920223.――いーい雪原だァ！\nヤーハーッ！ 雪も漢の海よォ！！:
――What a fine snowy expanse!
Yaa-haa! Snow is a man's sea, too!
m920223.――げぇ！？ 王国の連中がなぜここに！？: Gah!? Why are the Kingdom's people here!?
m920223.――というわけで、\n闇の組織の密猟を防ぐことに成功し、\n森にも平和が戻りまし:
And so, we successfully stopped the dark organization's poaching,
and peace has returned to the forest.
m920223.――はぁ。どうして、\n密猟の手伝いなんぞをしなければいけないのか。:
――Haa. Why do I have to
help with poaching?
m920223.――僕はね、怒ってるんだよ！\n人間たちが森を荒らして、\nみんなを捕まえようと:
—I'm angry, you know!
Humans keep trashing the forest
and trying to capture everyone!
m920223.――皆さん大変です！\n暴走した獣たちがこちらに向かっています！:
Everyone, we have a problem!
A pack of rampaging beasts is heading this way!
m920223.……このままでは飾り付けが破壊されるな。\n仕方がない、トナカイのおもちゃとやら:
……If we don't stop it, it'll wreck the decorations.
I suppose I have no choice. I'll stop that reindeer toy.
m920223.……そうだな。\n仕方がない、助けてやるか。:
……I suppose so.
Fine. I'll help it out.
m920223.……それにしても寒いな。\nお前たちは平気そうな顔をしているが、\n雪道を歩いて:
……And it's freezing, too.
You all look fine, but
aren't you freezing walking through the snow?
m920223.……とりあえず肯定しておけば大人しくなりそうだな。: ...I'll just agree for now. It might calm down.
m920223.……などと、聞くまでもありませんでしたね。\nかしこまりました。対処に当たります: ...I suppose there was no need to ask. Understood. I will take care of it.
m920223.……やめたいわけではない。\nまぁ、暇つぶしには丁度いいだろう。: ...It's not that I want to stop. It'll do fine as a way to pass the time.
m920223.……冷えるとよくない。\nルチアもくるといい。:
……Getting cold is bad for you.
Lucia, come here.
m920223.……聖夜という響きは気に食わんな。\nだというのにサンタクロースをやらされるとは: ...I don't care for the sound of "Holy Night." And yet, I'm the one who has to play Santa Claus.
m920223.……邪魔な奴だな。\nさっさと始末しよう。:
……What an annoyance.
Let's dispose of him quickly.
m920223.あぁ！？ 守護獣さんが\n悪い方向に振り切っちゃったよぉ！:
Oh no! The Guardian Beast
has gone completely the wrong way!
m920223.ああ、そうだな。\n今回は大きな騒ぎもなく、\n平穏に祝祭を過ごせそうな気がする:
Ah, I see.
It seems we'll be able to enjoy a peaceful celebration this time, without any major disturbances.
m920223.ああ、そうだな。\n闇の組織を放っておくわけにもいかないし、\n守護獣たちのもと:
Ah, yes.
We can't just leave the Dark Organization alone,
so let's hurry to the Guardian Beasts.
m920223.ああ、それがいいな。\nちびっ子を喜ばせる前に廃棄されては、\nおもちゃ達も悔し:
Ah, that sounds like a good idea.
If it's discarded before it can make the little ones happy,
the toy itself would probably be upset.
m920223.ああ、父よ母よ、森の仲間よ。\n死という安易な解決に頼る僕を許して！:
Oh, Father, Mother, and friends of the forest.
Forgive me for relying on the easy solution of death!
m920223.あちらが守護獣ということでしょうか。\n言葉が通じるようですし、声をかけて――。:
So that must be the Guardian Beast.
It seems to understand us. Let's try calling out to it—
m920223.あちらは相変わらず仲良しでございますね。\n邪魔をするのも悪いですし、私とメープ: They're as close as ever over there. We wouldn't want to intrude, so perhaps Maple and I should accept the gifts meant for distribution.
m920223.あっ、変な人が川に飛び込もうとしてるよ！: Oh no, that strange person is about to jump into the river!
m920223.あっ、海賊みたいな人が逃げていくよ！: Ah, the pirate-like person is running away!
m920223.あの風貌……闇の組織の人間か？: That appearance... Are they members of the Dark Organization?
m920223.あれは確か、闇の組織のスリーですね。\nどうします？ とりあえず倒しておきますか:
That must be Three from the Dark Organization.
What shall we do? Shall we take him down first?
m920223.うむむ……純粋すぎる娘が相手だと、\nいささか分が悪いな……。: Hmph... Dealing with someone so pure puts me at a slight disadvantage...
m920223.うん、なんとなく分かるんだぁ♪\nだからちょっと動物たちに聞いてみるね！:
Yes, I can get a vague sense of it♪
So I'll go ask the animals a little!
m920223.うんっ、メープルも、\n王子さまからプレゼントがほしいな♪:
Yeah! I want a present
from the Prince too♪
m920223.うんっ。力を合わせて、\nいい子のみんなに、プレゼントを配ろうね♪:
Yeah! Let's work together
and deliver presents to all the good kids♪
m920223.うんっ！ 動物たちのためにも、\nわるい人をやっつけるよー！: Yes! For the animals' sake, we'll defeat the bad guys!
m920223.うん！ そうだよ！\nだから安心して！:
Yes! That's right!
So please don't worry!
m920223.うん！ 森の動物たちが教えてくれたの！\n守護獣はこのあたりにいるって！:
Yes! The forest animals told us!
They said the Guardian Beast is around here!
m920223.うーん、違うみたいだよ？\nお腹が空いてるんじゃないんだって。:
Hmm, I don't think so.
They said they weren't hungry.
m920223.ええ。しかし、獣たちはどうして、\nこんなにも殺気立っていたのでしょうか？: Yes. But why were the beasts so agitated?
m920223.えっ、もしかして私に、\nプレゼントの用意を……？: E-eh? So you were preparing a gift for me…?
m920223.えっと、私もよろしいでしょうか……？: Um, may I join in too…?
m920223.えっとね、あっちのほうで\n襲われそうになったんだって！:
Well, they were about to be attacked
over that way!
m920223.えへへ、これなら寒くないね♪: Hehe, this is much better, right?♪
m920223.えへへ、じゃあメープルが、\nみんなと一緒に運んでおくね！:
Ehehe, then I'll carry it
with everyone else!
m920223.おっと、川があるじゃねェか！\n水があるならこっちのもんだぜ！:
Oh, there's a river!
If there's water, this place is just as good as any!
m920223.おもちゃは全て止まったか。\nまったく、人騒がせなものだ。:
All the toys are stopped now.
Honestly, what a fuss.
m920223.お前がしつこかったからだ。\nまったく、顎で使っているのだから、\nここの代金は:
It's because you were so insistent.
Honestly, you're just barking orders at me.
You're paying for everything here.
m920223.お前は意地悪にもなったな。\nそんな悪い子にはプレゼントはやれないぞ。:
You've turned into a tease, haven't you?
I can't give presents to a bad girl like that.
m920223.お嬢さんの目が今日の気温くらい冷たいぜ……。\nでもオレはめげない！\n泳げない:
Your eyes are as cold as today's temperature, miss...
But I'm not giving up!
If I can't swim, I'll just slide over!
m920223.お詫びになにか……。\nえっと、ドングリいる？:
As an apology, let me offer something…
Um, do you have any acorns?
m920223.くぅぅぅぅッ！\n急にオレに襲いかかるなんて、\n困ったお嬢さんたちだ！:
Grrr!
Attacking me out of nowhere…
You troublesome ladies!
m920223.くっ、ここは退くしかないようだな……！\n行くぞスリー、牢屋が嫌ならついてこい！:
Tch, looks like we have no choice but to retreat……!
Let's go, Three. Follow me if you don't want to end up in prison!
m920223.くっ、密猟のことがもうバレてやがる！\nこうなったら仕方ねぇ！\nこいつらを始末:
Dammit, the poaching has been exposed!
Well, I guess there's no other option!
We'll take them out and destroy the evidence!
m920223.くっ、次こそ大儲けしてやる！\n覚えてろよォーー！:
Tch. Next time, I'll make a killing!
Just you wait!
m920223.ぐうの音も出ねぇ……。\n俺、田舎に帰ろうかな。:
You've got me there…
I think I'll head back to the countryside.
m920223.こういう光景を見ていると、\n今回のクリスマスは無事に済みそうな気がしてきますね: Seeing a scene like this makes me feel like this Christmas will turn out fine in the end.
m920223.こちらでも調べてみたが、\n近頃森の中に不審な人物が出入りしているようだ。: We've looked into it as well. Lately, there have been suspicious figures entering and leaving the woods.
m920223.こっちもかなり大人しくなったようだな。: It seems to have calmed down quite a bit.
m920223.この森の動物たちは、密猟されそうになったり、\n酷い目にあってきたと思う。:
The animals in this forest have been on the verge of being poached,
and they've all suffered terribly.
m920223.これで全部か。\nまったく、手間をかけさせるな。:
Is that all of them?
Honestly, don't make us go through all this trouble.
m920223.これで少しは静かになったな。\n守護獣の方はどうだ？:
Things are a bit quieter now.
How is the Guardian Beast doing?
m920223.これは褒美のひとつでももらわないとな。: I think I deserve a little reward for that.
m920223.こんなに寒いんだから当たり前だろ。: That's only natural, it's this cold.
m920223.さて、そろそろ戻りましょうか、\nお疲れ様でした、王子。:
Well, let's head back.
Good work today, Prince.
m920223.さて、聖夜もそろそろ近い。\n私たちはサンタクロースとして、\nプレゼントを配る:
Well, the Holy Night is drawing near.
As Santa Claus, we should make our final preparations
for distributing presents.
m920223.しかし、サンタというのは\n割に合わない仕事をするものだ。:
However, being Santa is
quite a thankless job.
m920223.しかし抱き着かれていると、\n咄嗟の時に身動きができな――: However, being clung to like this makes it hard to move in a pinch――
m920223.しまった！ 一番面倒な奴が乱入してきたぞ！: Dammit! The most troublesome one just barged in!
m920223.しょうがねぇなァ！\nだが森の動物たちは、\n根こそぎオレたちがいただくぜェ！:
I guess I have no choice!
But we're taking every last animal in that forest!
m920223.じゃあ誰の血で角を赤く染めればいいの……？: Then whose blood should I use to dye my antlers red...?
m920223.すっかり遠慮がなくなって……。\nほら、これでいいのか？:
You've really dropped all your reservations…
Here, is this one okay?
m920223.すみませんラピス様。\nそこの飾りを取ってもらえますか？:
I'm sorry, Lapis-sama.
Could you grab that ornament over there?
m920223.そういうことだ。\nスリーはともかく、ファイブ。賢いお前なら、\n降伏するのが利:
That's right.
I don't care about Three, but Five. You're smart enough
to know that surrendering is the sensible choice, aren't you?
m920223.そういうわけさ。\nところでお嬢さん。:
That's right.
By the way, miss.
m920223.そういうわけにはいかねェなァ！\nじゃあなお嬢さんたち！\n狩りの後にオレと聖夜:
I'm afraid that's not going to happen!
Well then, ladies!
Let's spend the holy night together after the hunt!
m920223.そういえばメープルさんは、\n獣の気持ちが分かるのでしたね。: I recall that you can sense what the animals are feeling, Maple.
m920223.そういえば聞いたことがあります。\nここ、雪の国の森には守護獣がいるのだとか。:
Oh, I've heard of that.
I was told there's a Guardian Beast in the forests of the Snow Country.
m920223.そういえば近頃はクラールフ様が、\n海の平和維持をしてくれているそうですね。: I hear that His Majesty Claufr is maintaining peace at sea these days.
m920223.そうだよ！ 動物たち、すっごく怖がってたの！: That's right! The animals were so scared!
m920223.そうでしたね。\nでは、もうひと頑張りしましょうか。:
That's right.
Then let's buckle down one more time.
m920223.そうですね……おや？\nあちらに不審な人影がございますね。:
Indeed... Oh?
There are some suspicious figures over there.
m920223.そうですね。\n今日はこのあたりで撤収しましょうか。:
I suppose so.
Let's wrap things up for today.
m920223.そうですね。ところでラピス様は、\nいつまで私を抱き締めているつもりです？:
Yes. By the way, Lapis,
how long do you intend to keep holding me like that?
m920223.そうですね。またひょんなことで\n暴走しそうではありますが……。\nともかく、一:
Yes. It might run wild again over some trivial matter,
but for now, the crisis is averted.
m920223.そっか……なら、キミを信じて――。: I see... then I'll trust you.
m920223.そっか、キミたちは悪くないんだ……。\n襲っちゃってごめんね。:
I see. You're not bad people after all…
I'm sorry for attacking you.
m920223.そっちじゃないです。\n右隣のキラキラしている方をお願いします。:
Not that one.
Could you grab the sparkly one to the right of it, please?
m920223.その不審者が密猟を企てている、\nということでしょうか？: You mean these intruders are planning the poaching?
m920223.その前にまず\nちゃんと罪を償うことだな。:
Before that, though,
you need to properly atone for your crimes.
m920223.その後で、人間は悪人だけではなく、\n心が綺麗な者もいると、\n世間知らずなトナ:
After that, I'll teach this sheltered reindeer
that not all humans are villains,
and that some have pure hearts.
m920223.それで、ここで密猟をしてたのは、\nお前たち闇の組織なのか？: So, you from the Dark Organization were the ones poaching here?
m920223.それで、このおもちゃはどうしよう？\nこのまま捨てるのはかわいそうだよぉ……。:
So, what do we do with this toy?
It'd be a shame to just throw it away…
m920223.それで、貴様は何故ここにいる。\n貴様は確か海で悪事を働いていたはずだが。:
So, why are you here?
I thought you were committing crimes at sea.
m920223.それでご主人様。\n密猟の件はいかがしましょうか？: So, Master. How shall we handle the poaching situation?
m920223.そんなこと言われても……。\n下っ端は逆らえませんし……。:
I… I can't say much, I guess.
We're just low-level grunts. We don't get to argue.
m920223.そんなにオレと遊びたかったのかな……キラァン。: Did you really want to play with me that badly…? Kiraan.
m920223.そんなに飲むとは言っていない……！\nとにかく、今ある一杯を飲んだら、仕事に戻る:
I never said I wanted to drink that much……!
Anyway, once we finish this round, I'm heading back to work.
m920223.た、大変だよぉー！\nトナカイのおもちゃが！ トナカイのおもちゃが～！！:
H-help! It's the reindeer toy!
The reindeer toy is going haywire~!!
m920223.だ、だめ！ 守護獣は\n攻撃的な気持ちでいっぱいだよぉ！？:
N-no! The Guardian Beast is
filled with aggressive feelings!
m920223.だが私たちが倒されてはたまらん。\n一旦大人しくさせるぞ！:
But we can't afford to be defeated.
We'll calm it down for now!
m920223.だけど……正直この森での密猟は無理ッスよ。\nなんせここには、守護獣がいますから:
But honestly, poaching in this forest is a lost cause.
After all, there's a Guardian Beast here.
m920223.だとしたら、\n密猟の犯人は闇の組織ということか。: If so, then the Dark Organization is behind the poaching.
m920223.ち、ちくしょう！\nやっぱり海の漢は森じゃ分が悪いのか……！？:
C-curses!
So a sea brute really is at a disadvantage in the forest…?!
m920223.ついに見つけたぜ、森の守護獣！\nこれを仕留めちまえば、\nあとは動物も狩り放題:
I finally found you, Forest Guardian Beast!
If I take you down,
the rest of the animals will be fair game to hunt and sell!
m920223.でしたら、技師に預けて、\n修理していただきましょうか。:
If that's the case, we could hand it over to the engineers
and have them repair it.
m920223.でしたらやめますか？\nサンタ役の手は足りていると思いますが。: If you'd like, you can stop. I believe we have enough people for the Santa role.
m920223.でも、きっと困ってるよ！\nだからメープルは、\n助けに行ったほうがいいって思う:
But it's probably in trouble, right?
So I think Maple should go help it!
m920223.でも、人間は悪い人ばっかりじゃないんだよ。\nだから、メープルたちを信じて！:
But not all humans are bad people.
So please, trust us!
m920223.でも、暖かいでしょ♪\nメープルもね、寒い日は友達とこうして、\n身を寄せ合った:
But it's warm, right?♪
On cold days, Maple and my friends used to
huddle together like this.
m920223.でも違った。ヤツは……すごい獣だ。\nここにいる俺たちはみんな返り討ちに遭って、:
But we were wrong. That thing… it's a terrifying beast.
Everyone here got wiped out, and
we absolutely couldn't get close enough to hunt.
m920223.というわけでラピス様。\n引き続き飾り付けをしていきますよ。:
So, Lapis-sama.
We'll keep working on the decorations.
m920223.とかなんとか言いつつ、\n律儀にオレの手伝いをしてくれてるじゃねェか。:
You say that,
but you're faithfully helping me, aren't you?
m920223.ところでラピス様。\n遠慮がなくなったと嘆いていましたが、\n私はもっと余所余所:
By the way, Lapis-sama.
You were lamenting that I've lost my reserve.
Should I be more formal with you?
