m940001.……敵が兵を送り込む通路を、\nそのまま逆走してやればいいということね。: ……It seems you simply have to run in reverse down the path the enemy uses to send in their troops.
m940001.……時間を、取られすぎたな。\n飛空戦艦の発艦準備を急がせろ。: ……We've wasted enough time. Hurry up with the airship's launch preparations.
m940001.……結構。\nその怒り、人の身としておくには惜しいものダ。:
...Very well.
That anger of yours would be a waste if kept within a human body.
m940001.……迷わされている、のだろうな。: ...We are being led astray, aren't we.
m940001.……霊魂たちが、騒いでる。\nえっと……これは……。:
……The souls are making a commotion.
Um…… this is……
m940001.『物質界と冥界の国を打ち立てたら、\n次は天界にも参りましょうぞ！』とか言ってる:
"Once we've built nations in the Material World and the Underworld,
let's head to the Heavens next!" they're saying.
m940001.『行ってこいよ俺たちの女王陛下！』\n『伝説一個で満足するとからしくねぇ、\n伝:
"Go on, Your Majesty!"
and "Don't just settle for one legend,
go establish a second one!" they say.
m940001.ああ、こいつの言ってることは間違いない。: Yes, what he says is true.
m940001.ああ、時間稼ぎ、だろうな。: Ah, it's a stalling tactic, isn't it.
m940001.ああ。そのとおりだ。\nそしてその契約は果たされた。\nだからもう、オレはオレの:
Ah. That's correct.
And that contract has been fulfilled.
So now, I can do as I please.
m940001.ああ。ならば――問うべきだろう。\n我が同胞たちよ！\n我が名はメリュジアナ、黒: Indeed. Then we must ask. Hear me, my compatriots! I am Meliusiana, heir to the Black Elder!
m940001.あっ、待ちなさい！\n王子もためらいなく飛び降りる準備をしないで！\nはぁ……浮:
Ah, wait!
And don't you start preparing to jump, Prince!
Haa…… I'll cast a floating spell on you, all right!
m940001.あなたがかつて築いた国は、\nひとつの理想を体現したものでした。:
The nation you once built
was the embodiment of a single ideal.
m940001.あなたって、亜神のこと\n便利な道具だとでも思ってない？:
Do you just see the Demi-Gods
as convenient tools?
m940001.ある儀式のために必要な命の灯火を、狩りに行くんだとよ。: He was going on a hunt for the life-lights needed to perform it.
m940001.あんな力、戦えない人たちが受けたら……！: If people who can't fight were to be hit by that kind of power...!
m940001.いや、そうだな……。\nそこのへカティエも秩序を重んじる亜神だ。\n多少は似てて:
No, that's fair…….
That Hecatie over there is a Demi-Goddess who values order.
It's no surprise we have a few things in common.
m940001.いや、その理解は半分正しいが、\n正確とも言い切れないな。:
No, that understanding is only half right,
though I can't quite call it accurate either.
m940001.いやはや、相手の考えが手に取るように分かるね。\nただの都市を狙うだけじゃ効率が: Oh my, their intentions are painfully clear. They've decided that targeting a mere city is too inefficient.
m940001.うまく切り抜けたら、\nたぶん美味しいカリカリとかくれるはずだぞ。: If we pull it off, they'll probably give us some tasty treats.
m940001.えぇ、黙って留まっていれば、\nそれだけ食料の備蓄も減っていくわ。\nどうにかし:
Yes. If we just stay put,
our food supplies will only dwindle further.
We have to find a way through somehow.
m940001.えっ、いや待て、本当に飛び降りる気じゃ――: W-Wait, hold on! You're not actually going to jump, are you――
m940001.えっ、オルフィーさんまだ心当たりあるんですか？: Huh? Orphie, you still have a lead?
m940001.こうなると、軍は弱いわね……。\nうぅん、こっちまで弱気になったらダメね。:
At this rate, our army is weakening……
Ugh, I can't afford to lose my nerve too.
m940001.ここで、終わらせてやろう。\nその覚悟もなく、俺の民を手に掛けたわけではあるまい:
Let me end this here.
You didn't lay a hand on my people without the resolve to see it through, did you?
m940001.ここまでの領土奪還は、いわば前哨戦。\nハイドースの目的は、この先の儀式完遂にあ:
The reclamation of territory up to this point was merely a preliminary skirmish.
Hydra's true purpose is to complete the ritual ahead.
m940001.こちらは、こちらでできることをしよう。\n愚かな竜人の同胞たちは、\nどうやら続: We will do what we can. It seems our foolish Ryujin compatriots are marching toward us in droves.
m940001.この先は、冥界と物質界の隣接した場所よ。\n奴ら、それを知って突入口を開いたとい:
This is where the Underworld borders the Material World.
They must have known that, and opened a breach.
m940001.これは、俺の招いた失態だ。\nいずれこの首で、民には罪を償おう。: This is a blunder I brought upon us. I will atone for the people's suffering with my own life.
m940001.こんな戦法を仕掛けられるのは、\n完全に想定外ですからね。:
This kind of tactic was completely
outside of our expectations.
m940001.ご無事……のようですね……？\n実力行使をする前で助かりました……。: You seem to be safe……? I'm glad we arrived before things turned physical…….
m940001.さぁ、殺せ。\n全力で戦ったんだ、悔いはねぇ。:
Come on, finish me off.
I gave it my all, so I have no regrets.
m940001.さっきと同じ……いや、\n今度は死臭が混じっているな。\nミノタウロスのゾンビが:
Same as before……no,
there's a stench of death mixed in this time.
There are Minotaur zombies.
m940001.さて、我々も続くとしよう。\n女王ラビリスが待っているはずだ！:
Now then, let us follow.
Queen Labrys should be waiting for us!
m940001.しかし、その働きは十分だった。\n我が冥界に、数多の魂が集まりつつある。:
Nevertheless, his efforts were sufficient.
My underworld is gathering a multitude of souls.
m940001.すり潰されたい奴から前に出ろ！\n我が名はラビリス！\n雷霆の神が娘にして、地上: Whoever wants to be crushed, step forward! My name is Labrys! Daughter of the Thunder God, Queen of the Earth, and Demi-Goddess of Order!!
m940001.そうデス！\nモハヤ、ハイドースも帝国も関係アリませヌ！:
That is right!
Hydos and the Empire no longer matter!
m940001.そしてその契約は、完遂された。\nそれでハイドースは、この時間を使って何を企んだ: And that contract was fulfilled. So, what was Hades scheming while he had all that time?
m940001.その儀式が何を目的としているか、\nそこまでは教えちゃくれなかったが、\n人の命: They never did tell us what the ritual is for, but... anything that demands human lives can't be good.
m940001.その目的は？\nこちらに付いたのだから、教えてくれるでしょう？:
What was the purpose?
Since you've come to us, you'll tell us, won't you?
m940001.その言い方、思いっきり喧嘩売ってません？: Is that really the way to put it? You're practically picking a fight.
m940001.それでも、あなたの法は\n野蛮な荒くれ者たちから、民を守っていた。:
Even so, your laws
protected the people from barbaric brutes.
m940001.それでも、だ。エリック。\n我らが退路を確保せねば、\n帝国軍は進むべき道を失う:
Even so, Eric.
If we fail to secure a retreat,
the Imperial Army will lose its path forward.
m940001.それはたぶん、亜神ハイドースとの約束。\n帝国軍をここで足止めするところまでが、:
That's likely the promise you made with the Demi-God Haidos.
Your contract was to hold the Imperial Army here,
wasn't it?
m940001.そんなこと、させるものか。\nヴルム殿、街へ急ぐぞ！:
I will not allow that to happen.
Lord Wurm, we must rush to the city!
m940001.だが、ここは違う。\n広いのではなく、何というのか……。:
But this place is different.
It's not just wide, but how should I put it...
m940001.ちくしょう……。\nこうなったら元帥殿に直談判だ。\n特別報奨に危険手当に勲章も:
Dammit…….
If it comes to that, I'll go straight to the Marshal.
I'm demanding special rewards, hazard pay, and a medal!!
m940001.ちっ……そうは言ってもなぁ！\n門は破られたし、陣形もめちゃくちゃだぞ！？\n敵:
Tch…… That's easy for you to say!
The gate is breached, and our formation is in shambles!
Who knows how many of the enemy have slipped past us?
m940001.どうした、尻尾を巻いて逃げ出すのか？\n無様だな、偽物の雷竜殿。:
What's wrong? Are you going to run away with your tail between your legs?
How pathetic, you fake Thunder Dragon.
m940001.どっけぇぇぇぇぇッ！！: Get outta the way, ya hear me!!
m940001.なっ……どうやってオレの迷宮を……！: Wha…… how did you get into my labyrinth?!
m940001.なるほど、総力戦での我々の殲滅ではなく、\nただ長時間の足止めを目論んでいるのな:
I see. If their aim is not to annihilate us in a full-scale battle,
but simply to stall us for a long time,
then they've hidden their destination.
m940001.なんか、言い訳の仕方がヘカティエ様と似てるね。: Somehow, the way you make excuses reminds me of Hecatie-sama.
m940001.はっ！\n先刻、冥界拠点に竜人部隊が急襲。\nすでに多数の敵の通過を許し……。:
Yes, sir!
A dragonkin unit launched a surprise attack on the Underworld base just moments ago.
We've already allowed a large number of enemies to pass through……
m940001.ふぅ、やーっとマトモな敵のお出ましかな！: ???: Phew, finally a proper enemy shows up!
m940001.ふふん、ならば簡単なことよのぅ。\nそこの突き当たりから、\n地の底へ一直線に向:
Fufu, then it's simple.
From that dead end ahead,
we can head straight down to the bottom of the earth.
m940001.へカティエ、力を貸せ。\n魔術の神でもあるのなら、\n落下死くらいは防いでくれる:
Hecatie, lend me your power.
If you're a goddess of magic,
you can prevent a death by falling, right?
m940001.へカティエのところの小間使いが、\nふたりも揃って何の用事だ？: What business do Hecatie's little servants have, showing up together like that?
m940001.へカティエ様が敵対するつもりである以上、\nいずれは激突する相手ですし……。: Since Lady Hecatie has set her sights on opposing them, they're bound to clash eventually…….
m940001.へカティエ様との\n連絡が途絶えて、そろそろ一週間ですか。: It's been about a week since we lost contact with Lady Hecatie.
m940001.へカティエ様！\nやっぱり拉致監禁されてたんですね！？: Lady Hecatie! So you really were being kidnapped and held captive!
m940001.ほう……そこまで推測したのか。: Hm…… So you deduced that far.
m940001.ほとんどが口伝ばかり。\n書物はそれらを集めたものだから、\nバリエーションが豊:
Most of it was oral tradition.
The books just compiled all of it,
so the variations were overwhelming.
m940001.まさか、この部隊の指揮官は……。: No way... the commander of this unit is...
m940001.まっかせて！\nどけどけー！ ぶっ飛ばすぞー！！:
Leave it to me!
Move aside, you lot! I'm gonna blow you away!!
m940001.まったく……こんな過酷な行軍、\n帰ったらご褒美たんまりもらわないとな！:
Honestly……after a march this brutal,
I'm going to need a big reward when we get home!
--- scene: Seventh Formation: Harsh March (battle, battle) ---
m940001.めげないしょげない！\nそれだけフォーラの\n操艦技術が認められてるってことだよ:
Don't get discouraged!
It just means Fora's piloting skills are being recognized.
m940001.もう何日間、太陽を見てないんですかねぇ。: ??? : I wonder how many days it's been since we last saw the sun.
m940001.もはや、貴様の言葉など届かない。\n何を言おうと、ただ叩き潰すだけだ。:
Your words no longer reach me.
Whatever you say, I will simply crush you.
m940001.ようやく、だ。\n本当に、本当に長かった。\nこの時を迎えるまで、どれだけの夜を:
Finally.
It truly, truly took a long time.
How many nights did I have to endure before reaching this moment.
m940001.りょーかい！\n晴れ舞台には誰も行かせないよっと！: Got it! No one's getting to the main stage!
m940001.ん？ ああ、たぶんこの先――地の底だ。: Hm? Ah, probably from ahead――from the depths of the earth.
m940001.アダマス……決して赦すものか……。\n貴様の身勝手な正義のために\n奪われたもの:
Adamas... I will never forgive you....
I shall now reclaim what was taken from me for your selfish notion of justice.
m940001.オヤメください！\nクロコ様、今のお身体デハ、\n雷竜の力に耐えきれマセヌ！！:
Please stop!
Lord Croco, in your current state,
you cannot withstand the power of the Thunder Dragon!!
m940001.オラァ！ 腰抜けドモ！\n竜の誇りがネェならどきやがれェ！！:
Hah! You spineless wimps!
If you've no dragon's pride, then get lost!!
m940001.オルフィー、リチュエも助力を。\n今こそラビリスを討つ好機。\n彼らの戦いに水を: Orphie, Ritue, lend a hand. This is our chance to defeat Labrys. Eliminate anyone who tries to interfere with their battle.
m940001.オレが足止めをしていたのは、\nハイドースに借りがあったからだ。:
The reason I was stalling them
was because I owed Hades a debt.
m940001.キンドライヒ、敵の匂いを嗅ぎ取っていたな。\n出処は分かるか？:
Kindreich, you've been tracking the enemy's scent.
Do you know where they're coming from?
m940001.キンドライヒ、敵の規模は？: Kindreich, what's the scale of the enemy force?
m940001.クリッペ、盾騎士で玉座の間を封鎖しろ！\nラビリスをここで仕留める！: Krippe, seal off the throne room with your shield knights! Take Labrys down right here!
m940001.クロコ……竜将クロコ。\n貴様の思惑など、知ったことではない。:
Croco... Dragon General Croco.
I could not care less about your schemes.
m940001.クロコ様、遠方ヨリ軍勢が迫っておりまス。\nおそらく帝国軍カト。:
My lord Croco, an army is approaching from afar.
It is likely the Empire's forces.
m940001.クロコ様！\nくっ……転送魔法陣を急ゲ！:
Lord Croco!
Damn it... Hurry up with the teleportation circle!
m940001.シカシ、こちらにも退けぬ理由がアル。\nいずれ終焉ヲ迎えるコノ大地で、\n竜神の:
However, I have my reasons for not retreating.
On this land that will one day meet its end,
in order to preserve the blood of the Dragon God――
m940001.ジュディス、お疲れ様。\n負傷者の状態はどう？:
Judithe, you must be exhausted.
How are the wounded?
m940001.ダガ、ソノ歩みだけは覚えておこウ。\n次の時代に、愚かな先人の歴史とシテ。\n最:
But I will remember that path.
In the next age, as the history of foolish ancestors.
Time to move on to the final touch――
m940001.ティルト、あなたのご主人さまなら、\nささっとこの迷宮を脱出できたりしない？:
Tilt, couldn't your master
just quickly find a way out of this labyrinth?
m940001.ハッ、確かにそろそろ飽いてきた頃だ。\n約束した刻限も近いし、\n迷宮から出して: Hah, I was just getting bored anyway. The deadline I promised is coming up soon, so I don't mind letting you out of the labyrinth――
m940001.フォーラ、縦穴を確認しろ。\n飛空戦艦で通過可能か調べるんだ。\nクリッペ、キン:
Fora, inspect the shaft.
Check if the airship can pass through.
Krippe, Kindreich, provide escort.
m940001.ヘリューズ様の封鎖階層崩壊に\n巻き込まれた、というわけでもないでしょうし。\n:
It can't be that they were caught up in the collapse of Helius's sealed layers.
Ritue, I'll go look for any clues...
m940001.ホウ、想定より、少々早かったナ……。\n良いだろう、少々飽いてきたところダ。:
Hm, a bit earlier than expected....
Very well. I was starting to get bored, anyway.
m940001.一方的に法を押し付けられるつもりはない。\nこのままでは兵が疲弊し続けるだけだ。:
I have no intention of having law imposed on us unilaterally.
If we stay here, our troops will only continue to exhaust themselves.
Prince, let's find a way out.
m940001.不意打ちに奇襲に地下からの浸透戦術。\nやり口がただ勝つことしか考えてなくて、\: Ambushes, surprise attacks, infiltration from below. Their tactics are all about winning at any cost. There's no Ryujin spirit in it at all.
m940001.亜神――いえ、女王ラビリス。\n前回の遭遇戦の後、\n帝国軍と共同であなたの伝承:
Demi-Goddess――no, Queen Labrys.
After our last encounter,
we investigated your legends together with the Imperial Army.
m940001.今ここで、貴様の雷を終わらせる。: I will end your thunder here and now.
m940001.今回も大変ですよ。\n冥界から物質界のどこに繋がるかと思えば、\nここ、工業都市: This time is no different. I thought the connection from the Netherworld would lead somewhere else, but it's right next to this industrial city!
m940001.今工場を破壊されたら……。\n周囲を巻き込んで大爆発しちゃうぞ！:
If the factory gets destroyed now....
It'll trigger a massive explosion that takes the surroundings with it!
m940001.何度か試したけど、無理だったわ。\nここは冥界というより、そう、\n彼女の領土と:
I've tried a few times, but it was no use.
This place feels less like the Underworld and more like...
well, her territory, I suppose.
m940001.俺がヤツの立場なら、おそらく今頃は、\n気に入らない遅滞作戦を退屈に思っている頃:
If I were in his position, I'd probably be finding
that tedious delaying tactic boring by now.
m940001.倒しても倒してもキリがない……。\nいったいどこに、これだけの兵力を隠しているん:
No matter how many we defeat, they just keep coming...
Where on earth are they hiding so many troops?
m940001.儀式の成就まで、しばらく時間はかかるが……。\nどうか、焦らず待っていてほしい。:
It will take some time before the ritual is complete....
Please, do not rush. Wait for me.
m940001.全軍、前進するぞ。\n敵の襲撃に備えろ！:
All units, advance!
Be ready for enemy attacks!
m940001.冥界からこの地へ至る穴も、\n時が経てばさらに増えていくはずだ。\n敵の侵攻経路: The holes leading from the Netherworld to this land will only multiply with time. Keep a close watch on the enemy's invasion routes.
m940001.冥界がいくら広いって言っても、\n突然どこにいるか分からなくなるなんて\n絶対な:
No matter how vast the Underworld is,
there's no way people would just vanish without a trace.
Something definitely happened.
m940001.冥界の領土をオレに割譲してくれたのは、\nまぎれもなくあのハイドースだったからな:
It was undoubtedly that Hades
who ceded the Underworld's territory to me.
m940001.冥界の騎士たちならば、命の灯火も分かるだろう。\n……教えろ。帝国の民の血は、流:
The Knights of the Netherworld would surely know how to read the flames of life.
...Tell me. Did the blood of my people flow?
m940001.冥界は死者の世界。\n生と死が常に繰り返される以上、\n確かに広大――いや、無限:
The Underworld is the realm of the dead.
As long as life and death are in constant cycle,
it certainly possesses a vast—no, an infinite—domain.
m940001.前の戦いを思い出すね。\nあの時も大変だったけど……。: It reminds me of our last battle. That was tough, too...
m940001.厳格な法に基づいた、理性の都です。\n人々は秩序の庇護のもとに、\n繁栄を謳歌し:
A capital of reason, founded on strict law.
The people must have thrived
under the protection of order.
m940001.古の雷竜、真なる雷霆、その成就のタメ、\n我らはココに集いましタ。:
For the sake of the ancient Thunder Dragon, the true thunder, and its fulfillment,
we have gathered here.
m940001.失われたのは、戦士の魂ばかり。\n力なき者たちを守るために散っていったのでしょう:
What was lost was only the souls of warriors.
They must have fallen to protect those who had no strength to defend themselves.
m940001.女王ラビリス、我々は分かりあえるはずです。\nなぜなら、あなたは今も法を大切にし:
Queen Labrys, we can understand each other.
Because you still value the law.
m940001.好き勝手言いやがって……。\n法を破った罪は、その身で償ってもらうぜ。: Talking big, aren't you……. You'll pay for breaking the law with your own bodies.
m940001.妥当な策だとは思ったけれど、\nその出口が、あなたの玉座だとは考えもしなかったわ: I thought it was a reasonable strategy, but I never imagined the exit would be right at your throne.
m940001.存外、宴の準備でもして出迎えてくれるかもしれないぞ。: He might even be preparing a feast to welcome us.
m940001.守れもシナイ領土を広げ、\n現にコウシテ、愚かな敗北を繰り返ス。:
Expanding territory that cannot be defended,
and now look at this. Repeating the same foolish defeats.
m940001.小規模な戦闘を休みなく仕掛けられ、\n似たような風景ばかりを見ながら行軍し、\n:
Constant skirmishes without a break,
marching through the same scenery over and over……
Everyone is physically and mentally exhausted.
m940001.帝国の民の命を、好きにさせるものか。: I won't let him have his way with the lives of my people.
m940001.帝国軍、王国軍共に行方不明。\n捜索隊を出そうにも、\n完全に手がかりがない状態:
Both the Empire's and the Kingdom's forces are missing.
Even if we send out search parties,
we have absolutely no leads to go on...
m940001.彼女は、女王ラビリスは\nきっと話の通じる方だと思うんです！:
She, Queen Labrys,
is surely someone we can talk to!
m940001.待て、王子。\n我らが口出しすることではないだろう。: Hold on, Prince. This is not for us to meddle in.
m940001.愚かな人類に雷の鉄槌を下ス日マデ、\n御身に散られては困りまス！:
Until the day we bring the hammer of thunder down upon foolish humanity,
we cannot afford to have you scattered!
m940001.我が主がしばし不在でして……。\nもしかしたら、お隣さんの館に監禁されていないか: Our mistress is away for a moment……. I was wondering if perhaps she might be held captive at the neighbor's place.
m940001.我が儀式のるつぼに、死者の魂を。: Into the crucible of my ritual, the souls of the dead.
m940001.探索を続けるしか、なさそうだな……。: It seems we have no choice but to keep exploring……
m940001.敵は既に、帝国領内に侵入している。\n敵の目的は領土奪還ではない。\n此度の作戦:
The enemy has already breached Imperial territory.
Their objective is not the reclamation of land.
It seems the goal of this operation is to take lives.
m940001.方針は決まったな。\n斥候は各通路を探れ。\n残りの者は気付いたことがあれば何で:
The plan is set.
Scouts, check every passage.
The rest of you, report anything you notice.
--- scene: Seventh Formation: Harsh March (battle, start) ---
m940001.来るが良い、亜神ラビリス！\nみんな気をつけろ、\nヤツの突撃は倒れるまで止まら: Come at us, Demi-Goddess Labrys! Everyone, be careful! Her charge won't stop until she's taken down!
m940001.次から次へと……！\n元帥、お下がりください！:
One after another……!
Marshal, please fall back!
m940001.死者の確認を。\n必ず、全員見つけ出せ。:
Check on the dead.
Make sure to find every single one of them.
m940001.残りの者は物資と負傷者の移送を急げ！\nこの先は……。…………ッ。:
Everyone else, prioritize moving supplies and evacuating the wounded!
What lies ahead is………!
m940001.汝ら、如何なる理由でこの地を踏み荒らすのか！\n誇りある竜人ならば答えるがいい！: For what reason do you trample this land? Answer me, if you have any pride left as Ryujin!
m940001.犯罪者には容赦がなかったみたいだけど、\nまぁ、それはあなたを見れば分かる。:
You showed no mercy to criminals, it seems,
but well, you don't have to tell us that.
m940001.王子、敵の考えが分かるか？: Prince, do you understand the enemy's intentions?
m940001.王子さま、このままじゃ工業都市が大変です！\n前の戦いでも、クロコは一時的に\n:
Prince, if this goes on, the industrial city is in grave danger!
In the last battle, Croco briefly replicated the power of the ancient thunder dragon.
m940001.真なる竜神、だと……？: The True Dragon God, you say...?
m940001.確かに、敵の蠢く気配はより下方より感じられる。\nだが下へ向かう階段が、この迷宮:
Indeed, the enemy's presence is felt more strongly below.
But there is no staircase leading down in this labyrinth.
m940001.私たちを冥界に留めて、\nいったい何をするつもりなのかしら。:
Keeping us trapped in the Underworld……
what exactly is she planning?
m940001.穴掘りはこちらの専売特許だというのに！\n陛下、王子殿、ズガガガンと蹴散らしてや: And digging holes is our specialty! Your Majesty, Prince, let's kick them all to the curb!
m940001.第三層に下りてから、もう一週間か。\n冥界第三層、まさかここまで広大だとはな。:
It's been a week since we descended to the Third Layer.
I never imagined the Underworld's Third Layer would be this vast.
m940001.第三層を治める者、法と秩序の番人――ラビリスの、ね。: The ruler of the Third Layer, the Warden of Law and Order—Rabilis's, that is.
m940001.聞こえねぇなァ。\n――で、どこから話したものか。:
Can't hear you.
――Now, where should I start?
m940001.良からぬ企みであることは確かだ。\nならば、いつまでもその茶番に付き合う必要もあ:
It's certainly no good scheme.
Then we have no need to play along with this charade any longer.
m940001.行くぞ、祖国の……民のために。: Let's go. For our homeland... and its people.
m940001.行軍に問題はありません。\nただ、そろそろ医薬品のストックが底をつきそうで。:
The march itself is proceeding without issue.
However, our medical supplies are running dangerously low.
m940001.街壁が突破されてる……。\nしかもあれ、工場の排熱が止まってない！？:
The city walls have been breached....
And look, the factory's exhaust heat hasn't stopped?!
m940001.言っておくが、これは裏切りじゃねぇぞ。\n無事にひとつの約束を果たしたから、\n:
Let me make this clear, this isn't a betrayal.
I simply fulfilled a promise safely,
and decided to do whatever I wanted from here on out.
m940001.貴様の責任ではない。\n戦力配置を見誤った、私にこそ責任はある。\nよく、ここま:
This is not your fault.
I misjudged the deployment of our forces. The responsibility lies with me.
You've held out admirably.
m940001.貴様までつらそうな顔をするな。\n手を貸してくれているだけで、\n俺たちからすれ: Don't look so pained. The fact that you're lending us a hand is more than enough.
m940001.逃げろト言うノカ！？: Are you telling me to run away!?
m940001.通常の用兵と同じだと考えない方がいいわ。\nこの迷宮そのものがラビリスの権能なら:
It would be best not to think of it as standard military tactics.
If this labyrinth itself is Rabilis's authority,
then while we are trapped in her scheme—
m940001.部下の魂すら喰らい、\n雷竜と化す覚悟かと思えば、存外甘い男だったな。: I thought he had the resolve to devour the souls of his own subordinates and transform into a thunder dragon, but he was far more sentimental than expected.
m940001.長老ナド知ったことカ！\n我ラ、真なる竜神を目指す雷霆の徒ナリ！: Who cares what the Elder thinks! We are the Thunder Disciples, seeking the True Dragon God!
m940001.陛下、もはや一刻の猶予もありません。\nこの地の竜人部隊を撃破し、\n物質界を目:
Your Majesty, there is no more time to spare.
We must defeat the dragonkin unit in this area
and press on toward the Material World.
m940001.領土を侵した私たちに罰を与えるのではなく、\nこんな時間稼ぎをし続けたのは、\n:
Instead of punishing us for invading your territory,
you kept stalling us like this,
didn't you? Because of another "promise"?
m940001.食料も薬も、もう限界に近いと……。: Both food and medicine are nearly at their limit……
m940001.（……地上に出てから、\nへカティエ様、生き生きしてるなぁ）:
(……Ever since we came to the surface,
Hecatie-sama has been so lively.)
m940001.（ああ、それであの大量の本運ばされたんだ……）: (Ah, that's why they hauled in all those books……)
m940001.（粗暴ではあれど、己の法に忠実で、\n自ら前線に立つことを好むあのラビリスが、\:
(Rough as she is, Rabilis is loyal to her own code
and prefers to stand at the front lines herself.
Why is she resorting to such roundabout tactics?)
